# Amara Singapore: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025

 2025-05-07

Vendor:[Amara Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/9/hotels/detail/492/amara-singapore)

![Image 5: Amara Singapore: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250507/20250507112409_47670.jpg)

Singapore isn’t short on wedding venues. But when a hotel manages to balance polished spaces, practical comforts and just the right amount of flair, it earns our attention. This year, **Amara Singapore**has done just that, securing one of our Editor’s Choice Awards for ‘Banquet Venue’ 2025. Here’s why.

### Venues Designed for the Occasion

![Image 6: Amara Singapore: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250507/20250507112438_67601.jpg)

The Grand Ballroom at Amara Singapore ticks a lot of boxes, and then casually adds a few more. It’s pillarless, naturally sunlit, and seats up to 400 guests without the usual feeling of being wedged into rows.

The Grand Ballroom’s 38-metre aisle feature makes a dramatic entrance feel effortless. Meanwhile, a massive 7.6-metre LED video wall allows couples to personalise their celebration with striking visuals and atmosphere-defining moments.

For smaller weddings, the two adjoining ballrooms offer flexibility without compromise, equally suited to intimate receptions and mid-sized celebrations while maintaining the same sense of occasion. Each space is cleanly designed, easy to adapt, and polished without ever feeling impersonal.

Amara Singapore also offers Connection Rooms for ceremonies and solemnisation, hosting 50 to 60 guests in private, elegant settings. These spaces are especially suited for smaller ceremonies that still deserve the atmosphere of something carefully considered.

### An Icon, Refurbished with Purpose

![Image 7: Amara Singapore: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250507/20250507112530_84364.jpg)

The refurbishment in 2024 artfully bridges its 39-year legacy with contemporary elegance. This comprehensive revamp goes beyond visual appeal. It signals a bold new chapter defined by thoughtfully curated guest experiences and an elevated approach to modern hospitality. It’s a property with quite a lot of years behind it, but the new look signals that it knows exactly where it’s going next, and you’ll want your wedding to go with it.

### An Unmatched Location

Perfectly positioned between Singapore’s Central Business District and the charming cultural enclaves of Chinatown, Amara Singapore offers a seamless blend of city sophistication and heritage charm—an ideal setting for a blissful wedding celebration. Just steps from Tanjong Pagar MRT station and easily accessible via major expressways, the hotel ensures effortless travel for you and your guests. For added convenience, ample parking is available at the adjoining 100AM mall, so every arrival feels smooth and stress-free. Whether it’s a quiet stroll through nearby heritage streets or a lively evening in the heart of the city, everything you need is within easy reach.

### Details That Make a Difference

Every venue has its checklist. But Amara Singapore goes a step further by handling those smaller, often overlooked needs with clarity. Chinese banquet menus are crafted in-house by the hotel’s own experienced chef, and the kitchen can cater for halal and vegetarian requests without minimum orders. For couples wanting their pets present, the hotel permits bringing your precious fur-kids to solemnisation ceremonies, with pet-handling services and designated spaces available. Cleaning services are provided so everything runs smoothly before, during, and after.

### A Grand Wedding with Amara Singapore

Amara Singapore has earned one of our awards not by reinventing the wedding venue, but by refining it. It’s a place that understands what couples need and what guests appreciate and delivers it with quiet confidence. For couples looking to celebrate in a venue that offers both presence and practicality, **Amara Singapore**proves exactly why it deserves its place on our 2025 list.

# Amara Singapore: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025

 2025-05-07

Vendor:[Amara Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/9/hotels/detail/492/amara-singapore)

![Image 5: Amara Singapore: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250507/20250507112409_47670.jpg)

Singapore isn’t short on wedding venues. But when a hotel manages to balance polished spaces, practical comforts and just the right amount of flair, it earns our attention. This year, **Amara Singapore**has done just that, securing one of our Editor’s Choice Awards for ‘Banquet Venue’ 2025. Here’s why.

### Venues Designed for the Occasion

![Image 6: Amara Singapore: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250507/20250507112438_67601.jpg)

The Grand Ballroom at Amara Singapore ticks a lot of boxes, and then casually adds a few more. It’s pillarless, naturally sunlit, and seats up to 400 guests without the usual feeling of being wedged into rows.

The Grand Ballroom’s 38-metre aisle feature makes a dramatic entrance feel effortless. Meanwhile, a massive 7.6-metre LED video wall allows couples to personalise their celebration with striking visuals and atmosphere-defining moments.

For smaller weddings, the two adjoining ballrooms offer flexibility without compromise, equally suited to intimate receptions and mid-sized celebrations while maintaining the same sense of occasion. Each space is cleanly designed, easy to adapt, and polished without ever feeling impersonal.

Amara Singapore also offers Connection Rooms for ceremonies and solemnisation, hosting 50 to 60 guests in private, elegant settings. These spaces are especially suited for smaller ceremonies that still deserve the atmosphere of something carefully considered.

### An Icon, Refurbished with Purpose

![Image 7: Amara Singapore: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250507/20250507112530_84364.jpg)

The refurbishment in 2024 artfully bridges its 39-year legacy with contemporary elegance. This comprehensive revamp goes beyond visual appeal. It signals a bold new chapter defined by thoughtfully curated guest experiences and an elevated approach to modern hospitality. It’s a property with quite a lot of years behind it, but the new look signals that it knows exactly where it’s going next, and you’ll want your wedding to go with it.

### An Unmatched Location

Perfectly positioned between Singapore’s Central Business District and the charming cultural enclaves of Chinatown, Amara Singapore offers a seamless blend of city sophistication and heritage charm—an ideal setting for a blissful wedding celebration. Just steps from Tanjong Pagar MRT station and easily accessible via major expressways, the hotel ensures effortless travel for you and your guests. For added convenience, ample parking is available at the adjoining 100AM mall, so every arrival feels smooth and stress-free. Whether it’s a quiet stroll through nearby heritage streets or a lively evening in the heart of the city, everything you need is within easy reach.

### Details That Make a Difference

Every venue has its checklist. But Amara Singapore goes a step further by handling those smaller, often overlooked needs with clarity. Chinese banquet menus are crafted in-house by the hotel’s own experienced chef, and the kitchen can cater for halal and vegetarian requests without minimum orders. For couples wanting their pets present, the hotel permits bringing your precious fur-kids to solemnisation ceremonies, with pet-handling services and designated spaces available. Cleaning services are provided so everything runs smoothly before, during, and after.

### A Grand Wedding with Amara Singapore

Amara Singapore has earned one of our awards not by reinventing the wedding venue, but by refining it. It’s a place that understands what couples need and what guests appreciate and delivers it with quiet confidence. For couples looking to celebrate in a venue that offers both presence and practicality, **Amara Singapore**proves exactly why it deserves its place on our 2025 list.

# Amara Singapore: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025

 2025-05-07

Vendor:[Amara Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/9/hotels/detail/492/amara-singapore)

![Image 5: Amara Singapore: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250507/20250507112409_47670.jpg)

Singapore isn’t short on wedding venues. But when a hotel manages to balance polished spaces, practical comforts and just the right amount of flair, it earns our attention. This year, **Amara Singapore**has done just that, securing one of our Editor’s Choice Awards for ‘Banquet Venue’ 2025. Here’s why.

### Venues Designed for the Occasion

![Image 6: Amara Singapore: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250507/20250507112438_67601.jpg)

The Grand Ballroom at Amara Singapore ticks a lot of boxes, and then casually adds a few more. It’s pillarless, naturally sunlit, and seats up to 400 guests without the usual feeling of being wedged into rows.

The Grand Ballroom’s 38-metre aisle feature makes a dramatic entrance feel effortless. Meanwhile, a massive 7.6-metre LED video wall allows couples to personalise their celebration with striking visuals and atmosphere-defining moments.

For smaller weddings, the two adjoining ballrooms offer flexibility without compromise, equally suited to intimate receptions and mid-sized celebrations while maintaining the same sense of occasion. Each space is cleanly designed, easy to adapt, and polished without ever feeling impersonal.

Amara Singapore also offers Connection Rooms for ceremonies and solemnisation, hosting 50 to 60 guests in private, elegant settings. These spaces are especially suited for smaller ceremonies that still deserve the atmosphere of something carefully considered.

### An Icon, Refurbished with Purpose

![Image 7: Amara Singapore: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250507/20250507112530_84364.jpg)

The refurbishment in 2024 artfully bridges its 39-year legacy with contemporary elegance. This comprehensive revamp goes beyond visual appeal. It signals a bold new chapter defined by thoughtfully curated guest experiences and an elevated approach to modern hospitality. It’s a property with quite a lot of years behind it, but the new look signals that it knows exactly where it’s going next, and you’ll want your wedding to go with it.

### An Unmatched Location

Perfectly positioned between Singapore’s Central Business District and the charming cultural enclaves of Chinatown, Amara Singapore offers a seamless blend of city sophistication and heritage charm—an ideal setting for a blissful wedding celebration. Just steps from Tanjong Pagar MRT station and easily accessible via major expressways, the hotel ensures effortless travel for you and your guests. For added convenience, ample parking is available at the adjoining 100AM mall, so every arrival feels smooth and stress-free. Whether it’s a quiet stroll through nearby heritage streets or a lively evening in the heart of the city, everything you need is within easy reach.

### Details That Make a Difference

Every venue has its checklist. But Amara Singapore goes a step further by handling those smaller, often overlooked needs with clarity. Chinese banquet menus are crafted in-house by the hotel’s own experienced chef, and the kitchen can cater for halal and vegetarian requests without minimum orders. For couples wanting their pets present, the hotel permits bringing your precious fur-kids to solemnisation ceremonies, with pet-handling services and designated spaces available. Cleaning services are provided so everything runs smoothly before, during, and after.

### A Grand Wedding with Amara Singapore

Amara Singapore has earned one of our awards not by reinventing the wedding venue, but by refining it. It’s a place that understands what couples need and what guests appreciate and delivers it with quiet confidence. For couples looking to celebrate in a venue that offers both presence and practicality, **Amara Singapore**proves exactly why it deserves its place on our 2025 list.

# Wedding Catering with Peach Garden: When Your Dream Venue Needs the Perfect Menu

 2025-07-08

![Image 6: Wedding Catering with Peach Garden: When Your Dream Venue Needs the Perfect Menu](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250708/20250708144448_67177.jpg)

What if your dream wedding venue doesn't come with dream-worthy food?

You've found it. The perfect spot that makes your heart skip a beat every time you picture yourself walking down the aisle there. Maybe it's that stunning rooftop with panoramic views, or perhaps the charming heritage building that perfectly captures your love story. There's just one tiny problem: the catering situation leaves much to be desired.

Here's where **Peach Garden**steps in, and really, it's about time someone talked about this service that's been quietly revolutionising Singapore weddings.

Beyond the Restaurant Walls

Most people know Peach Garden for their stunning restaurant venues. But what many couples don't realise is that their culinary expertise doesn't have to stay confined within those four walls. The restaurant has been quietly building a reputation for bringing their exceptional Cantonese cuisine directly to external venues across Singapore.

Think about it for a moment. You shouldn't have to compromise on food just because you've fallen in love with a venue that doesn't have in-house catering. Your wedding day deserves both the setting of your dreams and the feast of your lifetime.

![Image 7: Wedding Catering with Peach Garden: When Your Dream Venue Needs the Perfect Menu](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250708/20250708144612_30247.jpg)

This external catering service opens up a world of possibilities for couples who want to marry somewhere unconventional. Gardens by the Bay? They've got you covered. Even venues like iFly (yes, where people go indoor skydiving) can become your wedding destination when Peach Garden handles the culinary side of things. And you don't have to imagine – these images are from the previous times Peach Garden has hosted a wedding at these venues!

![Image 8: Wedding Catering with Peach Garden: When Your Dream Venue Needs the Perfect Menu](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250708/20250708144636_18475.jpg)

Couples may choose between sit-down or buffet-style wedding catering, which we’ll talk about in the next section:

### Sit-Down and Buffet-Style Catering

![Image 9: Wedding Catering with Peach Garden: When Your Dream Venue Needs the Perfect Menu](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250708/20250708144726_83272.jpg)

Picture this: your guests arrive to find tables meticulously set with fine china and elegant place settings. Dedicated staff members glide between tables, serving each course with the precision and attention you'd expect from a high-end restaurant.

For **Sit-Down catering**, Peach Garden can arrange on-site cooking for many dishes, ensuring that signature items like their Double Boiled Shark's Bone Cartilage Soup arrives at your table piping hot and absolutely perfect.

![Image 10: Wedding Catering with Peach Garden: When Your Dream Venue Needs the Perfect Menu](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250708/20250708144816_83006.jpg)

This includes a full table set-up and dedicated staff to serve each course. Your uncle who's been to every wedding in the family will still be talking about the service months later.

![Image 11: Wedding Catering with Peach Garden: When Your Dream Venue Needs the Perfect Menu](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250708/20250708144906_91966.jpg)

But, sometimes, you want your wedding to feel more relaxed, where guests can mingle freely and sample different dishes at their own pace. Peach Garden's**Buffet-Style**catering creates exactly this atmosphere with their delectable spread of Oriental cuisine.

![Image 12: Wedding Catering with Peach Garden: When Your Dream Venue Needs the Perfect Menu](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250708/20250708145424_20725.jpg)

Want to watch culinary magic being performed in real time? There’s a buffet live station where you can watch their chefs in action.

Furthermore, the beauty of their buffet setup lies in the variety and the visual impact. Guests can return for seconds (or thirds) of their favourites, and there's something wonderfully communal about everyone gathering around beautifully arranged food stations. Conversations spark naturally and there are plenty of mixing opportunities between different groups of family and friends.

### Signature Dishes That Steal Hearts

Let's talk about the food itself, because this is where Peach Garden truly shines. Whether you choose sit-down or buffet style, you're not getting watered-down banquet versions of their restaurant dishes. You're getting the real deal.

Their Crispy Peking Duck remains a showstopper at weddings. Watching the chef carve it fresh creates a memorable moment that guests love photographing. And even for catering, couples can select and savour piping hot signature Chinese cuisines such as Double Boiled Shark’s Bone Cartilage Soup, Signature Stewed Noodle with Baby Lobster, as well as many other signature dishes.

The setup itself can be customised too, though terms and conditions apply. This flexibility means your catering can match your wedding's aesthetic rather than working against it. With their expertise, Peach Garden provides a formal and luxurious experience at your selected comfortable venue.

### Making It Work for Your Budget

Here's the practical bit that every couple needs to know. Peach Garden offers seven different buffet menus starting from $25++ per person, whilst sit-down options begin at $108++ per person across six different menu selections.

Of course, as we’ve mentioned in our previous article, Peach Garden understands that modern Singapore couples have diverse needs and preferences. They offer menus with no pork, no lard options, and even completely vegetarian selections. Your Hindu relatives, Muslim friends, and health-conscious cousins can all enjoy the celebration without dietary concerns.

The range of menu options ensures that whether you're feeding 50 people or 200, there's a combination that works for your specific situation.

### Your Perfect Day, Perfected by Peach Garden

Your dream venue shouldn't require compromising on dream-worthy food. Peach Garden Restaurant's external catering service means you can have both the setting that makes your heart sing and the culinary experience that leaves your guests raving for months afterwards.

Sometimes the best wedding decisions are the ones that refuse to accept limitations, and this catering service represents exactly that kind of thinking.

Keen to find out more? Join us at our Wedding Show on 19 July, from 10:30am to 4:00pm at Peach Garden @ The Heeren, and speak with our wedding experts!

# Your Ultimate Wedding Budget Guide

 2024-10-15

![Image 6: Your Ultimate Wedding Budget Guide](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241010/20241010181923_82874.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/vi-vn/anh/dan-ba-ban-ng-i-ti-n-b-c-5900268/)_

Dividing your budget into two main categories – 'For Us' and 'For Guests' – is the first step to creating your wedding budget. The 'For Us' section includes your personal desires, like a dream honeymoon or spending on decorations. The 'For Guests' portion focuses on your guests' experience, including the venue, food, drinks, and favors.

Remaining costs will include fixed expenses such as photography, videography, and attire. Additionally, there are costs for logistics like transportation, labor, lighting, printing, and any other miscellaneous items deemed necessary.

The following wedding budget breakdown provides a general framework for allocating your spending, and it can be adjusted based on each couple's unique needs and priorities.

![Image 7: Your Ultimate Wedding Budget Guide](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241011/20241011160730_43667.jpg)

### Budget Allocation

Before making any decisions, it's crucial to determine the exact amount you can spend on your wedding. To do this, you and your partner should review your savings and decide how much you can save throughout the preparation period leading up to the wedding day.

You may also want to talk to your parents to see if they're willing and able to contribute. Once you have a total amount, it's best to allocate your budget based on a breakdown of wedding expenses, which typically includes ten major categories. Below is a general allocation from Blissful Brides that you can use as a starting point, but you may need to adjust the spending based on your priorities and preferences.

*   **Venue and Catering:** 40% - 50% of the budget
*   **Decorations:** 20% - 30% of the budget
*   **Photography and Videography:** 15% - 20% of the budget
*   **Attire and Makeup:** 10%- 20% of the budget
*   **Invitations and Stationery:** 2%-5% of the budget
*   **Miscellaneous Costs:** You should allocate an additional 20% - 25% of the total budget for a wedding planner, transportation, gifts, and other smaller details.

### Create A Spreadsheet To Track Expenses

You can easily create an Excel or Google Sheets spreadsheet to keep track of all the costs for your big day. Each spreadsheet should include information such as the supplier's contract, the estimated cost, the actual cost, additional service fees, tips, shipping costs, and permit fees for vendors. Don't forget to create a total row and use the auto-sum function for easy updates when entering data.

Additionally, if you have the support of a Wedding Planner from the beginning, they will provide you with a detailed breakdown and help you manage this spreadsheet, ensuring that everything is monitored closely and effectively.

# The Art of creating Seating Chart for your Guests

 2024-10-14

![Image 5: The Art of creating Seating Chart for your Guests](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241010/20241010180147_70918.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/vi-vn/anh/t-m-th-m-tr-ng-2606405/)_

Whether you're a couple planning your big day or a wedding pro, we've got tips for you.This article provides practical solutions and valuable information to help you tackle common challenges, such as seating families and guests easily and efficiently.

Discover how to create a guest list that not only demonstrates your thoughtfulness but also ensures your guests feel welcomed and comfortable. Let's turn your wedding dreams into reality with the art of seating arrangements.

### 1.Arranging the Space with a Suitable Layout

When planning your table arrangement, you should consider the size and shape of the venue, the type of menu, and the overall atmosphere you want to create.

Some of the most popular options include:

●**Long Tables:**Suitable for rectangular spaces or outdoor venues. This layout often creates a relaxed, European-style atmosphere. Decorations can include floral arrangements or candles.

●**Grouped tables:**Typically arranged in a round or even a combination of long and round tables. Grouped tables can create a more formal atmosphere and a sense of intimacy at each table.

●**U-shaped:**This layout is unique and eye-catching, suitable for intimate parties or destination weddings with a smaller guest list.

![Image 6: The Art of creating Seating Chart for your Guests](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241010/20241010180232_52566.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-table-set-up-for-a-formal-dinner-7mJtN0xtCYo)_

### 2. Assigning Seating Arrangements

Once you've finalized the floor plan, it's time to decide on the seating arrangement that best suits your wedding.

Here are a few popular options:

*   **Assigned Tables:** Each table will have a name tag indicating the guest group, such as family, college friends, company ABC, etc. Guests will be directed to a specific table and can then choose their own seat within the available seating.
*   **Pre-assigned Seating by Name:** For smaller, more formal weddings, couples can place personalized name cards and favors at each guest's designated seat. If you choose this option, you can display a seating chart at the entrance and use a table name tag with individual guest names.

**Open Seating:** There is no specific seating arrangement, and guests can freely choose any seat they like. This style is suitable for intimate gatherings of under 30 people and groups who are already well-acquainted. 
![Image 7: The Art of creating Seating Chart for your Guests](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241010/20241010180358_70133.png)

_Source:_ _[Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/happy-birthday-greeting-card-on-brown-wooden-table-yWTqcUpHBWo)_

### 3. Seating Arrangements for the Couple

Traditionally in Vietnamese weddings, the couple doesn't have a designated table. They typically eat before the ceremony rather than dining with guests.

However, with the growing influence of Western-style celebrations, more couples are opting for a private table or a long table to share with their families alongside round tables for guests.

### 4. Special Treatment for VIP Guests

Reserve prime seats near the stage or dance floor for parents or close friends. Their wedding day is special to them too, so their seating should make them feel special and part of the celebration.

![Image 8: The Art of creating Seating Chart for your Guests](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241010/20241010180452_48954.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/vi-vn/anh/dia-g-m-hoa-tr-ng-va-d-tren-khan-tr-i-ban-tr-ng-6479607/)_

### 5. Group guests based on how they know the couple or the parents.

Seating people with similar interests or from the same social circles will help them find common ground for conversation. The couple could seat groups of young friends and colleagues near each other or close to the dance floor, making it easier for these groups to enjoy the party atmosphere.

This also means older guests might prefer to sit farther away from the music but still close enough to enjoy the festivities.

### 6. Seating children

Seating children can be challenging. Couples should consider the age and number of children attending or even specify a child-free policy on the invitations to ensure the best solution. Young children should sit with their parents, while older children, say 10 and up, might prefer a separate table with their friends. If you decide to have a children’s table, include some activities to keep them busy, like coloring or small stuffed animals to cuddle.

To avoid any mishaps, couples should check if the venue offers childcare services or has staff to supervise the younger guests.

### 7. Creating a Refined and Polite Seating Arrangement

The following tips will help you create a more sophisticated and polite seating chart for your guests:

*   **Avoid overcrowding tables.** You want your guests to feel comfortable, not crammed in like sardines! Depending on the size of the table, 10-12 guests per table is usually ideal. Don't forget to leave at least 1.5 meters between tables for serving staff.
*   **Be mindful of special circumstances.** Pay attention to the special needs of your guests to ensure their comfort. Any guests using wheelchairs will need extra space and should be seated at the end of a table. Pregnant women may prefer a seat close to the restroom, while elderly guests may not want to be right next to your band!
*   **Don't stress too much.** Planning seating arrangements can definitely be stressful, but try not to let it overwhelm you. While you should do your best to accommodate your guests, you may also have to accept that you simply can't please everyone.
*   **Go digital.** Instead of using scraps of paper and sticky notes, use an online seating chart tool that you can easily adjust until you find the perfect layout. Our soon-to-be-released **_planning tools_** will help you create a drag-and-drop seating chart that's easy to manipulate. 

![Image 9: The Art of creating Seating Chart for your Guests](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241010/20241010180648_58478.jpg)
_Source:_ _[Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/white-ceramic-dinnerware-set-aEnH4hJ\_Mrs)_

_Blissful Brides would like to reassure couples that the seating arrangement is just a small detail on your special day. We believe that your guests will be understanding and focused on celebrating your love with heartfelt wishes._

With an eclectic range of available resources on our portal, we hope that couples can enjoy an enjoyable and stress-free experience when arranging their wedding. In the wedding planning industry, Blissful Brides has gained more than 20 years of experience, thus forming a solid connection with our excellent vendors. We have many different wedding vendors you can hire, each offering variety of jewellery, venues, restaurants, and dresses options. 

 Our wedding vendors are arranged according to their provided services, allowing couples to find the resources they need quickly. All you need is to enter a particular category you are looking at to discover the range of wedding vendors in that particular category. Many of those featured on our portal has been in this industry for a long time, and have earned themselves a solid reputation. Any couple who chooses either one can rest assured that they are in good hands. Couples can also better plan their wedding with the vendors’ professional assistance. Apart from the guide to different vendors available in Singapore, our website also features wedding deals that help couples keep to their set budget when planning their wedding. 

 For couples in Singapore that need more resources when planning their wedding, Blissful Brides has a magazine that will surely help any couple plan their perfect wedding. It is filled with gorgeous pictures and informative articles; couples can get lots of inspiration from browsing through. Besides our magazine, couples can also find the resources they need by looking through our website. We have many entertaining and informative articles ranging that helps couples find solutions to different problems, from financial management, relationships, and beauty and wellness. 

 Apart from our wedding planning guides, Blissful Brides is also known for being the Blissful Outdoor Wedding Shows (BOWS) organiser. Held three times a year, the highly anticipated wedding show is lined up with many exciting programmes. There are numerous deals and discounts that couples can find from the variety of exceptional wedding planners. Being one of Singapore’s most prominent events, couples can enjoy unbeatable convenience when visiting the wedding show. Besides superb deals, couples will also receive awesome door gifts and are able to win attractive prizes during the event. 

 Blissful Brides is without a doubt a one-stop guide to all the resources you need in Singapore to plan your wedding. You may send any enquiries you might have via the “Contact Us” page for any questions. Our friendly and professional team will be happy to assist you as much as they can.

### Our Services

At Paradox Singapore, every wedding is a beautifully orchestrated celebration of love, legacy, and personal story.

Our newly reimagined ballroom, located conveniently on the lobby level, blends architectural grandeur with contemporary elegance. With soaring 5.5-metre ceilings and expansive floor-to-ceiling windows, the space is bathed in natural daylight and styled for unforgettable moments. An impressive 21-metre wall-to-wall LED screen transforms your wedding visuals into cinematic splendour.

Adjacent to the ballroom, our private foyer offers a stylish setting for pre-dinner cocktails or welcome receptions. For couples seeking a unique alfresco touch, our riverside gazebo sets the stage for a serene outdoor solemnisation, framed by tranquil views of the Singapore River. Your guests will enjoy the serenity of our urban oasis conveniently located in the heart of the city.

From exquisite cuisine prepared by our dedicated wedding culinary team to seamless service delivered by experienced planners, every detail is thoughtfully curated to ensure your big day is as effortless as it is extraordinary.

# Paradox Singapore Merchant Court: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025

 2025-05-07

Vendor:[Paradox Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/9/hotels/detail/1127/psmc-clarke-quay)

![Image 5: Paradox Singapore Merchant Court: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250507/20250507103729_43170.jpg)

Among this year’s standout venues, **_Paradox Singapore Merchant Court_**has earned one of our coveted _Editor’s Choice Awards for Banquet Venue_— and for good reasons. While Singapore has no shortage of elegant hotel ballrooms, few manage to balance architectural grandeur, culinary finesse, and effortless hospitality with the same precision as this urban resort.

### A Ballroom Designed to Impress

![Image 6: Paradox Singapore Merchant Court: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250507/20250507103840_58183.jpg)

At Paradox Singapore, the newly transformed Merchant Court Ballroom sets a new standard for wedding venues. Located at lobby level, this exclusive, pillar-less ballroom features soaring six-metre ceilings and sweeping floor-to-ceiling windows — a rare touch that fills the space with natural light and elegance that is highly sought-after feature for in-door weddings.

The adjoining private foyer isn’t just functional, but an elegant space in its own right, ideal for welcome drinks, photo ops or an exclusive cocktail reception. Accommodating 200 to 440 guests with ease, the venue balances grandeur with thoughtful design, ensuring every guest enjoys an unobstructed view and spacious comfort. Whether you're planning an opulent celebration or a more intimate affair, this award-nominated ballroom delivers a seamless, sophisticated experience from start to finish.

### A Riverside Retreat in the Heart of the City

![Image 7: Paradox Singapore Merchant Court: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250507/20250507103953_43757.jpg)

Paradox Singapore offers the luxury of tranquillity in a central location. Nestled along the Singapore River and just steps from Clarke Quay MRT, it seamlessly blends urban convenience with resort-like charm.

With direct sheltered access and proximity to key city attractions, guests enjoy effortless arrivals—yet feel worlds away amid the hotel’s serene surroundings. A lush pool terrace, tranquil spa, and landscaped spaces create an urban sanctuary that slows the city’s pace.

For wedding couples and their guests, this harmonious balance of vibrancy and calm is an understated indulgence that elevates the entire celebration.

### Say “I Do” With a View

![Image 8: Paradox Singapore Merchant Court: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250507/20250507104047_22321.jpg)

Outdoor solemnisation in the city rarely feels this private. Tucked on level two, the poolside gazebo at Paradox Singapore Merchant Court overlooks the scenic Singapore River, offering an elevated alfresco setting that feels both intimate and refined.

Framed by lush greenery and away from the city bustle, it’s a hidden gem that delivers quiet sophistication — the perfect backdrop for a truly memorable “I do.”

### Exceptional Service, Thoughtfully Delivered

![Image 9: Paradox Singapore Merchant Court: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250507/20250507104136_69831.jpg)

At Paradox Singapore, great service means anticipating every need with thoughtful consideration. The dedicated wedding team works closely with each couple to personalise every detail—from bespoke menus crafted by the in-house culinary team to tailored packages that reflect individual preferences.

Whether it’s refined Cantonese cuisine or globally inspired fare, menu flexibility is matched with thoughtful perks like free-flow beverages, dining credits, and complimentary stays for the wedding entourage.

It’s effortless, attentive service—executed with precision and heart.

### A Stay That’s Effortlessly Indulgent

![Image 10: Paradox Singapore Merchant Court: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250507/20250507104221_14994.jpg)

With 476 thoughtfully designed rooms and suites in sleek, modern tones, Paradox Singapore ensures every part of the wedding experience is well considered — not just the celebration itself. Many rooms offer tranquil views of the Singapore River, paired with understated comforts that make each stay feel like a true escape.

Guests in Executive Rooms and Suites enjoy exclusive access to the Executive Lounge, where complimentary refreshments provide a welcome pick-me-up for loved ones joining the festivities.

On the dining front, the acclaimed Ellenborough Market Café delights with authentic Peranakan flavours, while Blue Potato and Crossroads Bar offer stylish settings for pre-wedding toasts or relaxed post-event catch ups. At sunset, riverside alfresco dining sets the scene for memories beyond the ceremony.

### Paradox Singapore Merchant Court: An Exceptional Stunning Venue

![Image 11: Paradox Singapore Merchant Court: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250507/20250507104310_67591.jpg)

**Paradox Singapore**does what a great wedding venue should do: beautifully designed spaces, delightful cuisine , intuitive service and an unforgettable setting.up. It’s equal parts graceful and grounded, and it has the rare ability to suit different tastes without losing its identity.

That’s why we at _Blissful Brides_ have no hesitation in awarding it one of our _Editor’s Choice Awards for Banquet Venue_. It earned it.

It is filled with gorgeous pictures and informative articles; couples can get lots of inspiration from browsing through. Besides our magazine, couples can also find the resources they need by looking through our website. We have many entertaining and informative articles ranging that helps couples find solutions to different problems, from financial management, relationships, and beauty and wellness. 

 Apart from our wedding planning guides, Blissful Brides is also known for being the Blissful Outdoor Wedding Shows (BOWS) organiser. Held three times a year, the highly anticipated wedding show is lined up with many exciting programmes. There are numerous deals and discounts that couples can find from the variety of exceptional wedding planners. Being one of Singapore’s most prominent events, couples can enjoy unbeatable convenience when visiting the wedding show. Besides superb deals, couples will also receive awesome door gifts and are able to win attractive prizes during the event. 

 Blissful Brides is without a doubt a one-stop guide to all the resources you need in Singapore to plan your wedding. You may send any enquiries you might have via the “Contact Us” page for any questions. Our friendly and professional team will be happy to assist you as much as they can. 

 We look forward to helping you with your wedding planning through our resources.

# Weddings, Rewritten: Plan Less, Celebrate More at Novotel Singapore on Stevens

 2025-06-18

Vendor:[Novotel Singapore on Stevens](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/9/hotels/detail/777/novotel-singapore-on-stevens-)

![Image 6: Weddings, Rewritten: Plan Less, Celebrate More at Novotel Singapore on Stevens](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250617/20250617101335_58303.jpg)

If you’re after a wedding venue that delivers elegance, charm, and a little magic without the fuss, **Novotel Singapore on Stevens**might just be what you’re looking for. Hidden just off the bustle of Orchard Road, this modern urban retreat offers a surprising blend of grandeur and ease, perfect for couples who want their day to feel exceptional and effortlessly theirs.

### Spaces That Sparkle, Indoors and Out

![Image 7: Weddings, Rewritten: Plan Less, Celebrate More at Novotel Singapore on Stevens](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250617/20250617101522_43335.jpg)

The hotel’s wedding venues are refreshingly versatile. Indoors, you’ll find spacious, pillarless ballrooms with themes such as those inspired by the constellations; think twinkling lights and high ceilings that create the kind of atmosphere where both fairy tales and dance-offs can unfold comfortably. The largest of these spaces can seat up to 300 guests banquet-style.

![Image 8: Weddings, Rewritten: Plan Less, Celebrate More at Novotel Singapore on Stevens](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250617/20250617101717_39616.jpg)

Prefer an alfresco celebration? The lush outdoor terraces offer a breezy alternative. These garden-style spaces can host up to 120 guests and provide a scenic, resort-like backdrop that’s both romantic and relaxed. Bonus: they’re pet-friendly, so your dog, cat, or curious rabbit can make a red-carpet appearance too.

### Ambience With Personality

![Image 9: Weddings, Rewritten: Plan Less, Celebrate More at Novotel Singapore on Stevens](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250617/20250617101735_28597.jpg)

There’s a quiet confidence to how the venue is styled. The indoor ballrooms echo the Milky Way, giving a subtle nod to the celestial without tipping into the theatrical. Outdoors, it’s all about greenery and serenity. Whether you want something refined or whimsical, there’s enough character here to serve as a meaningful backdrop without trying to steal the show.

You’ll also want to arrive early just to explore the photoshoot potential. The Golden Stairs glow with soft light and look like something out of an editorial spread. The secret garden is ideal for those dreamy, stolen-moment shots, and La Terrasse delivers the kind of elegant, airy charm that will make your photographer quietly thank you. And of course, the Milky Way ballroom, with its glowing ambience, wraps the whole thing in a little stardust.

### Good Food and Service That Gets it

Menus here go well beyond hotel-standard fare. Wedding packages span Chinese set menus with up to nine courses, individually plated meals for intimate groups, or tailored Indian menus that honour tradition without skimping on flair. You’ll have a tasting with up to 10 guests, and the culinary team works closely with each couple to adjust flavour profiles, presentation, and that all-important dessert table.

As for service, from the moment you book, the events team jumps in with the kind of support that’s both proactive and unobtrusive. Wedding planners here are known for getting the brief quickly, tweaking details with precision, and managing the actual day without breathing down anyone’s neck. It’s the kind of behind-the-scenes mastery that makes you feel like everything just happened naturally, because they made sure it did.

### Packages That Feel Personal

![Image 10: Weddings, Rewritten: Plan Less, Celebrate More at Novotel Singapore on Stevens](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250617/20250617101803_92033.jpg)

There’s nothing cookie-cutter about the wedding packages. Options range from the full-glam Galactical Wedding, to the more relaxed Nova package for intimate affairs. There’s even a Timeless Serenade package for Indian weddings that combines cultural warmth with hotel polish. Every package includes its share of thoughtful perks, such as bridal suite stays, drinks, décor, and various waivers.

Guests also get special room rates, and you’ll receive parking coupons for up to 20% of your confirmed guest count. The bridal suite includes private breakfast and access to the Premier Lounge, which is stocked with free-flow drinks and elegant snacks. And with regards to décor themes, there are a variety of celestial-inspired options for you to choose from, such as ‘Stardust and Dreams’ and the like. Just the right amount of poetic, we think.

### Celebrate Your Big Day with Novotel Singapore on Stevens

Dates here are snapped up quickly, particularly during peak wedding season, so booking six to twelve months ahead is recommended. That said, if you’ve got flexibility, the team is known to go the extra mile to make last-minute dreams happen too.

In short, we think that **Novotel Singapore on Stevens**delivers more than just a backdrop, but a feeling. That feeling of walking into a space and knowing it fits. That feeling of being looked after without needing to ask twice.

It’s about comfort, style, and a quiet confidence that everything will go exactly the way it should.

Please extend our heartfelt thanks to every member of your team who played a role in making the banquet so special. We are truly grateful.

Celebrate your love embraced by the serenity of nature at Equarius Hotel. The elegant ballroom opens to tranquil forest views, while the Saffron Room is bathed in soft daylight and greenery.  Ocean Gallery – A Magical Underwater Soirée

Perfect for couples who dream of a celebration that is as extraordinary as their love.

 ⸻

 Resorts World Ballroom & Function Rooms – Grand & Timeless

Begin your happily-ever-after in the majestic Resorts World Ballroom, where soaring ceilings and a grand foyer set the stage for your unforgettable entrance. For more intimate yet elegant celebrations, our stylish column-free function rooms provide the perfect setting to gather with your nearest and dearest. Whether with a traditional banquet or a modern dinner, our culinary team will ensure your guests are indulged in every detail.

 Your Love, Your Celebration

### Our Services

Where Your Forever Begins ✨

Every love story is unique — and so is the way you choose to celebrate it. At Resorts World Sentosa, we offer a collection of extraordinary venues, each with its own charm, to bring your dream wedding to life. Whether you imagine saying “I do” surrounded by nature’s beauty, beneath the spellbinding ocean, or in a ballroom of timeless grandeur, our team is here to create moments that are as unforgettable as your love.

 ⸻

 Equarius Hotel – Romance in Nature

Celebrate your love embraced by the serenity of nature at Equarius Hotel. The elegant ballroom opens to tranquil forest views, while the Saffron Room is bathed in soft daylight and greenery. For intimate and whimsical moments, the Glass Pavilion and Lawn provide a garden setting perfect for an alfresco celebration. With menus crafted thoughtfully in line with our ecological commitment, you and your guests can savour a feast that is both meaningful and memorable.

 ⸻

 Ocean Gallery – A Magical Underwater Soirée

Step into a world of wonder and exchange vows in the presence of 40,000 marine animals at the Ocean Gallery. Nestled within the Singapore Oceanarium, this one-of-a-kind setting offers a truly magical backdrop where every glance feels timeless and every photograph tells a story. Perfect for couples who dream of a celebration that is as extraordinary as their love.

 ⸻

 Resorts World Ballroom & Function Rooms – Grand & Timeless

Begin your happily-ever-after in the majestic Resorts World Ballroom, where soaring ceilings and a grand foyer set the stage for your unforgettable entrance. For more intimate yet elegant celebrations, our stylish column-free function rooms provide the perfect setting to gather with your nearest and dearest. Whether with a traditional banquet or a modern dinner, our culinary team will ensure your guests are indulged in every detail.

 ⸻

 Your Love, Your Celebration

At Resorts World Sentosa, we believe your wedding should be nothing less than extraordinary. Whichever setting you choose, our dedicated Wedding Consultants will walk with you every step of the way, ensuring your special day is filled with beauty, joy, and cherished memories to last a lifetime.

# Simply Yours: Celebration at PARKROYAL on Beach Road

 2025-05-06

Vendor:[PARKROYAL on Beach Road](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/9/hotels/detail/495/parkroyal-on-beach-road)

![Image 5: Simply Yours: Celebration at PARKROYAL on Beach Road](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250506/20250506111642_76751.jpg)

Planning a wedding is stressful enough without having to worry about whether the venue will actually live up to expectations. At PARKROYAL on Beach Road, you won’t have that problem. Located in the heart of Bugis, this elegant venue makes celebrating your big day as seamless as it is stylish. Read on for more.

### The Perfect Setting, Whatever Your Style

![Image 6: Simply Yours: Celebration at PARKROYAL on Beach Road](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250506/20250506111712_51488.jpg)

Whether you're after a lavish banquet or an intimate ROM ceremony, PARKROYAL on Beach Road has a space to match. The Sky Ballroom, bathed in natural daylight through floor-to-ceiling windows, offers a picturesque setting with views of the city and Nicoll Highway. For a more private atmosphere, the windows can be screened to create an intimate mood.

![Image 7: Simply Yours: Celebration at PARKROYAL on Beach Road](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250506/20250506111739_87345.jpg)

Hosting a grand celebration? The pillarless Grand Ballroom provides a spacious and sophisticated setting, accommodating up to 460 guests. Both ballrooms feature soaring ceilings, intelligent moving headlights, and full-length LED screens — so your love story gets the blockbuster treatment it deserves. The Grand Ballroom accommodates a minimum of 25 tables, while the Sky Ballroom requires at least 16 tables, making both spaces ideal for weddings of varying sizes.

### Stress Less, Celebrate More

![Image 8: Simply Yours: Celebration at PARKROYAL on Beach Road](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250506/20250506111806_50511.jpg)

No one wants their wedding to feel like a corporate event. That’s where PARKROYAL’s Celebration Curators come in, guiding you through every detail, from planning to execution. The culinary experience is equally impressive — Master Chef Chong from Hong Kong crafts exquisite Cantonese dishes with a unique twist, ensuring your guests leave raving about the food. Plus, with customisable options for Chinese and ethnic weddings, your cultural traditions will be seamlessly woven into the experience.

![Image 9: Simply Yours: Celebration at PARKROYAL on Beach Road](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250506/20250506111825_97074.jpg)

Beyond the wedding day, PARKROYAL’s wedding packages include a luxurious stay in a PARKROYAL Suite Room (dinner) or PARKROYAL Club Premier Room with full club benefits and a spa treatment for two, offering a relaxing retreat before or after your wedding. Additionally, couples can enjoy a one-night stay for their anniversary celebration — because celebrations should last beyond just one day.

![Image 10: Simply Yours: Celebration at PARKROYAL on Beach Road](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250506/20250506111843_73209.jpg)

### Themes to Match Your Dream

![Image 11: Simply Yours: Celebration at PARKROYAL on Beach Road](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250506/20250506111903_48010.jpg)

Décor makes all the difference, and PARKROYAL on Beach Road offers three stunning wedding themes to suit every couple’s style. ‘Iridescent Fantasy’ creates a dreamlike ambience with soft pastel hues, ‘Blushing Beauty’ radiates romance with peach and pastel pink tones, and ‘Botanical Love’ brings lush greenery into the mix for an effortlessly elegant touch. Each theme includes carefully curated floral arrangements and styling elements, taking the stress out of choosing the perfect aesthetic.

![Image 12: Simply Yours: Celebration at PARKROYAL on Beach Road](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250506/20250506111920_65865.jpg)

Besides your wedding album deserves more than an ordinary backdrop. The venue’s grand LED backdrops and high ceilings create a dramatic, elegant setting for photos, while the poolside area and warmly lit lobby offer more intimate, relaxed options.

### Secure Your Dream Venue at PARKROYAL on Beach Road

To secure your ideal date, booking at least a year in advance is recommended — good venues fill up fast. Keep an eye out for seasonal promotions, which can include cash rebates and exclusive perks.

Your wedding isn’t just another event on the calendar, and **PARKROYAL on Beach Road**isn’t just another venue. By providing a seamless and stress-free wedding experience, they’ll ensure that your wedding day is Simply Yours, down to the last perfect detail.

Being one of Singapore’s most prominent events, couples can enjoy unbeatable convenience when visiting the wedding show. Besides superb deals, couples will also receive awesome door gifts and are able to win attractive prizes during the event.

### Our Services

At**Eternal Love Weddings**, we are dedicated to offering a diverse and inclusive collection of wedding dresses that cater to every bride's unique taste, body type, and vision for her special day. Our collection is thoughtfully curated to ensure that we have something for everyone—whether you’re looking for a classic, romantic look, a modern twist, or something that truly expresses your individuality. Our focus is not only on how brides and grooms look but also on how they feel, ensuring that every moment is as breathtaking as the gown itself. We strive to make every couple feel celebrated, cherished, and confident on their special day. At **Eternal Love Weddings**, we also honor and preserve the rich traditions of Chinese weddings. We proudly support the wearing of traditional Chinese wedding attire, including the Qun Kua for the bride and Ma Gua for the groom, embracing the deep cultural significance of these garments. Our team is dedicated to sharing Chinese customs and practices with couples, ensuring that their celebration is not only beautiful but deeply meaningful. # Wedding Planner and Why Do You Need Them?

 2024-10-06

![Image 5: Wedding Planner and Why Do You Need Them?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241010/20241010160902_68362.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/vi-vn/anh/ng-i-dan-ong-m-c-ao-tr-ng-phia-tr-c-ng-i-ph-n-m-c-ao-dai-tay-mau-xanh-1181715/)_

Wedding planners handle all the details and keep track of everything you might not think of, ensuring your wedding runs smoothly and stress-free. Join Blissful Brides Vietnam as we explore the benefits of hiring a wedding expert.

Most wedding planners offer various levels of involvement in your planning process:

**Day-of Coordination:** Perfect for couples who have done most of the planning but need someone to execute their vision on the big day..

**Partial Planning:** If you need help with specific aspects of your wedding planning or have started but need someone to finish, this is the option for you.

**Full Service Planning:** For couples who want complete support from start to finish, full-service planning is the way to go.

![Image 6: Wedding Planner and Why Do You Need Them?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241010/20241010160942_96826.jpg)
_Source:_ _[Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/mr-and-mrs-signage-gnm2op0m2pw)_

### 1.Saving time for the couple

One of the primary reasons couples hire wedding planners is to save time and effort throughout the planning process and on the wedding day itself. On average, planning a wedding can take over 200 hours or more.

From selecting venues to managing and coordinating vendors, professional wedding planners handle all the heavy lifting, allowing you and your partner to focus on other things—like enjoying that post-engagement glow!

Even if it's just six months or even seven days before your wedding, hiring a wedding planner is worth it when you consider the time you'll save.

Wedding planners are often industry insiders with years of experience working with vendors. This means they know the industry and exactly what needs to be done at each stage of the planning process.

### 2.Managing budgets and negotiating costs

With a wedding planner on your side, you can rest assured that your money will be spent wisely to bring your vision to life.

Wedding planners often have a pre-established network of preferred vendors. This not only helps them select the best vendors for your big day but can also lead to discounted rates.

Without a wedding planner, you'll have to do all the legwork yourself and may end up choosing subpar vendors, leading to budget overruns.

 Of course, you'll need to factor in the cost of hiring a wedding planner, so it's important to be upfront about this expense in your wedding budget. 
![Image 7: Wedding Planner and Why Do You Need Them?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241010/20241010161048_65143.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/vi-vn/anh/ng-i-l-p-k-ho-ch-va-gi-y-t-811572/)_

### 3.Becoming your trusted advisor

A skilled wedding planner is well-versed in the wedding industry. They know exactly which venues align with your wedding size, budget, and desired atmosphere. They also have a knack for matching couples with the perfect decor styles and vendors to ensure a seamless event.

Wedding planning can often cause stress between couples and their families. Wedding planners are skilled at mediating these situations and acting as a neutral third party to avoid conflict, find common ground, and provide optimal solutions.

### 4.Ensuring nothing is overlooked

When planning a wedding, wedding planners anticipate potential challenges and offer solutions. They handle all the small details that others might miss, such as creating contingency plans, developing a detailed timeline, and ensuring you have everything you need on your big day, down to the last bobby pin.

With so many things to consider, it's a relief to have a wedding planner who remembers everything.

### 5.Acting as your direct contact and up-to-date event updates

A wedding planner will be your primary contact with all vendors on your big day, allowing you to relax and enjoy your special day.

Wedding planners pay attention to the small details that could go wrong and ensure everything is handled promptly, from flowers arriving late to dealing with last-minute weather changes.

![Image 8: Wedding Planner and Why Do You Need Them?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241010/20241010161156_49099.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/vi-vn/anh/c-t-cac-b-n-gai-da-d-ng-vi-t-trong-sach-bai-t-p-5537545/)_

They handle everything smoothly and keep the event running seamlessly, so you don't have to worry about a thing. Unexpected incidents can happen at any time, but with a wedding planner, you'll have a team to handle it effectively.

When it comes to your big day, hiring a wedding planning team is a great idea as they can help bring your vision to life, avoid costly mistakes, and ensure everything is taken care of.

_Blissful Brides provides a list of reputable wedding planners across Vietnam, along with a variety of service packages to help couples enjoy their special day to the fullest._

### Our Services

Beyond its melodious allure, Twilight Weddings @Stevens weaves visions of a fairy-tale realm, where love stories blossom amidst a breathtaking panorama, enriching the romantic tapestry. # Novotel Singapore on Stevens: Editor's Choice for Banquet Venue 2025

 2025-02-21

Vendor:[Novotel Singapore on Stevens](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/9/hotels/detail/777/novotel-singapore-on-stevens-)

![Image 6: Novotel Singapore on Stevens: Editor's Choice for Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250219/20250219101045_12330.jpg)

When it comes to wedding venues, few manage to strike the perfect balance between breathtaking design, seamless service, and unforgettable experiences. **Novotel Singapore on Stevens**, located near Orchard Road, is one such gem. For us at _Blissful Brides_, this remarkable hotel has redefined what it means to host a truly magical wedding — and that’s why we’ve awarded Novotel Singapore on Stevens our Editor’s Choice award for Banquet Venues.

But what makes Novotel Singapore on Stevens stand out in a city brimming with luxury options? Read on to see why this venue has captured the hearts of couples and earned its well-deserved accolades.

### A Venue Where Elegance Meets Enchantment

![Image 7: Novotel Singapore on Stevens: Editor's Choice for Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250219/20250219101058_16426.jpg)

There’s no doubt about it — Novotel Singapore on Stevens creates an atmosphere where love stories come alive. The hotel’s signature concept, **Twilight Weddings @ Stevens**, transforms every celebration into a dreamscape. Inspired by the ephemeral beauty of twilight, the theme combines soft, romantic hues with a celestial glow, creating an ethereal setting that feels both intimate and grand. _Twilight Weddings_ manages the almost impossible, inspiring a sense of fleeting beauty and thereby symbolising the timeless nature of love.

Here, couples and their guests are treated to a venue that brings the allure of a fairy-tale realm to life, blending the elegance of modern architecture with lush natural surroundings. Whether it’s an outdoor ceremony framed by greenery or an indoor reception in a refined yet inviting space, the venues at Novotel Singapore on Stevens provide the ideal canvas for your love story, framed by nature’s beauty and twilight’s serene charm.

![Image 8: Novotel Singapore on Stevens: Editor's Choice for Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250219/20250219101122_18101.jpg)

No two love stories are the same, and at Novotel Singapore on Stevens, no two weddings are either. The _Twilight Weddings_ concept offers endless thematic interpretations, allowing couples to shape their day exactly as they envision. Whether the vibe is whimsical and romantic, celestial and mythical, or a bespoke combination of the two, this venue’s versatility ensures that each wedding is a true reflection of the couple's style.

From delicate floral arrangements to custom lighting that bathes the space in twilight’s soft glow, every element can be tailored to create a one-of-a-kind experience.

### Award-Winning Culinary Experiences

But what’s a wedding without remarkable food? Novotel Singapore on Stevens brings gastronomic excellence to the table, ensuring that every meal is as memorable as the celebration itself. Their team of chefs crafts menus that cater to diverse tastes, offering both local and international cuisines of the highest quality. Couples are even invited to personalised menu tastings, ensuring the final spread is a perfect fit for their preferences and the occasion.

The dining experience here is not just a feast for the palate but also for the senses, with presentation and flavours that leave a lasting impression on every guest.

### Flawless Service, Seamlessly Delivered

![Image 9: Novotel Singapore on Stevens: Editor's Choice for Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250219/20250219101210_45798.jpg)

Behind the scenes, the dedicated wedding team at Novotel Singapore on Stevens works tirelessly to ensure every detail is flawlessly executed. From the initial planning stages to the final moments of the celebration, they’re on hand to guide couples through the process, offering expert advice and solutions to bring their vision to life.

This team’s ability to turn ideas into reality and solve challenges with ease has earned Novotel Singapore on Stevens a reputation for reliability and excellence. The result is a wedding day where everything flows smoothly, and couples can revel in the joy of the moment without distraction.

### The Perfect Stage for New Beginnings: Novotel Singapore on Stevens

![Image 10: Novotel Singapore on Stevens: Editor's Choice for Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250219/20250219101236_36396.jpg)

At Novotel Singapore on Stevens, a wedding is a transformative experience that lingers in the hearts of couples and their guests long after the day has passed. The hotel’s combination of innovative themes, flawless execution, and culinary artistry has earned it our Editor's Choice Award for 'Banquet Venues.'

For couples looking to write the opening chapter of their marriage in a venue that feels entirely their own, **Novotel Singapore on Stevens** offers a backdrop that inspires and impresses.

Your love story deserves nothing less than a setting as extraordinary as this.

# Film Vs Digital Photography For Weddings – Is Film Dead?

 2025-06-23

![Image 6: Film Vs Digital Photography For Weddings – Is Film Dead?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250612/20250612160212_28519.jpg)

You’ve probably heard the phrase “film is dead” thrown around for years now. In the age of smartphones, mirrorless cameras, and high-speed editing, it’s easy to believe that film photography belongs in a dusty photo album from the '90s. But is it really gone for good?

What if you're someone who appreciates the grainy, nostalgic magic of film? Maybe you're even a film enthusiast yourself, with a collection of vintage cameras tucked away. Now that your big day is coming up, you might be wondering: can you still incorporate film into your wedding photography? Is it possible to blend the timeless charm of film with the precision and convenience of digital? Let’s explore.

### The Charm of Film Photography

![Image 7: Film Vs Digital Photography For Weddings – Is Film Dead?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250612/20250612160436_67547.jpg)

Film photography carries an emotional weight that’s hard to explain until you’ve held a developed print in your hands. There’s something undeniably romantic about its warm tones, soft focus, and grainy texture, perfect for a day as sentimental as your wedding. For couples who appreciate the artistry of photography, film can offer a unique, dream-like aesthetic that digital sometimes struggles to replicate without heavy editing.

Film also encourages a slower, more intentional approach. Photographers using film tend to be more thoughtful with every frame, capturing raw, fleeting moments that feel organic rather than staged. It’s ideal for couples who value authenticity and the little details, like the squeeze of a hand, the laughter between kisses, or the tears you didn’t realise were falling during the vows.

### The Advantages of Digital Photography

![Image 8: Film Vs Digital Photography For Weddings – Is Film Dead?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250612/20250612160448_57731.jpg)

On the flip side, digital photography dominates the wedding industry for good reason. It's fast, versatile, and incredibly reliable. Photographers can shoot hundreds, even thousands of images without worrying about running out of film. Images can be instantly reviewed and adjusted for lighting, composition, or even reshot on the spot. In a fast-paced wedding environment, that flexibility can be a game changer.

Digital photos are also much easier to edit and deliver. Most [wedding photography packages in Singapore](https://deals.blissfulbrides.sg/product/wedding-photoshoot-packages-jt-studio-sg/ "Wedding Photography Packages, Singapore Wedding Photography Packages") now include post-processing services where photographers can enhance colours, retouch blemishes, and create a polished final product. For couples who want a modern, clean look or a variety of styles in one album, digital photography makes that possible.

### So, Is Film Dead?

![Image 9: Film Vs Digital Photography For Weddings – Is Film Dead?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250612/20250612160505_21181.jpg)

Far from it. While it's no longer mainstream, film photography is enjoying a quiet revival, especially among couples looking for something distinctive. Many wedding photographers in Singapore now offer hybrid services, combining the best of both film and digital. That means you can still have the timeless beauty of film for your ceremony and portraits while relying on digital for the fast-paced reception and group shots.

It’s also worth noting that film has become a kind of artistic statement. Choosing to include it in your wedding shows that you're not just ticking boxes but making deliberate choices about how you want to remember your day. It's a throwback, yes, but also a step forward into a more meaningful form of storytelling.

### Things to Consider Before Choosing Film

![Image 10: Film Vs Digital Photography For Weddings – Is Film Dead?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250612/20250612160520_28608.jpg)

Film photography isn’t without its quirks, and it helps to go in with your eyes open. For one, film rolls are limited. Your photographer can’t shoot endlessly like they can with a digital camera. Each frame counts, which can either be a blessing (more thoughtful shots) or a limitation (fewer photos overall).

Developing film also takes time. If you're hoping for same-week previews or next-day sneak peeks, you might be in for a wait. It's important to discuss timelines with your photographer ahead of time, so expectations are clear. Additionally, film photographers often charge a premium due to the cost of film rolls, processing, and specialised skills. So, if you're working within a tight budget, you’ll need to weigh up whether it’s worth the extra expense.

That said, many couples feel the emotional payoff is well worth it. If you’re after wedding photos that look like they came from a timeless romance movie, film could be your perfect match.

The good news? You don’t have to choose just one. Many couples are opting for a hybrid approach to get the best of both worlds. Film for artistic shots, like bridal portraits, candid pre-ceremony moments, or romantic couple sessions, and digital for everything else.

When exploring wedding photography packages in Singapore, ask whether photographers offer film or hybrid options. Some may even have second shooters dedicated to film, ensuring you get a mix of styles without missing any key moments.

And remember, you can always [choose the right package](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/trending/how-to-choose-the-right-wedding-photography-package "How To Choose The Right Wedding Photography Package") for wedding photography that suits your vision, whether you're going full digital, film-only, or blending both. The important thing is to communicate clearly with your photographer about what you want your final album to feel like.

The decision ultimately comes down to your personal style, priorities, and budget. If you’re someone who swoons over vintage aesthetics and wants a tactile, almost tangible quality to your photos, film is a beautiful choice. If you value efficiency, variety, and a crisp, polished finish, digital might be more your speed. And if you love both? That’s completely okay. You’re allowed to be sentimental and practical. Your wedding is one of the most important days of your life, so you deserve photography that reflects you.

### Bringing Your Vision to Life

![Image 11: Film Vs Digital Photography For Weddings – Is Film Dead?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250612/20250612160533_61965.jpg)

Whether you're drawn to the nostalgic feel of film or the modern elegance of digital, your wedding photos should tell your story in the most authentic way possible. Explore different styles, review photographers’ portfolios, and, most importantly, trust your gut.

Need help finding a photographer who gets your vision? Blissful Brides connects couples with talented wedding professionals across Singapore. Join us for our exclusive wedding show on 4th & 5th October! As a prime hilltop destination wedding venue, Mount Faber Peak is thrilled to host our very own in-house showcase. This is your opportunity to explore our stunning spaces and make your dream day a reality.

Admission is free, and we’ve made sure to add a little something extra. RSVP to enjoy a complimentary cable car ride to our venue, cocktails at Mirabilis Bar, and fun activities like a mini gown try-on, bridal makeup trial, and a photo booth.

Plus, you’ll unlock special promotions and perks. Confirm your booking on the day of the show and receive:

*    A complimentary hotel stay 
*    An outdoor solemnisation 
*    10 additional guests (min 100pax for The Ballroom) 
*    A free groom suit rental 

Don't miss out—RSVP today: [https://bit.ly/4genY6l](https://bit.ly/4genY6l)
