# A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel

 2025-03-19

![Image 6: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151235_83592.jpg)

Located along Singapore's iconic shopping beltstands a landmark that has witnessed countless love stories unfold within its walls — each one as unique as the couples themselves.

Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel's distinctive octagonal pagoda-inspired architecture makes it instantly recognisable on the Orchard Road skyline. While its exterior may be familiar to many, it's what happens inside that transforms this urban retreat into a canvas for extraordinary celebrations. Here, amidst the bustling city, couples will find a sanctuary where their unique vision comes alive through attention and meticulous detail.

If that sounds right up your alley, then read on to find out more.

### A Wedding Venue Like No Other

![Image 7: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151305_59700.jpg)

The hotel boasts 12 versatile spaces that can accommodate celebrations ranging from intimate gatherings of 30 guests to grand affairs with up to 500 guests.

For couples seeking a more intimate setting, The Gallery on Level 2 offers a charming venue that can host up to 140 guests. Its rustic wedding theme, decorated with coral and chestnut orange hues of lilies, roses, poppies, and stunning fairy lights, creates a warm and inviting atmosphere for your celebration.

At the centre of their offering, however, is the stunning Grand Ballroom, a magnificent space featuring a glittering 5-metre alabaster marble ceiling that overlooks 7,600 square feet of pillarless space. This design creates an uninterrupted view of your celebration, ensuring every guest feels connected to your special moment.

### Personalised Themes to Match Your Vision

What sets Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel apart is their collection of six enchanting wedding themes, each meticulously designed to bring specific wedding dreams to life.

**Blissful Grandeur**: An ethereal display of roses, hydrangeas, and eucalyptus creates a romantic ambience filled with rustic-chic and autumn colour palettes.

![Image 8: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151343_14288.jpg)![Image 9: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151355_52477.jpg)

**Blooms of Love**: A minimalist yet modern theme, surrounded by delicate champagne eustomas, peach and blush pink roses for couples who appreciate elegant simplicity.

![Image 10: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151414_97923.jpg)![Image 11: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151424_30897.jpg)

**Elegant Scarlet**: Adorned with peonies and red roses symbolising love, commitment, and happiness, this theme transforms your wedding ceremony with bold, passionate colours.

![Image 12: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151442_32891.jpg)![Image 13: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151452_36030.jpg)

**Enchanted Wonderland**: Enter a magical forest world where baby's breath, sweet pink roses, and candlelight create a whimsical setting for two hearts to become one.

![Image 14: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151509_49159.jpg)![Image 15: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151520_21185.jpg)

**Eternal Dazzle**: A dreamy paradise of delicate roses with purple, pink, and white hues of baby's breath — a breathtaking theme that captivates the senses.

![Image 16: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151617_54306.jpg)![Image 17: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151626_79545.jpg)

**Pink Fairytale**: Immerse yourself in pure bliss with blush pink roses, eustomas, and eucalyptus symbolising happiness and joy in this magical atmosphere.

![Image 18: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151644_97260.jpg)![Image 19: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151652_79633.jpg)

### Expert Planning for Flawless Execution

Behind every successful wedding at Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel are their Marriott Certified Wedding Planners. These professionals have completed demanding coursework and are qualified to coordinate weddings of all types, including ethnic and military ceremonies.

As the saying goes, dream weddings don't just happen — they're planned. Their experienced team helps determine an overall vision for your wedding and execute each detail meticulously. From setting an event budget to deciding on menu options, arranging table settings, and finding florists, photographers, and entertainment, these planners handle it all with expertise born from experience, training, tradition, and intuition.

This seamless coordination continues through to the big day itself, with dedicated event hosts taking care of every detail so you can focus on enjoying your celebration. Their comprehensive service ensures that nothing is left to chance.

### Culinary Excellence to Impress Your Guests

![Image 20: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151736_21521.jpg)

Food is often one of the most remembered aspects of any wedding, and Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel exceeds expectations with its culinary offerings. Guests can savour authentic and classic Cantonese cuisines presented by the award-winning Wan Hao Chinese Restaurant.

Using only premium and the freshest ingredients, their repertoire of specially curated masterpieces displays exquisite workmanship and ingenuity.

![Image 21: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151818_53501.jpg)

For those requiring Halal options, their Halal-certified banquet kitchen offers a delectable menu featuring international cuisines that satisfy any palate. To ensure your complete satisfaction, the hotel provides private food tasting sessions, giving you an accurate sense of what to expect on your wedding day.

### Picture-Perfect Moments

Every couple wants stunning photographs to commemorate their special day, and Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel offers several picturesque spots for capturing these precious moments. The charming mini garden on Level 4 provides a serene and lush backdrop that feels like an oasis in the city centre. Other popular locations include the outdoor pool area, guest room corridor, and the hotel's forecourt — all perfect settings to create beautiful memories.

### Promotions and Packages for Your Special Day

But the celebration doesn't end with the reception. Each wedding couple receives special in-room amenities, including a bottle of champagne, a 250g chocolate fudge cake, chocolate-dipped strawberries, and chocolate pralines — sweet touches that make your stay even more memorable.

With packages to suit different preferences and budgets, Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel offers options for both intimate celebrations and grand affairs:

**Intimate Wedding Packages:**

*    7-Course Chinese Wedding Lunch: From $1,388.00++ per table (10 guests) 
*    8-Course Chinese Wedding Dinner: From $1,488.00++ per table (10 guests) 

**Grand Ballroom Dinner Package:**

*    8-Course Chinese Wedding Dinner (Weekend Pricing: Friday, Saturday, Sunday, Eve of Public Holidays, and Public Holidays): From $1,988.00++ per table (10 guests) 

### Your Dream Wedding Awaits at Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel

![Image 22: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151948_96397.jpg)

From its prime location to its impeccable service, exquisite décor, and gourmet dining, Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel is a venue that delivers on all fronts. To secure your preferred wedding date at this sought-after venue, couples are advised to book 1 to 1.5 years in advance.

From the moment you begin planning until the last dance of the night, **Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel** is committed to making your celebration as unique and special as your love story.

# Beauty Hope: The Wedding-Ready Glow You Deserve

![Image 6: Beauty Hope: The Wedding-Ready Glow You Deserve](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311172651_81854.jpg)

Eighteen years in the beauty industry isn’t just a number — it’s a testament to trust. Beauty Hope has spent nearly two decades perfecting the art of skincare and wellness, earning a reputation as a go-to sanctuary for radiant, healthy skin and rejuvenation. It’s not just about facials and treatments; it’s about a philosophy of care that has won over four generations of loyal clients. When it comes to pre-wedding skincare and wellness, that kind of experience matters.

### One-Stop Skin and Wellness Solution, Tailored to You

![Image 7: Beauty Hope: The Wedding-Ready Glow You Deserve](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311172711_98931.jpg)

No two skin types are the same, and Beauty Hope understands that better than anyone. Their expert team offers free one-on-one consultations to assess your skin’s unique needs and customise a treatment plan that works for you.

![Image 8: Beauty Hope: The Wedding-Ready Glow You Deserve](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311172724_79690.jpg)

Furthermore, Beauty Hope takes a holistic approach to skincare, offering a comprehensive range of treatments designed to rejuvenate, hydrate, and enhance your natural glow. From gentle, hydrating facials to advanced microneedling and high-tech oxygen treatments, their specialists craft personalised regimens to address every skin concern — whether it's dullness, fine lines, or uneven tone. The result? A radiant, wedding-ready complexion that looks effortless (even if the planning wasn’t).

### The Wedding-Ready Must-Try Treatments

![Image 9: Beauty Hope: The Wedding-Ready Glow You Deserve](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311172744_10217.jpg)

For brides (and grooms) looking to achieve flawless skin, Beauty Hope offers a range of expert treatments. Their **Diamond Peel Facial** is a favourite for refining texture and evening out skin tone, while the **Jet Peel Facial** infuses pure oxygen to deeply cleanse and hydrate. Those looking for next-level results might opt for the **Micro Needle Treatment**, designed to stimulate collagen production and create lasting smoothness.

Struggling with tired eyes from all those late-night seating chart revisions? The **Genosys Eye Cell Treatment** targets dark circles and puffiness, ensuring you look fresh and well-rested on the big day.

### More Than Just Skin Deep

![Image 10: Beauty Hope: The Wedding-Ready Glow You Deserve](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311172805_69455.jpg)

Beauty Hope isn’t just about treatments; it’s about confidence. Their philosophy is rooted in the belief that beauty isn’t about perfection — it’s about embracing and enhancing what’s already there. By combining expert techniques with state-of-the-art technology, they help clients achieve real, lasting results without gimmicks or empty promises.

### Special Offers for Brides-to-Be (and Grooms!)

![Image 11: Beauty Hope: The Wedding-Ready Glow You Deserve](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311172824_92472.jpg)

Quality skincare shouldn’t cost as much as the wedding itself. Beauty Hope balances expertise with affordability, ensuring top-tier treatments are within reach. For couples looking to unwind together, they also offer exclusive promotions — because self-care is always better when shared.

In celebration of love (and good skincare), Beauty Hope is offering these special wedding-ready promotions:

*   **1 Customised Facial Voucher:** $28 
*   **2 Customised Facial Vouchers:**$40 (Save $16) 
*   **1 x 45-min Body Pai Suan Wellness Voucher:** $68

_(Prices exclude 9% GST)_

### Visit Beauty Hope Today!

With locations across Singapore, Beauty Hope makes it easy to schedule a pampering session amid the wedding chaos. Whether you’re looking for a quick refresh or an in-depth skin transformation, their team is ready to help you achieve that sought-after bridal glow.

With nearly two decades of expertise, tailored treatments, and a commitment to affordability, they make beauty accessible without compromise.

Whether you’re preparing for your wedding or simply indulging in well-deserved self-care, their expert team ensures you leave feeling refreshed, rejuvenated, and ready to shine. **Beauty Hope** isn’t just about skincare — it’s about feeling your best from the inside out.

### Our Services

**A unique hilltop destination to begin your lifetime of happiness**

Create blissful memories to last a lifetime at**Mount Faber Peak**, surrounded by magnificent views of the city and glistening harbour vista. At 100m above sea level, the extraordinary hilltop wedding destinations at Mount Faber Peak artfully incorporate lush greenery and natural elements into a unique charm that is sure to inspire many beautiful memories.

Encased with glass walls that overlooks panoramic sea views, our**Angsana Glasshouse**offers an intimate wedding ceremony and deck solemnisation experience for your guests to feel on top of the world. For large weddings up to 200 guests,**The Ballroom**features floor-to-ceiling glass windows that treat guests to magnificent views of the cable car line and picturesque harbour, bound to leave your guests in awe. The botanical-themed**Arbora**sets the scene for a unique alfresco wedding amid a natural ambience. Our venues all come with the option to add on a **Garden Solemnisation**, where you can make a grand entrance down the elegant spiral staircase and commemorate your love by ringing the Bells of Happiness as a symbol of everlasting bliss.

Whether it’s a sophisticated wedding dinner, an intimate solemnisation ceremony or a cosy reception,bring together your closest loved ones for an intimate celebration at Mount Faber Peak.

For more information, visit us at [https://mountfaberdining.com/pages/celebrations-catering](https://mountfaberdining.com/pages/celebrations-catering)

### Our Services

**A unique hilltop destination to begin your lifetime of happiness**

Create blissful memories to last a lifetime at**Mount Faber Peak**, surrounded by magnificent views of the city and glistening harbour vista. At 100m above sea level, the extraordinary hilltop wedding destinations at Mount Faber Peak artfully incorporate lush greenery and natural elements into a unique charm that is sure to inspire many beautiful memories.

Encased with glass walls that overlooks panoramic sea views, our**Angsana Glasshouse**offers an intimate wedding ceremony and deck solemnisation experience for your guests to feel on top of the world. For large weddings up to 200 guests,**The Ballroom**features floor-to-ceiling glass windows that treat guests to magnificent views of the cable car line and picturesque harbour, bound to leave your guests in awe. The botanical-themed**Arbora**sets the scene for a unique alfresco wedding amid a natural ambience. Our venues all come with the option to add on a **Garden Solemnisation**, where you can make a grand entrance down the elegant spiral staircase and commemorate your love by ringing the Bells of Happiness as a symbol of everlasting bliss.

Whether it’s a sophisticated wedding dinner, an intimate solemnisation ceremony or a cosy reception,bring together your closest loved ones for an intimate celebration at Mount Faber Peak.

For more information, visit us at [https://mountfaberdining.com/pages/celebrations-catering](https://mountfaberdining.com/pages/celebrations-catering)

# Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025

 2025-02-20

Vendor:[Mount Faber Peak](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/15/restaurants/detail/306/mount-faber-peak)

![Image 5: Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218124420_82536.jpg)

When it comes to wedding venues that truly elevate the experience — literally and figuratively — **Mount Faber Peak** stands in a league of its own.

With panoramic views that stretch over the harbour and Sentosa Island, this hilltop haven is a dream come true for couples seeking a wedding venue that feels both unique and intimate. Blissful Brides is proud to honour Mount Faber Peak with our coveted Editor’s Choice Award for Preferred Banquet Venue, and here’s why it deserves a place on your shortlist.

### Versatile Venues for Every Celebration

![Image 6: Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218124443_89321.jpg)

Mount Faber Peak offers a selection of exquisite venues that cater to every type of celebration, from intimate receptions to grand gatherings. For those dreaming of a cosy yet sophisticated affair, the **Angsana Glasshouse** provides an ethereal setting. Surrounded by floor-to-ceiling glass windows, this crystalline space is perfect for up to 70 guests. Its elevated location at the highest point of Mount Faber ensures awe-inspiring views of the HarbourFront and beyond.

![Image 7: Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218124458_56770.jpg)

For larger celebrations, **The****Ballroom** is nothing short of breathtaking. With its floor-to-ceiling glass windows and sophisticated design, it comfortably accommodates up to 200 guests. The venue’s unique charm lies in its view of the iconic cable car cabins gliding against a backdrop of shimmering waters. Guests can even begin the festivities with a stylish cocktail reception at the veranda or bar, setting the tone for an unforgettable evening.

![Image 8: Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218124515_82856.jpg)

For couples who dream of an outdoor ceremony surrounded by nature, the **Arbora Garden** offers a picturesque setting like no other. This lush hilltop garden, adorned with heritage Angsana trees and whimsical landscaping, is the ideal spot for exchanging vows under the open sky. The centrepiece of the garden, Poland’s Bells of Happiness, adds a touch of enchantment and tradition, inviting couples to ring in good fortune for their new chapter together.

### Simply Unforgettable Experiences

![Image 9: Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218124537_58988.jpg)

Mount Faber Peak is all about creating magical moments, and it all begins with a breathtaking first impression! Couples can make a dramatic entrance via the stunning spiral staircase that leads to Arbora Garden for their solemnisation, setting the stage for a day brimming with elegance and romance. Guests will also have a blast arriving in style by cable car rides, adding an extra layer of excitement and uniqueness to the event!

### A Setting Like No Other

![Image 10: Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218124605_47310.jpg)

Beyond the venues themselves, Mount Faber Peak’s hilltop location offers something few others can match: an escape from the city’s hustle without straying too far from its conveniences. Just minutes from downtown Singapore, this hidden gem provides a serene retreat with panoramic views, lush greenery, and a sophisticated atmosphere. It’s a place where nature meets modern luxury, creating the perfect backdrop for unforgettable celebrations.

### Award-Winning Excellence @ The Peak

With its slogan “Celebrate Love @ The Peak,” Mount Faber Peak encapsulates everything a wedding venue should be — romantic, versatile, and utterly breathtaking. Just imagine exchanging vows or hosting a reception where every corner reveals a new picture-perfect scene.

It’s no wonder, then, that Mount Faber Peak has earned our Editor’s Choice Award for Preferred Banquet Venue. From its charming spaces to its spectacular views and unique offerings, every element is designed to make your wedding day truly extraordinary. For couples looking to start their forever on a high note, **Mount Faber Peak** is the venue that delivers on every promise.

### Our Services

### ALUXE, a messenger of happiness

ALUXE has been dedicated to crafting high-quality jewellery since its founding in 2005. With a commitment to valuing every customer, ALUXE uses diamonds to commemorate life's most precious and loved moments. With a commitment to continuous innovation and a relentless pursuit of excellence, ALUXE has proudly served over 200,000 couples and currently operates 10 stores throughout Taiwan, solidifying its position as the leading jewellery brand in Taiwan. Furthermore, ALUXE has expanded its presence with branches in Hong Kong, Singapore, and other international locations.

The name ALUXE comes from the abbreviation of "A luxury moment," representing the precious moments we all have, as well as the brand's philosophy and style. Through ALUXE, the brand hopes to enable every customer to feel their unique and precious love, and enjoy a full sense of happiness.

# The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love 

 2025-03-11

Vendor:[ALUXE](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/11/jewellery-accessories/detail/1203/aluxe)

![Image 5: The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311153606_46512.jpg)

Few things capture the essence of love quite like a diamond. For over 40 years, **ALUXE** has been perfecting the art of selecting and crafting these timeless gems, earning its place as Taiwan’s leading wedding jewellery brand. Now, Singaporean couples can experience the same expertise and dedication, with ALUXE’s dazzling collection of diamonds and wedding rings designed to mark life’s most cherished moments.

As one of Taiwan’s largest diamond importers, ALUXE sources directly from the top three diamond-cutting factories worldwide, bypassing unnecessary middlemen. The result? Premium diamonds at competitive prices, ensuring couples get the most brilliance for their budget. With some of the best diamond prices in Singapore, ALUXE ensures couples get maximum brilliance for their budget, making luxury more accessible than ever.

### A Bespoke Experience

![Image 6: The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311153622_93848.jpg)

Every love story is unique, and the ring that symbolises it should be too. ALUXE offers full customisation with thousands of ring designs, styles, and settings to explore, ensuring every couple finds their perfect match. From classic solitaires to intricate halo designs, the possibilities are endless. With expert guidance at every step, ALUXE helps bring dream rings to life, crafting one-of-a-kind masterpieces that truly reflect each couple’s journey.

Beyond design, the experience itself is seamless. ALUXE’s consultants provide warm, personalised guidance, making every step of the process enjoyable and stress-free. Their expertise extends beyond diamonds, so whether couples need proposal tips or jewellery care advice, ALUXE is there to assist.

### Custom-Crafted Brilliance: The ALUXE Diamond Advantage

![Image 7: The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311153707_85083.jpg)

Whether you are looking for a natural diamond or a lab-grown diamond, ALUXE's dedication to quality, transparency, and innovation ensures that you find the perfect one. Not all diamonds are created equal, and ALUXE makes no compromises when it comes to quality. Every diamond in its collection is graded D to F in colour — the purest, most colorless standard—so each stone radiates unparalleled brilliance.

And for those who want the perfect balance of quality and convenience, ALUXE’s **Instant Diamond Selection** ensures a hassle-free experience. With real-time access to over 30,000 diamonds, customers can select their ideal piece with confidence, viewing every detail through a 360° high-resolution display. A direct connection with suppliers guarantees diamonds are always in stock, with transparent pricing updated in real time — no hidden mark-ups, just the best value for the best diamonds. Those in a hurry can choose from a wide range of ready-to-go options and walk away with their dream piece the same day, while pre-orders are guaranteed for delivery within two months.

ALUXE’s commitment to **competitive pricing without compromise** ensures that luxury remains accessible. By sourcing directly from the world’s leading diamond-cutting factories, ALUXE eliminates unnecessary middlemen and passes those savings directly to customers. As one of Taiwan’s largest diamond importers, ALUXE has the power to negotiate unbeatable prices, offering some of the best diamond prices in Singapore. Whether it’s a first-time purchase or an addition to a growing collection, customers receive the highest quality at the most competitive price.

### Certified Excellence & Distinctive Elegance

![Image 8: The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311153744_77354.jpg)

Every ALUXE diamond is backed by internationally recognised certification. Natural diamonds are GIA-certified, ensuring authenticity, ethical sourcing, and precise grading of cut, colour, clarity, and carat weight. Lab-grown diamonds come with IGI certification, guaranteeing the same brilliance and quality. But ALUXE goes even further. By introducing the Ultimate Diamond, ALUXE sets a new benchmark in excellence. Using advanced diamond technology, these gems undergo scientific evaluation for brilliance, fire, scintillation, and optical symmetry — ensuring they are not just beautiful, but truly exceptional.

![Image 9: The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311153802_30916.jpg)

For those seeking something beyond the ordinary, ALUXE offers an extensive range of fancy-cut diamonds and rare coloured diamonds, including pink, yellow, and blue hues.

![Image 10: The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311153824_10135.jpg)

![Image 11: The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311153832_22860.jpg)

The **ROSÉ My Love collection** makes the dream of pink diamonds more attainable by pairing lab-grown pink diamonds with expert craftsmanship, offering unparalleled beauty at a price within reach. Whether it’s an engagement ring, anniversary gift, or Valentine’s Day surprise, these diamonds provide a striking alternative to traditional white stones.

![Image 12: The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311153846_90395.jpg)
Meanwhile, the **Lovers Collection** showcases elegant blue diamonds, a rarity in Singapore’s wedding jewellery scene, embodying purity and devotion.

### The ALUXE Difference

![Image 13: The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311153912_28899.jpg)

With decades of expertise, a direct sourcing model, and an unwavering commitment to quality, ALUXE stands apart in the world of wedding jewellery. More than just diamonds, **ALUXE** ensures every couple walks away with a piece as enduring as their love.

Visit any ALUXE store to explore their collections. Because when it comes to celebrating love, nothing shines brighter.

# Dusit Thani Laguna Singapore: Editor’s Choice for Banquet Venue 2025

 2025-02-24

![Image 6](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250219/20250219163554_97046.jpg)

At _Blissful Brides_, we are committed to recognising venues that redefine the art of celebration, turning wedding dreams into reality. This year, **Dusit Thani Laguna Singapore** has earned its place as one of our Editor’s Choice Award winners for 'Banquet Venue', and it’s no surprise why. From its idyllic location to its exceptional event spaces, this venue offers everything couples could wish for - to create a wedding that is nothing short of extraordinary. Interested? Read on for more.

### Tailored Venues for Unforgettable Occasions

One of the highlights of Dusit Thani Laguna Singapore is its array of both indoor and outdoor venues, each designed to cater to different styles of weddings.

![Image 7](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250219/20250219163621_33091.jpg)

For grand celebrations, the **Laguna Ballroom** takes centre stage. With its pillarless design, high ceilings, and capacity for up to 380 guests, the ballroom allows every attendee to have an unobstructed view of the ceremony or festivities. Its elegant interiors create a sophisticated atmosphere, while its spaciousness provides flexibility for personalisation, allowing couples to make the space uniquely theirs.

![Image 8](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250219/20250219163639_27734.jpg)
For more intimate gatherings, the **Albatross & Birdie** venue offers an enchanting option. With natural daylight streaming through large windows and stunning views of the pool and golf courses, it creates a warm and inviting ambience for up to 80 guests.

![Image 9](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250219/20250219163650_13130.jpg)
For those seeking to embrace the beauty of nature, the **Laguna Lawn** is a dream come true. This lush outdoor space can host grand solemnisation ceremonies for up to 50 guests, set against a backdrop of verdant greenery. Whether under a canopy of stars or in the soft glow of daylight, the lawn provides an unforgettable setting for life’s most romantic moments.

### A Serene Escape Just Minutes Away

![Image 10](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250219/20250219163708_32891.jpg)

Located within the grounds of the prestigious Laguna National Golf Resort Club, Dusit Thani Laguna Singapore provides a tranquil haven that feels a world away from the city. Its lush surroundings of rolling greenery and pristine landscapes make it a truly unique wedding destination. Conveniently located just 10 minutes from Singapore Changi Airport and within easy reach of downtown, the venue combines accessibility with a sense of retreat, perfect for couples looking to exchange vows in an oasis of calm.

### A Seamless Blend of Elegance and Convenience

![Image 11](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250219/20250219163724_76218.jpg)

Spanning over 4,000 square metres of classy indoor and lush outdoor event spaces, Dusit Thani Laguna Singapore offers couples the ability to host their entire wedding — from solemnisation to reception — in one convenient location. Beyond its stunning venues, the hotel provides cutting-edge facilities and unparalleled attention to detail, ensuring every event is executed to perfection.

This dedication to excellence extends to the guest experience. # Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall

 2025-03-04

![Image 5: Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250304/20250304111414_25711.jpg)

Have you heard? Couples who desire atypical or unique wedding spots are turning their gaze skyward — specifically to the rooftop of Grand Park City Hall. Here, among wrought iron domes and gentle fountains, urban weddings take on an unexpected botanical twist. It's where "I do" comes with a view and wedding stress checks out before you do.

For those who believe marriage should start on a high note, this skyward sanctuary might just be your match made in heaven — or at least, several stories closer to it. Read on for more.

### A Garden in the Sky

Tucked away from the hustle and bustle of Singapore's central business district lies a hidden gem for couples seeking a memorable wedding venue. Grand Park City Hall offers not one, but two distinctive spaces that transform wedding dreams into reality.

![Image 6: Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250304/20250304111455_89760.jpg)

The crown jewel of this urban retreat is undoubtedly the Rooftop Sky Garden. Perched at the building's summit, this outdoor venue draws inspiration from the surrounding nature and neoclassical architecture of Singapore's historic Civic District. The wrought iron dome structure creates a stunning focal point, while gentle water fountains provide a soothing soundtrack to your ceremony; one couldn’t ask for a more perfect backdrop for rustic outdoor garden weddings and intimate solemnisations.

![Image 7: Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250304/20250304111511_91323.jpg)

![Image 8: Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250304/20250304111521_48712.jpg)

For couples concerned about capacity, the Rooftop Sky Garden comfortably accommodates up to 120 guests for ceremonies and 80 for receptions, making it ideal for those who prefer quality time with a select gathering rather than an overwhelming crowd.

### Fine Dining Excellence

![Image 9: Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250304/20250304111543_36882.jpg)

For indoor celebrations, Tablescape Restaurant on Level 3 presents an equally impressive option. Widely regarded as one of the finest dining establishments in Singapore's CBD, Tablescape transports guests to an era when restaurant dining was a truly special occasion.

![Image 10: Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250304/20250304111556_86493.jpg)

![Image 11: Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250304/20250304111610_45371.jpg)

The restaurant's interior showcases neoclassical beauty with meticulous attention to detail, creating an atmosphere of refined elegance. Here, up to 120 guests can enjoy a reception featuring impeccable table service and classic dishes reimagined with contemporary flair.

Seamless Planning Support

Understanding that wedding planning can be overwhelming, Grand Park City Hall offers dedicated support to ensure a stress-free experience. Each couple is assigned a designated Event Services Planner who handles pre-event logistics and coordinates all details, ensuring everything runs smoothly on the big day.

### The Grand Park Promise

![Image 12: Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250304/20250304111655_71931.jpg)

Wedding dates are precious, and securing your preferred venue is paramount. Grand Park City Hall recommends that couples place their deposit as soon as they finalise their date. With packages starting from $178++ to $198++ per person, Grand Park City Hall offers competitive pricing for a premium wedding experience in a central Singapore location.

For couples seeking a wedding venue that balances urban convenience with natural beauty, historical character with modern amenities, and intimate atmosphere with generous capacity, **Grand Park City Hall** stands ready to host your celebration of love.

### Our Services

A wedding at W Singapore - Sentosa Cove is not just a ceremony. It's a happening. Pop the question, celebrate an engagement, tie the knot or steal away into a picture perfect honeymoon at our hotel.

Go for a personalized celebration with our Wed Your Way options, turning your "I Do" into the event of the year in a stylish setting where the focus is entirely on celebrating the unique bond between the two of you in a stylish locale.

Our pillarless 720sqm Great Room is the grandest space for magical moments, featuring natural daylight, a giant LED screen of 5 X 14 meters showcasing your beautiful memories in a wedding video montage, high ceiling for a grand or playful march in, enhanced by dramatic spotlights encased in crystals, fairy wall illustrations, orchid petal wall lights and dazzling chandeliers. Let's not forget the lavish and expertly curated banquet by our Executive Chef, ensuring a once-in-a-lifetime experience with memories to last a lifetime.

For another type of setting, leave mild-mannered weddings behind in our Studios. Say ‘I Do’ in Studios showcasing high ceilings, natural daylight and tropical views and surroundings. The versatile set up of the Studios allow for flexible space arrangement, from one Studio up to four open studios. Captivate your guests to a momentous wedding to remember.

The tranquil environment of our breezy tropical island will set the mood for an elegant tropical ceremony and set the stage for a catered reception to remember. Your solemnization can be hosted at our outdoor venues: W Lawn or the more intimate English garden. The tropical air and surroundings will make this solemnization feel like a breeze of love for you and your guests. It is all about celebrating the two of you in a stylish location.

Our innovative planners transform the hotel’s breathtaking banquet venues into an out-of-the-world wedding setup that’s unique to you, whether that means glamour, fun, simple, chic or all of the above.

# Amara Singapore: Beyond One Celebration

 2025-03-02

Vendor:[Amara Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/9/hotels/detail/492/amara-singapore)

![Image 6: Amara Singapore: Beyond One Celebration](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250227/20250227155858_62201.jpg)

Nestled in the heart of vibrant Tanjong Pagar, Amara Singapore stands as a beacon of elegance and sophistication for couples seeking the perfect wedding venue. With its recent transformation, this iconic hotel has ushered in a new era of celebration, seamlessly blending modern luxury with timeless charm.

### An Elegant Setting for Your Love Story

![Image 7: Amara Singapore: Beyond One Celebration](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250227/20250227155906_11113.jpg)

The crowning jewel of Amara Singapore's renovation is undoubtedly the breathtaking Grand Ballroom. This column-free space boasts a spectacular 38-metre-long aisle, perfect for those dreaming of a grand entrance. Inspired by the diverse shophouse facades of Tanjong Pagar, the ballroom exudes an air of grandeur and warmth that will captivate up to 400 guests.

But what truly sets this venue apart is its versatility. The neutral palette serves as a blank canvas, allowing couples to bring their unique vision to life. Floor-to-ceiling windows bathe the space in natural light, creating an airy and romantic atmosphere. For those seeking a truly immersive experience, the ballroom features a stunning 7.6-metre-long LED video wall, perfect for showcasing your love story in cinematic style.

### Intimate Celebrations and Pre-Wedding Festivities

![Image 8: Amara Singapore: Beyond One Celebration](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250227/20250227155915_60272.jpg)

While the Grand Ballroom steals the spotlight, Amara Singapore offers a range of spaces to accommodate every aspect of your wedding journey. The four elegantly appointed Connection rooms are ideal for intimate ceremonies, rehearsal dinners, or pre-wedding gatherings. Each space boasts state-of-the-art audiovisual amenities and flexible seating arrangements, ensuring a tailored experience for your special moments.

### A Foyer That Flows with Celebration

![Image 9: Amara Singapore: Beyond One Celebration](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250227/20250227155924_42154.jpg)

Central to the Grand Ballroom and Connection rooms, the newly redesigned foyer serves as the perfect prelude to your wedding festivities. This contemporary space features built-in amenity counters and modular seating that can be customised to suit your needs. The emerald tiling creates a striking first impression, whilst plush armchairs and sofas offer a welcoming atmosphere for mingling guests.

For those seeking a touch of additional glamour, look no further than 'The Locale'. This charming neighbourhood bar, situated at the heart of the conference area, can provide everything from mid-morning coffees to celebratory cocktails, ensuring your wedding day flows seamlessly from ceremony to reception.

### Your Dream Wedding Curated with Care and Expertise

![Image 10: Amara Singapore: Beyond One Celebration](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250227/20250227155936_52152.jpg)

As one of the first hotels in Tanjong Pagar, Amara Singapore has a storied history of hosting memorable events. Now, with its stunning transformation, the hotel is poised to create a new legacy of love stories. The dedicated events team brings a wealth of experience and passion to every wedding, ensuring that your special day unfolds exactly as you've always dreamed.

 But Amara Singapore's appeal extends far beyond the wedding day itself. The hotel's 389 rooms and suites, newly revitalised by Studio HBA, offer a serene urban oasis for you and your guests. Drawing inspiration from the charming alleyways and vibrant neighbourhood, each space is thoughtfully adorned with luxurious amenities, ensuring a comfortable stay for all.

### Your Forever Begins Here

Amara Singapore offers an exceptional setting for your special day. From the moment you enter the elegant grand foyer to the final dance in the beautifully transformed ballroom, every detail is thoughtfully curated to ensure your wedding is a memorable celebration.

With its prime location, refined amenities, and steadfast dedication to excellence, Amara Singapore is ready to bring your vision to life.

To begin planning your dream wedding, reach out to their dedicated events team. Your unforgettable celebration awaits in the heart of Tanjong Pagar.

# Copthorne King’s Hotel Singapore: Blissful Brides Editor’s Choice Award for Banquet Venue

 2025-02-19

Vendor:[Copthorne King's Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/9/hotels/detail/53/catering-cks-millenniumhotels-com)

![Image 6: Copthorne King’s Hotel Singapore: Blissful Brides Editor’s Choice Award for Banquet Venue](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218123045_10877.jpg)

When it comes to wedding venues that redefine the standard**, Copthorne King’s Hotel Singapore** is a top contender. That’s exactly why it has rightfully earned our **Editor’s Choice Award for Banquet Venue**this year, solidifying its place as one of the premier destinations for couples seeking a celebration as unique and meaningful as their love story.

But what makes this riverside gem so deserving of this accolade? Here’s why it’s the ultimate choice for your dream wedding.

### A Seamless Planning Experience

Planning a wedding can be daunting, but at Copthorne King’s Hotel, couples are in the best hands. The hotel’s team of **dedicated Wedding Consultants** excels at turning dreams into reality. With meticulous attention to detail, they tailor every element of the celebration to reflect the couple's vision. From personalised timelines to custom touches, the process is made effortless, leaving couples free to enjoy their journey to the big day.

### A Feast to Remember: Signature Teochew Cuisine

![Image 7: Copthorne King’s Hotel Singapore: Blissful Brides Editor’s Choice Award for Banquet Venue](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218123148_64499.jpg)

As always, a wedding banquet is a celebration of culture and connection. At Copthorne King’s, the banquet is elevated by the culinary artistry of its award-winning **Tien Court restaurant**, helmed by MasterChef Lui Wing Keung. Guests are treated to **authentic Teochew cuisine**, where every bite reflects a harmonious blend of tradition and modern gastronomy. This signature offering sets the hotel apart, leaving an indelible impression on even the most discerning palates.

The eight-course Teochew banquet menu is a symphony of flavours, making it a standout feature of the wedding packages offered here. Each dish is a masterpiece, ensuring your guests will leave not just satisfied but raving about the meal for years to come.

Furthermore, from the moment your guests arrive, they are enveloped in warmth and professionalism. The hotel’s banquet team goes above and beyond to ensure every detail is executed flawlessly. Whether it’s the perfectly timed arrival of each course or the seamless coordination of the day’s events, their commitment to excellence ensures that your wedding unfolds without a hitch.

### Wedding Packages and Venues Designed to Wow

Copthorne King’s Hotel offers thoughtfully curated wedding packages that deliver both luxury and exceptional value. Couples can immerse themselves in **themed celebrations**, such as the serene and tranquil hues of Azure, the earthy and grounding tones of Terrestrial, or the romantic and sophisticated allure of Scarlett.

These packages are packed with perks, including a one-night stay in the hotel’s **luxurious Bridal Suite**, complete with two private balconies and a separate living room, dining area, and bedroom. Other inclusions, such as complimentary Nonya kuehs for guests and elegant wedding favours, ensure that every element of the day is unforgettable.

So, rest assured that whatever the occasion, the hotel’s **versatile event spaces** provide the perfect backdrop. Flexible layouts allow couples to design their ideal setting, accommodating both cosy solemnisation ceremonies and lavish banquets with ease.

And that’s not to mention what happens after the celebrations. When all is said and done, couples can retreat to the hotel’s **elegant Bridal Suite**, a haven of luxury and tranquillity. With its refined décor, plush furnishings, and breathtaking views, it’s the perfect place to unwind and reflect on your special day. Every corner of the suite is designed to make newlyweds feel pampered and cherished.

### Celebrate with Copthorne King’s Hotel Singapore

Copthorne King’s Hotel Singapore has redefined what it means to be a wedding venue, combining impeccable service, extraordinary cuisine, and unparalleled attention to detail. It’s no wonder they’ve earned our Blissful Brides Editor’s Choice nomination for Banquet Venue.

*    10% discount on your wedding banquet 
*    Complimentary free-flow beer and house wine 
*    A 1-night stay in a Deluxe Room for your wedding helpers 
*    Authentic handmade Nonya Kueh for up to 100 guests during pre-reception 
*    An additional overnight stay in our Bridal Suite with breakfast for two 
*    A post-dinner get-together at Princess Terrace Café, featuring an Authentic Penang-Peranakan Buffet for 10 persons

When planning your wedding, you’d want to make sure everything is perfect, from the seating chart to the music playlist and every detail in between. It's one of the biggest days of your life, so it’s only natural to want to be thorough and get down to the nitty-gritty of what needs to be sorted.

But are all these details truly essential, or are some simply unnecessary pressures passed down through generations or social media? Let’s take a closer look at some common wedding planning myths and, more importantly, what really deserves a spot on your[wedding planning checklist in Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/wedding-tools "Wedding Planning Checklist, Wedding Planning Checklist Singapore").

### Myth 1: You Need a Grand Guest List

![Image 6: Wedding Planning Myths: What Should Be On Your Checklist?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250506/20250506164504_34523.jpg)

There’s a long-standing belief that weddings must include everyone you know: your childhood neighbours, distant cousins, former classmates, and your parents’ colleagues. While it may seem polite to cast a wide net, a large guest list doesn’t necessarily mean a better celebration.

In fact, many couples in Singapore are now embracing the idea of smaller, more intimate weddings. These gatherings not only allow for more meaningful interactions with each guest, but they also help keep costs manageable. A compact guest list can free up your budget for things you genuinely care about, such as a stunning venue or a great photographer.

**Checklist Tip:**Think about the people who matter most to you and your partner. Instead of feeling obligated to invite everyone, create a guest list that feels right for you. This will also help you make better decisions when it comes to catering, seating, and venue size.

### Myth 2: You Must Follow Every Wedding Tradition

![Image 7: Wedding Planning Myths: What Should Be On Your Checklist?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250506/20250506164606_27183.jpg)

From cake cutting to tossing the bouquet, traditional wedding customs are often treated as must-haves. But the truth is, many couples today are skipping these rituals in favour of more personal touches.

Don’t like the idea of a first dance? Skip it. Prefer an unconventional walk down the aisle song? Go for it. Whether it’s the type of ceremony, your outfit, or the reception format, there’s no rule that says you have to follow any specific formula. In multicultural Singapore, couples often mix different customs or invent their own, and that’s part of what makes each celebration unique.

Even during [wedding dress shopping](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/wedding/wedding-dress-shopping-101-expert-advice-for-brides-to-be "Wedding Dress Shopping 101: Expert Advice for Brides-to-Be"), some brides choose coloured gowns or opt out of traditional silhouettes entirely. The focus is on what makes you feel beautiful and confident, not what fits a centuries-old standard.

**Checklist Tip:**When going through your checklist, consider what traditions you and your partner value and which ones you can let go of. Replace outdated expectations with experiences that reflect your personalities and relationship.

### Myth 3: You Must Have a Perfect Plan for Every Detail

![Image 8: Wedding Planning Myths: What Should Be On Your Checklist?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250506/20250506164704_85503.jpg)

It's tempting to believe that if you plan everything down to the second, your wedding day will go off without a hitch. But weddings, like life, are full of unpredictable moments. The truth is, no matter how detailed your schedule is, something small may go wrong on the day itself. And that’s completely okay.

You might forget the rings at the hotel, or a guest might arrive late. It might drizzle during your outdoor ceremony. These little mishaps are normal, and many become funny or touching memories in hindsight. What’s important is that you and your partner are celebrating your love with the people who care about you.

Instead of striving for a flawless event, aim for a meaningful one. Have a basic timeline, communicate clearly with your vendors, and assign a reliable point-of-contact for the day. But beyond that, give yourself permission to enjoy the moment without sweating every detail.

**Checklist Tip:**Your wedding planning checklist should include essentials like confirming your venue, hiring key vendors, and arranging transportation. But also include flexibility by allowing space for changes and focusing on what will make the day feel special, not perfect.

### What Matters Most on Your Big Day

![Image 9: Wedding Planning Myths: What Should Be On Your Checklist?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250506/20250506164828_19434.jpg)

Wedding planning can feel overwhelming, especially with so many opinions, traditions, and myths floating around. But once you filter out what doesn’t serve you, you’ll find it much easier to focus on what really matters.

Your wedding day should reflect your love story, your personality, and your priorities, not someone else’s idea of what’s “right.” Whether you're going all out or keeping things simple, it’s the connection between you and your partner that truly makes it unforgettable.

 DEALS FROM WEDDING VENDORS 

 Blissful Brides is an all-in-one wedding guide in Singapore that strives to help all soon-to-be-married couples turn their ideal wedding into a reality by providing the necessary tools they need. With an eclectic range of available resources on our portal, we hope that couples can enjoy an enjoyable and stress-free experience when arranging their wedding. In the wedding planning industry, Blissful Brides has gained more than 20 years of experience, thus forming a solid connection with our excellent vendors. We have many different wedding vendors you can hire, each offering variety of jewellery, venues, restaurants, and dresses options. 

 Our wedding vendors are arranged according to their provided services, allowing couples to find the resources they need quickly. All you need is to enter a particular category you are looking at to discover the range of wedding vendors in that particular category. Many of those featured on our portal has been in this industry for a long time, and have earned themselves a solid reputation. Any couple who chooses either one can rest assured that they are in good hands. Couples can also better plan their wedding with the vendors’ professional assistance. Apart from the guide to different vendors available in Singapore, our website also features wedding deals that help couples keep to their set budget when planning their wedding. 

 For couples in Singapore that need more resources when planning their wedding, Blissful Brides has a magazine that will surely help any couple plan their perfect wedding. It is filled with gorgeous pictures and informative articles; couples can get lots of inspiration from browsing through. Besides our magazine, couples can also find the resources they need by looking through our website. We have many entertaining and informative articles ranging that helps couples find solutions to different problems, from financial management, relationships, and beauty and wellness. 

 Apart from our wedding planning guides, Blissful Brides is also known for being the Blissful Outdoor Wedding Shows (BOWS) organiser. Held three times a year, the highly anticipated wedding show is lined up with many exciting programmes. There are numerous deals and discounts that couples can find from the variety of exceptional wedding planners. Being one of Singapore’s most prominent events, couples can enjoy unbeatable convenience when visiting the wedding show. Besides superb deals, couples will also receive awesome door gifts and are able to win attractive prizes during the event. 

 Blissful Brides is without a doubt a one-stop guide to all the resources you need in Singapore to plan your wedding. You may send any enquiries you might have via the “Contact Us” page for any questions. Our friendly and professional team will be happy to assist you as much as they can. 

 We look forward to helping you with your wedding planning through our resources.

# A Dream Come True: My Dream Wedding

 2024-09-02

![Image 6: A Dream Come True: My Dream Wedding](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240902/20240902140650_43631.jpg)

Every bride dreams of her perfect wedding day, and at the heart of that dream is often the perfect dress. **My Dream Wedding**, a bridal boutique that's making waves in the Asian wedding market, is turning these dreams into reality. With its roots in Hong Kong and branches across Malaysia, China, and Singapore, this Korean-inspired boutique is redefining the bridal experience. From exquisite gowns to stunning photography, My Dream Wedding offers a comprehensive service that caters to every bride's unique vision.

### The Ultimate Bridal Destination

![Image 7: A Dream Come True: My Dream Wedding](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240902/20240902140732_47544.jpg)

At My Dream Wedding, no expense is spared for your big wedding. The boutique offers brides-to-be a vast collection of stunning wedding gowns, each carefully chosen for its sophisticated style, high-quality materials, and impeccable workmanship. Rest assured, their team of experts is dedicated to helping each bride find the dress that matches her unique style.

With a wide range of designer labels and bridal collections, the boutique caters to all tastes, from classic to contemporary. There’s even the option to rent or have dresses made to measure, ensuring a personalised experience for every bride. All in all, the boutique's commitment to excellence means that every dress is a masterpiece in its own right.

### A Fusion of Trends and Traditions

![Image 8: A Dream Come True: My Dream Wedding](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240902/20240902140755_70487.jpg)

That being said, My Dream Wedding doesn’t just offer any ordinary selection of gowns. Drawing inspiration from the latest Korean trends and classic wedding aesthetics, My Dream Wedding ensures that you, too, can keep up with the times in stylish fashion. From classic A-line silhouettes that whisper of timeless romance to daring mermaid cuts that sing of modern allure, their racks are a playground for every bride's fantasy.

The boutique's experienced professionals, well-versed in Hallyu sensibility, guide brides through the intricate process of selecting the perfect dress, considering every detail from colour to appliqué. Here, brides-to-be can lose themselves in a world where designer labels and bespoke creations coexist in harmonious luxury.

### Capturing Love in Pixels

![Image 9: A Dream Come True: My Dream Wedding](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240902/20240902140820_62583.jpg)

But My Dream Wedding's artistry extends beyond the dress. Beyond its role as a bridal atelier, My Dream Wedding has carved a niche in the world of wedding photography. Their Korean-style studio transports couples into a realm of romantic fantasy, reminiscent of beloved K-dramas.

However, the magic doesn't stop there — for those dreaming of destination weddings, My Dream Wedding also offers overseas photography sessions in a variety of breathtaking locations, from the sun-drenched streets of Paris to the ethereal beauty of Japanese cherry blossoms. With the unparalleled services of My Dream Wedding, preserve every beautiful moment and create cherished memories for a lifetime.

### More Than Just a Boutique

![Image 10: A Dream Come True: My Dream Wedding](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240902/20240902140844_42506.jpg)

As you can see, My Dream Wedding is more than just a dress shop or a photo studio; it's a one-stop destination for brides seeking a comprehensive wedding experience. With hair and makeup services complementing their gown selection and photography expertise, they offer a seamless journey from 'yes' to 'I do'. Having 70 Korean-styled studios across Asia, including Hong Kong, Malaysia, China, and Singapore, the boutique has already become widely synonymous with trendsetting designs and quality service.

With their vast selection of designer gowns, unique photography options, and dedicated team of professionals, My Dream Wedding is committed to making your wedding dreams come true. So, why wait? Contact My Dream Wedding now to see how they can fulfil the needs of your big day!

# Preferred Banquet Venues – Mount Faber Peak 

 2024-07-10

Vendor:[Mount Faber Peak](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/15/restaurants/detail/306/mount-faber-peak)

Mount Faber Peak stands as a beacon of elegance and natural beauty, earning its nomination for the Editor's Choice Award for Preferred Banquet Venues. Nestled atop the verdant hills, it offers couples an unparalleled setting for their wedding celebrations, combining breathtaking views of the cityscape with the tranquillity of the harbour below. Its uniqueness lies in the seamless integration of lush greenery and modern sophistication, providing couples with a picturesque backdrop and an unforgettable experience. With venues ranging from intimate dining rooms to expansive ballrooms, Mount Faber Peak caters to every couple's vision, ensuring that each celebration is as unique as the love it commemorates.

![Image 6: Preferred Banquet Venues – Mount Faber Peak ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240709/20240709094616_64511.jpg)

Nestled within Mount Faber Peak, the Angsana Glasshouse beckons couples seeking an intimate and enchanting space to celebrate their love surrounded by their nearest and dearest. Enclosed in glass walls revealing gorgeous sea panoramas and lush garden vistas, this ethereal alcove elevates wedding celebrations to new heights of luxury and romance. With the city's skyline as its backdrop, the Angsana Glasshouse offers nature-loving couples a serene oasis, capturing the essence of Singapore as a verdant garden city.

![Image 7: Preferred Banquet Venues – Mount Faber Peak ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240709/20240709094701_61424.jpg)

For couples who are envisioning a grander celebration, Mount Faber Peak presents two stunning options. Firstly, their signature Ballroom sets the stage for larger gatherings, accommodating up to 200 guests with unparalleled elegance. Featuring floor-to-ceiling glass windows that showcase the mesmerising cable car line and picturesque harbour, the Ballroom promises a breathtaking backdrop for memorable festivities. Secondly, the botanical-themed Arbora restaurant offers an alfresco wedding experience amidst lush greenery, catering to 120 guests. With its natural ambience and captivating surroundings, Arbora is an idyllic setting for couples seeking an intimate yet enchanting celebration amidst nature's embrace.

![Image 8: Preferred Banquet Venues – Mount Faber Peak ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240709/20240709094718_37385.jpg)

Moreover, couples can opt for the Garden Solemnisation—a romantic addition to their celebration. Couples get to enjoy a grand entrance down the elegant spiral staircase, surrounded by the serene beauty of nature. Seal your love by ringing the Bells of Happiness, an enchanting symbol of everlasting bliss that echoes through the hilltop sanctuary.

![Image 9: Preferred Banquet Venues – Mount Faber Peak ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240709/20240709094737_53397.jpg)

Beyond the gorgeous location, Mount Faber Peak boasts a large array of food options guaranteed to accommodate every couple’s and their guest’s preferences. With an exquisite selection of menus ranging from Chinese banquets to modern European sets and international buffets, couples have the freedom to choose a dining experience that perfectly reflects their tastes and preferences. Complimentary food tastings for four guests, available for the Asian Fusion and Modern European Set based on the confirmed menu, ensuring every dish surpasses expectations.

![Image 10: Preferred Banquet Venues – Mount Faber Peak ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240709/20240709094753_24270.jpg)

Additionally, during the wedding day itself, guests can indulge in a free flow of soft drinks, orange juice, and lime juice throughout the event. For those looking to raise a toast, each event includes a barrel of Tiger draught beer (30 Litres) and one bottle of house wine per 10 guests, available in red wine, white wine, or Moscato varieties. From refreshing beverages to culinary delights, every detail is meticulously crafted to elevate the dining experience and make each moment unforgettable.

Mount Faber Peak brings wedding decorations to a new level with an exquisite array of offerings designed to elevate every moment of your special day. Fresh floral centrepieces adorn each table, including two special arrangements for VIP tables, while elegant floral stands grace the stage or aisle, creating an ambience of natural beauty and sophistication. Specially adorned VIP tables and chairs, complete with complimentary seat covers, welcome guests with grace and charm. The highlight of the décor is the elegant five-tier model wedding ceremonial cake, a piece that adds grandeur to the occasion. The champagne pyramid, accompanied by a complimentary bottle of champagne for toasting, adds sparkle and effervescence to the celebrations. Last but not least, the march-in is enhanced by a mesmerising dry ice effect.

![Image 11: Preferred Banquet Venues – Mount Faber Peak ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240709/20240709094816_83302.jpg)

In addition to the stunning décor, Mount Faber Peak offers an array of privileges to enhance your wedding experience. Couples enjoy complimentary wedding invitation cards, a choice of wedding favours for all confirmed guests, and a stylish red packet box and guest book for the reception table! Lastly, the VIP bridal car lot and complimentary valet parking, along with a complimentary two-way 49-seat coach service, add convenience and luxury to the celebration.

In essence, Mount Faber Peak stands as a testament to elegance and natural allure, deserving its recognition as the Editor's Choice Award for Preferred Banquet Venues, with its breathtaking views and impeccable services. Don't miss the opportunity to create unforgettable memories at Mount Faber Peak, where every detail has been carefully curated and prepared for your special day. Join the ranks of delighted couples and choose Mount Faber Peak as your dream wedding destination today!

# Dive into Forever: Exchange Vows at a One-of-A-Kind Solemnisation Venue, The Robertson House

 2024-07-09

A calm, radiant and historically significant oasis tucked in Central Singapore. The best kept secret for your momentous occasion.

The Robertson House by The Crest Collection is situated at the heart of bustling Clarke Quay, where important commodity trades once took place along the Singapore River. By carefully preserving a piece of history through its sleek monochrome interior, The Robertson House hopes to provide guests with a refreshing experience through its meticulously designed rooms and event facilities, complemented by warm hospitality.

![Image 6: Dive into Forever: Exchange Vows at a One-of-A-Kind Solemnisation Venue, The Robertson House](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708140635_13131.jpg)

![Image 7: Dive into Forever: Exchange Vows at a One-of-A-Kind Solemnisation Venue, The Robertson House](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708140643_26396.jpg)

### Poolside Promises

Beyond timeless narratives, The Robertson House by The Crest Collection is the refined venue perfect for your intimate solemnisations and cosy soirées at sunset.

![Image 8: Dive into Forever: Exchange Vows at a One-of-A-Kind Solemnisation Venue, The Robertson House](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708140708_82642.jpg)

Robertson 4, the main function room of The Robertson House, boasts a fresh semi-outdoor concept which enables guests to enjoy the best of both worlds. Witness the couple exchange promises which last a lifetime in the cool comfort of a sophistically decorated function room, as sunlight dances across brilliant blue waters beyond the floor-to-ceiling windows.

![Image 9: Dive into Forever: Exchange Vows at a One-of-A-Kind Solemnisation Venue, The Robertson House](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708140724_39773.jpg)
This once-in-a-lifetime occasion deserves only to be captured in the best light. Step out onto the wooden pool deck with your partner in hand, with radiant early morning rays or crimson hues of sunset serving as the perfect complement for immaculate outfits and wide smiles.

![Image 10: Dive into Forever: Exchange Vows at a One-of-A-Kind Solemnisation Venue, The Robertson House](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708140738_18477.jpg)
### Familiar Recipes with a Delightful Twist

After the solemnization ceremony, adjourn for a delightful dining experience by Entrepôt, The Robertson House’s signature restaurant. Curate tantalising dishes according to the tastes of you and your guests. For the adventurous, seize the opportunity to feature a novel memu which will definitely be the talk of the town.

The team behind Entrepôt is committed to ensure a wonderful and exotic dining experience for your special occasion. Entrepôt’s menu showcases a unique medley of Anglo-Asian culinary excellence, where familiar Asian flavours meet European influences in perfect harmony. Besides using premium cuts of meat, freshest catches of the sea and seasonal produce, even the simplest ingredients are elevated. The wonderful fusion of flavours culminates in enticing dishes, which are spin-offs from local favourites such as _Claypot Rice_ and _Satay._

Relax and clink wine glasses under the city lights, as attentive servers ensure that your needs are well taken care of.

![Image 11: Dive into Forever: Exchange Vows at a One-of-A-Kind Solemnisation Venue, The Robertson House](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708140755_81440.jpg)
### Make your One-of-A-Kind Wedding a Reality

With its unique combination of beautiful waters under a clear sky, The Robertson House by The Crest Collection presents itself as the perfect location to begin the next phase of your life with your other half.

With The Robertson House by The Crest Collection’s recent soft-opening, register for your solemnisation by 31 March 2024 to enjoy a 2D1N anniversary stay in the stunning Panoramic Room and a delectable breakfast for two.
