# The Secret to Radiant, Wedding-Ready Hair: Beijing 101’s Signature Hair & Scalp Treatment

 2025-03-01

![Image 6: The Secret to Radiant, Wedding-Ready Hair: Beijing 101’s Signature Hair & Scalp Treatment](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250227/20250227150819_90639.jpg)

For nearly three decades, **Beijing 101** has been transforming the landscape of hair and scalp care in Singapore. Since 1998, this renowned establishment has helped countless individuals tackle their hair concerns through a unique fusion of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) and contemporary technology. As couples prepare for their wedding day, Beijing 101 stands ready to ensure they walk down the aisle with confidence. Read on for more.

### The Wedding Hair Dilemma

![Image 7: The Secret to Radiant, Wedding-Ready Hair: Beijing 101’s Signature Hair & Scalp Treatment](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250227/20250227150834_92934.jpg)

A wedding is one of life’s biggest moments, and while much effort goes into choosing the perfect dress and flawless makeup, hair health often gets overlooked — until the stress kicks in. Late nights, planning pressures, and last-minute adjustments can wreak havoc on hair and scalp health, leading to thinning, dullness, or excessive shedding.

Their **Meridian Hair Growth Treatment** blends Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) with modern hair therapy to help couples achieve stronger, healthier hair just in time for their big day. Whether you’re dealing with stress-related shedding, lacklustre locks, or simply want to enhance your hair’s natural vitality, this treatment offers a targeted and deeply restorative solution.

### What to Expect: The Meridian Hair Growth Treatment

The treatment follows a **multi-step, deeply nourishing process** designed to cleanse, revitalise, and stimulate hair growth.

![Image 8: The Secret to Radiant, Wedding-Ready Hair: Beijing 101’s Signature Hair & Scalp Treatment](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250227/20250227151217_60849.jpg)

**●Customised Mask:** The scalp is prepped with a gentle yet effective mask that removes accumulated oil, dirt, and bacteria — key culprits of hair thinning.

![Image 9: The Secret to Radiant, Wedding-Ready Hair: Beijing 101’s Signature Hair & Scalp Treatment](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250227/20250227151229_44941.jpg)

**● Meridian Hair Wash:**Inspired by TCM principles, this wash enhances scalp health and strengthens hair vitality.

![Image 10: The Secret to Radiant, Wedding-Ready Hair: Beijing 101’s Signature Hair & Scalp Treatment](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250227/20250227151306_64397.jpg)

![Image 11: The Secret to Radiant, Wedding-Ready Hair: Beijing 101’s Signature Hair & Scalp Treatment](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250227/20250227151320_93394.jpg)

**● Medi Air Jet + Herbal Plus Anti-Hair Loss Lotion:** A high-pressure air device ensures the active ingredients penetrate deeply into the scalp, delivering a potent blend of **Chili, Ginger, Ginkgo, and Mint** to combat hair loss and strengthen roots.

![Image 12: The Secret to Radiant, Wedding-Ready Hair: Beijing 101’s Signature Hair & Scalp Treatment](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250227/20250227151346_17428.jpg)

**●****Meridian Scalp Massage:** This 20-minute massage is a powerhouse technique that **dredges meridians, increases oxygen supply, and enhances follicle function**for thicker, stronger hair. As a bonus,it also helps with headaches, sleep quality, and overall brain health.

![Image 13: The Secret to Radiant, Wedding-Ready Hair: Beijing 101’s Signature Hair & Scalp Treatment](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250227/20250227151356_56280.jpg)

****●**Alpha Hair Beam:** Using **low-light therapy**, this non-invasive step stimulates the scalp at a cellular level, encouraging hair growth and improving overall scalp health.

### The Science of TCM-Inspired Hair Care

![Image 14: The Secret to Radiant, Wedding-Ready Hair: Beijing 101’s Signature Hair & Scalp Treatment](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250227/20250227151418_49942.jpg)

Beijing 101’s approach isn’t just about surface-level results; it starts at the root — literally. Their treatment focuses on stimulating blood circulation, balancing the body's natural energy flow, and delivering potent nutrients directly to the scalp. The **Meridian Scalp Massage**, a highlight of the treatment, applies the principles of TCM to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and optimise the scalp environment for hair growth. Many clients report improved sleep, reduced tension, and a noticeable boost in overall well-being after a session.

But it’s not all about tradition — Beijing 101 pairs TCM wisdom with advanced hair growth technology. Their cutting-edge scalp-boosting devices, low-level light therapy, and herbal extraction technology ensure that every strand receives maximum nourishment without any strong herbal scent. According to an Ipsos study conducted in February 2024, Beijing 101’s treatments were rated as the most effective for hair and scalp concerns among 220 respondents.

### The TCM Difference: More Than Just Hair Care

![Image 15: The Secret to Radiant, Wedding-Ready Hair: Beijing 101’s Signature Hair & Scalp Treatment](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250227/20250227151440_72870.jpg)

Hair health in TCM isn’t just about what’s happening on the surface — it’s linked to the balance of Qi and blood circulation, as well as the health of key organs like the kidneys, liver, and spleen. Beijing 101’s premium-grade herbs, including Ginseng, Dang Gui, and He Shou Wu, nourish these vital organs, ensuring a stronger foundation for long-term hair growt h.

Their customised treatment plans address a range of concerns, from early-stage hair thinning to chronic scalp issues. With over 50 years of expertise, Beijing 101 has helped countless individuals restore confidence through personalised, results-driven care.

Beyond the hair-strengthening benefits, this treatment offers a shared, stress-relieving experience for couples. Wedding planning can be intense — taking time out for a relaxing yet effective self-care session not only ensures you both look fantastic on the big day but also helps you unwind together.

### Your Wedding Hair, Upgraded

![Image 16: The Secret to Radiant, Wedding-Ready Hair: Beijing 101’s Signature Hair & Scalp Treatment](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250227/20250227151454_88197.jpg)

In celebration of love and luscious locks, Beijing 101 is offering an **exclusive trial session**:

*   **Meridian Hair Growth Treatment for $50 (U.P. $724)**
*   **FREE $10 Starbucks Gift Card**
*   **Complimentary Scalp Analysis**to understand your hair and scalp health in detail

This promotion is open to first-time Singaporean/PR customers or valid pass holders aged 21+. Limited slots available — secure yours now via **[this link](https://bit.ly/101xBBxFreeStarbucks)** or **WhatsApp****[here](https://bit.ly/101xBBxFresStarbucksxWA)**.

Whether you’re dealing with hair concerns or simply want to enhance your natural glow, Beijing 101’s TCM-powered treatments offer a science-backed, deeply relaxing solution. Because on your wedding day, every detail matters — including your hair.

Make sure yours is thicker, healthier, and wedding-photo ready with **Beijing 101**.

# Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day

 2024-07-08

Vendor:[Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/15/restaurants/detail/1249/jumbo-restaurant)

![Image 6: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115540_98096.jpg)

_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

Marriage is a momentous occasion for all involved, from the couple at the centre of it all to your loved ones. As you prepare to embark on a new and exciting chapter of your life, Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine promises to deliver an experience that exudes understated refinement and classic elegance with overtones of traditional Chinese décor and delicate, light and heartwarming culinary dishes. With Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine’s catering expertise, you can be assured that every step of your wedding banquet will be an enjoyable experience.

### Choose From a Range of Stunning Venues

At Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine, you’re spoilt for choices with the four ballrooms available for weddings. If you’re keen on a grand wedding to accommodate all your loved ones, go for the bright and spacious **Amber Hall** capable of holding up to 24 banquet tables.

![Image 7: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115607_38239.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

On the other hand, if you’d prefer a smaller and more intimate ceremony, the **Beryl Hall** is perfect for you. Capable of holding 14 banquet tables, its smaller area lends itself to creating a cosier atmosphere where you can really soak in and enjoy the company of those most important to you on your important day.

![Image 8: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115633_59785.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

Alternatively, for those looking for a grand venue large enough to hold massive celebrations and a great number of guests there to witness your love, the **Amber Hall and Beryl Hall** can be combined into a majestic ballroom capable of holding up to 42 tables. You can be sure with this option that there will be ample space for all those special and dear to you!

![Image 9: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115652_40546.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

For those looking to add extra oomph with their wedding decorations, the **Celestine Hall**, which holds up to 18 banquet tables, allows for flower standees to be arranged along the aisle to add a refreshing pop of colour to your wedding. Picture yourself taking each step down the aisle towards your future while flanked by the fragrance of the beautiful flowers.

![Image 10](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115710_59707.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

![Image 11: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115726_91402.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

If you’re looking for ultimate privacy and a space just big enough to hold your closest family and friends, you can consider the **VIP private rooms**. Available for use with a minimum spend, enjoy a dedicated butler service and delicious Teochew dishes in utmost comfort and privacy.

![Image 12: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115749_73092.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

### Transform Your Venue to the Ballroom of Your Dreams

Regardless of which venue you choose, they’ll need to be absolutely decked out and decorated to give that extra oomph to your wedding. Opt for one of Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine’s three decoration packages and entrust your venue to the hands of their team of expert wedding stylists. From the **Pretty Pastel** theme which offers light and bright colours for a whimsical wedding, to the **Boho Bliss** theme of warm and cosy beige shades for an elegant setting and the **Scarlet Romance** theme which will have your chosen ballroom decked out in the passionate red and pink shades of love, turn your venue into the one of your dreams under the expertise of Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine and their team of wedding stylists.

### Serve up the best of the best Teochew dishes for your banquet

What’s a wedding without the banquet dinner? Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine specialises in creating iconic Teochew classics, taking familiar homely tastes to the next level in flavours and textures. Highlights from the wedding menu span from a delicate steamed pomfret to a stunning wok-fried mud crab, from a crisp-skinned yet succulent roasted suckling pig to a luxuriously smooth yam paste. Experience a variety of flavours and textures with each dish you eat to create an elevated oriental dining experience.

![Image 13: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115826_44346.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

![Image 14: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115842_11364.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

Choose from 3 different 8-course menus with different price points and dishes available. With the range of menu options, there’s sure to be the perfect lineup of dishes at your price preference!

### The Bliss Menu

The Bliss Menu comes in at $899++ per table of 10 guests and offers delicacies like Pig Trotter Terrine as part of a Combination Platter as well as the Teochew ‘Puning’ Fermented Bean Chicken.

![Image 15: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115903_43893.jpg)

_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

![Image 16: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115920_88833.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

### The Everlasting Menu

The Everlasting Menu, priced at $1,299++ per table of 10 guests, shares similar dishes with the Bliss Menu but made with elevated ingredients to offer the ultimate eating experience for you and your guests. Some dishes on this menu include the Braised Duck with Beancurd and Wok Fried Shelled King Prawn with Golden Salted Egg.

![Image 17: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115939_14128.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

![Image 18: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115954_92493.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

### The Celestial Menu

Coming in at the price tag of $1,699++ per table of 10 guests, expect to be stunned by the most exquisite and splendid dishes that Teochew cuisine has to offer as they are brought to your table one by one. Among these iconic and show-stopping dishes are the Roasted Suckling Pig Marinated with Five Spices and Teochew Superior Shark’s Fin Soup, in Claypot Style to wow your taste buds and weave a truly unforgettable dining experience.

![Image 19: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708120012_18936.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

![Image 20: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708120031_63200.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

### The Vegetarian Menu

Fret not if you have special dietary requirements for your banquet! Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine has a unique vegetarian menu composed of vegetarian dishes for only an additional $88++ per person. No pork no lard menus are also available on request to accommodate any and every eating preference!

### Craft the Wedding of Your Dreams in Tradition

At Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine, their menus feature a repertoire of authentic Teochew delicacies, using only the freshest ingredients and purest methods of preparation. As you celebrate your love and the future ahead, feast on the epitome of Teochew dishes that pays tribute to the long-standing culinary traditions of one of Singapore’s founding Chinese dialect groups at your wedding banquet. With Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine’s expertise in wedding banquets, the wedding of your dreams will be a truly unforgettable experience for you and your family.

### Our Services

Seletar Country Club is a haven of peace and tranquillity set right in the heart of the countryside. With rolling acres of lush greenery, it is strategically located on a hill overlooking the Lower Seletar Reservoir and the Johor Straits.

 Established circa 1930, Seletar Country Club has been distinguished as a wonderful mix of fine private club and leisure cluster rolled into one. Thus, it strives to protect and enhance the natural surrounds, while continually becoming a home to one of the finest golfing, sports and social activities in the country. It has been designed and built to complement the eco-habitat of various species of flora and fauna. Aside from its highly-coveted club membership, 18-hole gem that presents infinite challenges, and a breath-taking view of serenity, Seletar Country Club is more than just a golf club. It also features a beautiful club house, private hilltop jacuzzi overlooking a beautiful landscaped swimming pool, dance studio, bowling centre, and an integrated sports and recreational complex complete with a gym and activity rooms. There is also an excellent Seletar Terrace and Seletar Tavern with sumptuous food and great music, set in a cosy atmosphere.

 At Seletar Country Club, let your guests bask in relaxing resort ambience. The tranquil environment ensures that everyone enjoys a comfortable time and to be in their best mood. Be it for weddings, parties, corporate golf games, retreats, seminars and other sporting activities, its facility and service offerings surpass all. The rustic countryside setting illuminated by the chirping of the birds, trickling sound of water and vast green pastures can only be the perfect place for the event of your lifetime. Seletar Country Club has it all to make your wedding and solemnization celebrations an endearing and meaningful one.Whether it is a casual garden party or an elaborate pompous affair, the Club’s team of energetic and creative staff is ever ready to help create your dream wedding. Complementing the Club’s countryside charm is the legendary friendly Seletarian spirit. Whether you are a member or guest, the warmth and fellowship of Seletar members and staff awaits you!

# Seletar Country Club: Where Your Wedding Dreams Take Flight 

 2024-02-19

![Image 5: Seletar Country Club: Where Your  Wedding Dreams Take Flight ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240219/20240219091418_66938.jpg)

_Source: @Seletar Country Club_

Imagine saying your vows with the sun setting over the Seletar Reservoir, casting a golden glow on the water, and the lush greenery creating a picturesque backdrop. Seletar Country Club is not just a venue; it's a canvas where your dreams take flight. Let's delve into why this location stands out as the ideal choice for couples seeking a stunning and romantic wedding experience.

### A Picturesque Backdrop

![Image 6: Seletar Country Club: Where Your  Wedding Dreams Take Flight ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240219/20240219091505_74255.jpg)

_Source: @Seletar Country Club_

At the heart of Seletar Country Club lies a tapestry of beauty, with the Seletar Reservoir playing the starring role. As the sun sets, casting its golden glow upon the water, and the lush greenery envelops the surroundings, the reservoir becomes more than just a view – it becomes a magical, living canvas for your special day. The elegant architecture seamlessly woven into the landscape adds a touch of sophistication, creating an atmosphere of timeless romance that will linger in the memories of all who attend.

### The Grand Ballroom

For couples in search of a chic and unforgettable venue to commemorate their love, Seletar Country Club introduces an opulent grand ballroom that imparts a sense of sophistication to your momentous day.

![Image 7: Seletar Country Club: Where Your  Wedding Dreams Take Flight ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240219/20240219091555_63167.jpg)

_Source: @Seletar Country Club_

This remarkable location is meticulously crafted, providing a flexible and adaptable space tailored to suit your distinct vision. With the capacity to comfortably seat up to 240 individuals, you'll have the freedom to extend invitations to all your cherished guests, ensuring a joyous celebration for everyone involved.

### Intimate Celebration

Seletar Country Club extends a warm invitation to couples seeking a venue for their wedding celebration, where the focus is on sharing the joy with their closest friends and family.

![Image 8: Seletar Country Club: Where Your Wedding Dreams Take Flight ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240219/20240219154100_53883.jpg)

_Source: @Seletar Country Club_

From the combination of Heron I and Heron 2 rooms, accommodating up to 80 guests, to the exclusive Kingfisher Room, perfect for intimate solemnisations with a capacity for 40 guests, Seletar Country Club ensures a diverse array of options to suit every couple's unique preferences.

![Image 9: Seletar Country Club: Where Your Wedding Dreams Take Flight ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240219/20240219154110_48442.jpg)

_Source: @Seletar Country Club_

Irrespective of the celebration's scale, the club guarantees a space that aligns perfectly with the couple's needs, promising an unforgettable experience for all involved.

### A Stress-Free Journey: The Plan

![Image 10: Seletar Country Club: Where Your  Wedding Dreams Take Flight ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240219/20240219091827_92966.jpg)

_Source: @Seletar Country Club_

Planning a wedding can be overwhelming, but Seletar Country Club's experienced and dedicated team is there to make it a seamless and stress-free journey. From catering to decor, and wedding planning services, they take care of every detail, allowing you to focus on savoring every moment. Your wedding day is one of the most important days of your life, and Seletar Country Club is committed to ensuring it's flawless.

### More Than a Venue: The Experience

![Image 11: Seletar Country Club: Where Your  Wedding Dreams Take Flight ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240219/20240219091910_74016.jpg)

_Source: @Seletar_ _Country Club_

Seletar Country Club is more than just a beautiful location; it's a place where dreams come true. The magic of the venue lies not only in its scenic views and versatile spaces but also in the commitment to creating unforgettable moments. The staff understands the significance of your special day and feels honoured to be a part of it. Seletar Country Club isn't just a venue; it's an experience that transcends expectations.

### Embark on Your Journey Today!

Seletar Country Club invites you to experience the magic for yourself. Schedule a tour and let the ambience, the views, and the dedicated team sweep you off your feet. # A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel

 2025-03-19

![Image 6: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151235_83592.jpg)

Located along Singapore's iconic shopping beltstands a landmark that has witnessed countless love stories unfold within its walls — each one as unique as the couples themselves.

Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel's distinctive octagonal pagoda-inspired architecture makes it instantly recognisable on the Orchard Road skyline. While its exterior may be familiar to many, it's what happens inside that transforms this urban retreat into a canvas for extraordinary celebrations. Here, amidst the bustling city, couples will find a sanctuary where their unique vision comes alive through attention and meticulous detail.

If that sounds right up your alley, then read on to find out more.

### A Wedding Venue Like No Other

![Image 7: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151305_59700.jpg)

The hotel boasts 12 versatile spaces that can accommodate celebrations ranging from intimate gatherings of 30 guests to grand affairs with up to 500 guests.

For couples seeking a more intimate setting, The Gallery on Level 2 offers a charming venue that can host up to 140 guests. Its rustic wedding theme, decorated with coral and chestnut orange hues of lilies, roses, poppies, and stunning fairy lights, creates a warm and inviting atmosphere for your celebration.

At the centre of their offering, however, is the stunning Grand Ballroom, a magnificent space featuring a glittering 5-metre alabaster marble ceiling that overlooks 7,600 square feet of pillarless space. This design creates an uninterrupted view of your celebration, ensuring every guest feels connected to your special moment.

### Personalised Themes to Match Your Vision

What sets Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel apart is their collection of six enchanting wedding themes, each meticulously designed to bring specific wedding dreams to life.

**Blissful Grandeur**: An ethereal display of roses, hydrangeas, and eucalyptus creates a romantic ambience filled with rustic-chic and autumn colour palettes.

![Image 8: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151343_14288.jpg)![Image 9: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151355_52477.jpg)

**Blooms of Love**: A minimalist yet modern theme, surrounded by delicate champagne eustomas, peach and blush pink roses for couples who appreciate elegant simplicity.

![Image 10: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151414_97923.jpg)![Image 11: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151424_30897.jpg)

**Elegant Scarlet**: Adorned with peonies and red roses symbolising love, commitment, and happiness, this theme transforms your wedding ceremony with bold, passionate colours.

![Image 12: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151442_32891.jpg)![Image 13: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151452_36030.jpg)

**Enchanted Wonderland**: Enter a magical forest world where baby's breath, sweet pink roses, and candlelight create a whimsical setting for two hearts to become one.

![Image 14: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151509_49159.jpg)![Image 15: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151520_21185.jpg)

**Eternal Dazzle**: A dreamy paradise of delicate roses with purple, pink, and white hues of baby's breath — a breathtaking theme that captivates the senses.

![Image 16: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151617_54306.jpg)![Image 17: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151626_79545.jpg)

**Pink Fairytale**: Immerse yourself in pure bliss with blush pink roses, eustomas, and eucalyptus symbolising happiness and joy in this magical atmosphere.

![Image 18: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151644_97260.jpg)![Image 19: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151652_79633.jpg)

### Expert Planning for Flawless Execution

Behind every successful wedding at Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel are their Marriott Certified Wedding Planners. These professionals have completed demanding coursework and are qualified to coordinate weddings of all types, including ethnic and military ceremonies.

As the saying goes, dream weddings don't just happen — they're planned. Their experienced team helps determine an overall vision for your wedding and execute each detail meticulously. From setting an event budget to deciding on menu options, arranging table settings, and finding florists, photographers, and entertainment, these planners handle it all with expertise born from experience, training, tradition, and intuition.

This seamless coordination continues through to the big day itself, with dedicated event hosts taking care of every detail so you can focus on enjoying your celebration. Their comprehensive service ensures that nothing is left to chance.

### Culinary Excellence to Impress Your Guests

![Image 20: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151736_21521.jpg)

Food is often one of the most remembered aspects of any wedding, and Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel exceeds expectations with its culinary offerings. Guests can savour authentic and classic Cantonese cuisines presented by the award-winning Wan Hao Chinese Restaurant.

Using only premium and the freshest ingredients, their repertoire of specially curated masterpieces displays exquisite workmanship and ingenuity.

![Image 21: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151818_53501.jpg)

For those requiring Halal options, their Halal-certified banquet kitchen offers a delectable menu featuring international cuisines that satisfy any palate. To ensure your complete satisfaction, the hotel provides private food tasting sessions, giving you an accurate sense of what to expect on your wedding day.

### Picture-Perfect Moments

Every couple wants stunning photographs to commemorate their special day, and Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel offers several picturesque spots for capturing these precious moments. The charming mini garden on Level 4 provides a serene and lush backdrop that feels like an oasis in the city centre. Other popular locations include the outdoor pool area, guest room corridor, and the hotel's forecourt — all perfect settings to create beautiful memories.

### Promotions and Packages for Your Special Day

But the celebration doesn't end with the reception. Each wedding couple receives special in-room amenities, including a bottle of champagne, a 250g chocolate fudge cake, chocolate-dipped strawberries, and chocolate pralines — sweet touches that make your stay even more memorable.

With packages to suit different preferences and budgets, Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel offers options for both intimate celebrations and grand affairs:

**Intimate Wedding Packages:**

*    7-Course Chinese Wedding Lunch: From $1,388.00++ per table (10 guests) 
*    8-Course Chinese Wedding Dinner: From $1,488.00++ per table (10 guests) 

**Grand Ballroom Dinner Package:**

*    8-Course Chinese Wedding Dinner (Weekend Pricing: Friday, Saturday, Sunday, Eve of Public Holidays, and Public Holidays): From $1,988.00++ per table (10 guests) 

### Your Dream Wedding Awaits at Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel

![Image 22: A Spectacular Setting for Your Special Day: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250318/20250318151948_96397.jpg)

From its prime location to its impeccable service, exquisite décor, and gourmet dining, Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel is a venue that delivers on all fronts. To secure your preferred wedding date at this sought-after venue, couples are advised to book 1 to 1.5 years in advance.

From the moment you begin planning until the last dance of the night, **Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel** is committed to making your celebration as unique and special as your love story.

# Beauty Hope: The Wedding-Ready Glow You Deserve

 2025-03-12

Vendor:[BeautyHope](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/1/beauty-wellness/detail/1253/beautyhope)

![Image 6: Beauty Hope: The Wedding-Ready Glow You Deserve](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311172651_81854.jpg)

Eighteen years in the beauty industry isn’t just a number — it’s a testament to trust. Beauty Hope has spent nearly two decades perfecting the art of skincare and wellness, earning a reputation as a go-to sanctuary for radiant, healthy skin and rejuvenation. It’s not just about facials and treatments; it’s about a philosophy of care that has won over four generations of loyal clients. When it comes to pre-wedding skincare and wellness, that kind of experience matters.

### One-Stop Skin and Wellness Solution, Tailored to You

![Image 7: Beauty Hope: The Wedding-Ready Glow You Deserve](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311172711_98931.jpg)

No two skin types are the same, and Beauty Hope understands that better than anyone. Their expert team offers free one-on-one consultations to assess your skin’s unique needs and customise a treatment plan that works for you.

![Image 8: Beauty Hope: The Wedding-Ready Glow You Deserve](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311172724_79690.jpg)

Furthermore, Beauty Hope takes a holistic approach to skincare, offering a comprehensive range of treatments designed to rejuvenate, hydrate, and enhance your natural glow. From gentle, hydrating facials to advanced microneedling and high-tech oxygen treatments, their specialists craft personalised regimens to address every skin concern — whether it's dullness, fine lines, or uneven tone. The result? A radiant, wedding-ready complexion that looks effortless (even if the planning wasn’t).

### The Wedding-Ready Must-Try Treatments

![Image 9: Beauty Hope: The Wedding-Ready Glow You Deserve](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311172744_10217.jpg)

For brides (and grooms) looking to achieve flawless skin, Beauty Hope offers a range of expert treatments. Their **Diamond Peel Facial** is a favourite for refining texture and evening out skin tone, while the **Jet Peel Facial** infuses pure oxygen to deeply cleanse and hydrate. Those looking for next-level results might opt for the **Micro Needle Treatment**, designed to stimulate collagen production and create lasting smoothness.

Struggling with tired eyes from all those late-night seating chart revisions? The **Genosys Eye Cell Treatment** targets dark circles and puffiness, ensuring you look fresh and well-rested on the big day.

### More Than Just Skin Deep

![Image 10: Beauty Hope: The Wedding-Ready Glow You Deserve](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311172805_69455.jpg)

Beauty Hope isn’t just about treatments; it’s about confidence. Their philosophy is rooted in the belief that beauty isn’t about perfection — it’s about embracing and enhancing what’s already there. By combining expert techniques with state-of-the-art technology, they help clients achieve real, lasting results without gimmicks or empty promises.

### Special Offers for Brides-to-Be (and Grooms!)

![Image 11: Beauty Hope: The Wedding-Ready Glow You Deserve](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311172824_92472.jpg)

Quality skincare shouldn’t cost as much as the wedding itself. Beauty Hope balances expertise with affordability, ensuring top-tier treatments are within reach. For couples looking to unwind together, they also offer exclusive promotions — because self-care is always better when shared.

In celebration of love (and good skincare), Beauty Hope is offering these special wedding-ready promotions:

*   **1 Customised Facial Voucher:** $28 
*   **2 Customised Facial Vouchers:**$40 (Save $16) 
*   **1 x 45-min Body Pai Suan Wellness Voucher:** $68

_(Prices exclude 9% GST)_

### Visit Beauty Hope Today!

With locations across Singapore, Beauty Hope makes it easy to schedule a pampering session amid the wedding chaos. Whether you’re looking for a quick refresh or an in-depth skin transformation, their team is ready to help you achieve that sought-after bridal glow.

**Locations:**

Whether you’re preparing for your wedding or simply indulging in well-deserved self-care, their expert team ensures you leave feeling refreshed, rejuvenated, and ready to shine. **Beauty Hope** isn’t just about skincare — it’s about feeling your best from the inside out.

# The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love 

 2025-03-11

Vendor:[ALUXE](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/11/jewellery-accessories/detail/1203/aluxe)

![Image 5: The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311153606_46512.jpg)

Few things capture the essence of love quite like a diamond. For over 40 years, **ALUXE** has been perfecting the art of selecting and crafting these timeless gems, earning its place as Taiwan’s leading wedding jewellery brand. Now, Singaporean couples can experience the same expertise and dedication, with ALUXE’s dazzling collection of diamonds and wedding rings designed to mark life’s most cherished moments.

As one of Taiwan’s largest diamond importers, ALUXE sources directly from the top three diamond-cutting factories worldwide, bypassing unnecessary middlemen. The result? Premium diamonds at competitive prices, ensuring couples get the most brilliance for their budget. With some of the best diamond prices in Singapore, ALUXE ensures couples get maximum brilliance for their budget, making luxury more accessible than ever.

### A Bespoke Experience

![Image 6: The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311153622_93848.jpg)

Every love story is unique, and the ring that symbolises it should be too. ALUXE offers full customisation with thousands of ring designs, styles, and settings to explore, ensuring every couple finds their perfect match. From classic solitaires to intricate halo designs, the possibilities are endless. With expert guidance at every step, ALUXE helps bring dream rings to life, crafting one-of-a-kind masterpieces that truly reflect each couple’s journey.

Beyond design, the experience itself is seamless. ALUXE’s consultants provide warm, personalised guidance, making every step of the process enjoyable and stress-free. Their expertise extends beyond diamonds, so whether couples need proposal tips or jewellery care advice, ALUXE is there to assist.

### Custom-Crafted Brilliance: The ALUXE Diamond Advantage

![Image 7: The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311153707_85083.jpg)

Whether you are looking for a natural diamond or a lab-grown diamond, ALUXE's dedication to quality, transparency, and innovation ensures that you find the perfect one. Not all diamonds are created equal, and ALUXE makes no compromises when it comes to quality. Every diamond in its collection is graded D to F in colour — the purest, most colorless standard—so each stone radiates unparalleled brilliance.

And for those who want the perfect balance of quality and convenience, ALUXE’s **Instant Diamond Selection** ensures a hassle-free experience. With real-time access to over 30,000 diamonds, customers can select their ideal piece with confidence, viewing every detail through a 360° high-resolution display. A direct connection with suppliers guarantees diamonds are always in stock, with transparent pricing updated in real time — no hidden mark-ups, just the best value for the best diamonds. Those in a hurry can choose from a wide range of ready-to-go options and walk away with their dream piece the same day, while pre-orders are guaranteed for delivery within two months.

ALUXE’s commitment to **competitive pricing without compromise** ensures that luxury remains accessible. By sourcing directly from the world’s leading diamond-cutting factories, ALUXE eliminates unnecessary middlemen and passes those savings directly to customers. As one of Taiwan’s largest diamond importers, ALUXE has the power to negotiate unbeatable prices, offering some of the best diamond prices in Singapore. Whether it’s a first-time purchase or an addition to a growing collection, customers receive the highest quality at the most competitive price.

### Certified Excellence & Distinctive Elegance

![Image 8: The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311153744_77354.jpg)

Every ALUXE diamond is backed by internationally recognised certification. Natural diamonds are GIA-certified, ensuring authenticity, ethical sourcing, and precise grading of cut, colour, clarity, and carat weight. Lab-grown diamonds come with IGI certification, guaranteeing the same brilliance and quality. But ALUXE goes even further. By introducing the Ultimate Diamond, ALUXE sets a new benchmark in excellence. Using advanced diamond technology, these gems undergo scientific evaluation for brilliance, fire, scintillation, and optical symmetry — ensuring they are not just beautiful, but truly exceptional.

![Image 9: The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311153802_30916.jpg)

For those seeking something beyond the ordinary, ALUXE offers an extensive range of fancy-cut diamonds and rare coloured diamonds, including pink, yellow, and blue hues.

![Image 10: The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311153824_10135.jpg)

![Image 11: The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311153832_22860.jpg)

The **ROSÉ My Love collection** makes the dream of pink diamonds more attainable by pairing lab-grown pink diamonds with expert craftsmanship, offering unparalleled beauty at a price within reach. Whether it’s an engagement ring, anniversary gift, or Valentine’s Day surprise, these diamonds provide a striking alternative to traditional white stones.

![Image 12: The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311153846_90395.jpg)
Meanwhile, the **Lovers Collection** showcases elegant blue diamonds, a rarity in Singapore’s wedding jewellery scene, embodying purity and devotion.

### The ALUXE Difference

![Image 13: The Brilliance of ALUXE: Diamonds That Celebrate Love ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250311/20250311153912_28899.jpg)

With decades of expertise, a direct sourcing model, and an unwavering commitment to quality, ALUXE stands apart in the world of wedding jewellery. More than just diamonds, **ALUXE** ensures every couple walks away with a piece as enduring as their love.

Visit any ALUXE store to explore their collections. Because when it comes to celebrating love, nothing shines brighter.

# Timeless Wedding Photography For Unforgettable Moments

 2025-03-14

![Image 6: Timeless Wedding Photography For Unforgettable Moments](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250411/20250411144256_95285.jpg)

Wedding photography is sometimes overlooked in the midst of planning a big day. With so many things to consider – the dress, the venue, the flowers, the guest list – it’s easy to assume that any wedding photographer will do. You might even book the first company you come across without giving it much thought. But photography is not just about capturing moments; it’s about preserving emotions, memories, and the essence of your special day. Choosing the right photographer is crucial because their style and approach will determine how your wedding story is told.

Not all wedding photography companies are the same. Some specialise in dramatic, editorial-style shoots, while others focus on light and airy romance. There are photographers who excel in candid storytelling, while others are skilled in crafting stunning, posed portraits. If you don’t take the time to find a photographer whose style resonates with you, you might end up with wedding photos that don’t truly reflect your vision or emotions. Your wedding album should be something you look back on with joy, not regret. That’s why selecting the right photography company is just as important as any other part of your wedding planning.

### Understanding wedding photography packages

![Image 7: Timeless Wedding Photography For Unforgettable Moments](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250411/20250411144337_40032.jpg)

[Wedding photography packages](https://deals.blissfulbrides.sg/product/wedding-photoshoot-packages-jt-studio-sg/ "Wedding Photography Packages, Wedding Photography Packages Singapore ")vary significantly, and it’s essential to understand what’s included before making a decision. Some packages offer full-day coverage, capturing everything from the bridal preparations to the final dance, while others may only cover the ceremony and reception. You’ll also find packages that include engagement shoots, albums, prints, and even additional photographers for more comprehensive coverage.

A good package should align with your [wedding plans](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/wedding-tools "Wedding Planning Checklist, Wedding Planning Checklist Singapore"). If you’re having a grand wedding with multiple locations, you may need a more extensive package. On the other hand, for an intimate ceremony, a shorter coverage option might suffice. Always check if there are hidden costs, such as extra charges for additional hours, travel, or expedited editing. It’s best to discuss all details upfront so that there are no surprises later.

### Finding a photographer who matches your vision

![Image 8: Timeless Wedding Photography For Unforgettable Moments](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250411/20250411144455_20048.jpg)

When choosing a photographer, don’t just go by price or popularity. Look at their portfolio and ask yourself if their images evoke the emotions you want in your own wedding photos. Do they capture natural moments beautifully? Do their shots feel warm and authentic? Are their posed photos elegant and well-composed? These are important factors to consider.

It’s also a good idea to meet your potential photographer before booking. A great photographer will not only be skilled with the camera but will also know how to make you feel comfortable. They should be able to put you at ease, making it easier for you to be yourself in front of the lens. This connection can make a huge difference in the outcome of your wedding photos.

### The importance of a pre-wedding shoot

![Image 9: Timeless Wedding Photography For Unforgettable Moments](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250411/20250411144537_60574.jpg)

Many wedding photography packages include a pre-wedding shoot, and while it might seem like an extra expense, it can be incredibly beneficial. A pre-wedding shoot allows you to get comfortable in front of the camera, understand how your photographer works, and build rapport with them. It’s also a great opportunity to capture beautiful images of you and your partner in a relaxed setting, which can be used for invitations, wedding decor, or keepsakes.

This shoot also helps in setting expectations. You’ll get a preview of how your wedding photos might turn out and can provide feedback to your photographer. If you have any preferences or insecurities, discussing them during the pre-wedding shoot ensures that your photographer knows what to focus on (or avoid) on the big day.

### Capturing the big day – what to expect

![Image 10: Timeless Wedding Photography For Unforgettable Moments](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250411/20250411144618_49574.jpg)

Your wedding day will be filled with countless moments – some planned, others spontaneous. A good photographer will be able to capture both with ease. From the excitement of getting ready in the morning to the heartfelt vows, the laughter at the reception, and the intimate moments in between, your wedding album should tell a story.

To make sure everything goes smoothly, communicate with your photographer about must-have shots. Do you want a special picture with your grandparents? A candid moment with your bridesmaids? A dramatic sunset silhouette? Having a list of key shots ensures that nothing important is missed.

It also helps to factor in time for photos. A rushed photoshoot can lead to stress and less-than-perfect results. Set aside ample time for couple portraits and family shots. Working closely with your photographer on a timeline will make the process much smoother and enjoyable.

A well-planned schedule also contributes to a [stress-free wedding morning routine](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/trending/checklist-for-a-stress-free-wedding-morning-routine "Checklist For A Stress-Free Wedding Morning Routine"), ensuring you start the day feeling relaxed and prepared.

### Preserving your memories

![Image 11: Timeless Wedding Photography For Unforgettable Moments](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250411/20250411144734_68720.jpg)

Once your wedding is over, your photos become one of the few tangible reminders of your special day. Investing in quality prints and albums ensures that your memories are preserved for years to come. Many photography packages include custom albums, so take the time to choose a design that complements your wedding theme.

Digital images are great for sharing on social media, but nothing beats the feeling of flipping through a beautifully printed album. Consider getting high-quality prints of your favourite shots to display in your home – they serve as daily reminders of the love and joy you shared on your wedding day.

### A picture-perfect wedding starts with the right photographer

![Image 12: Timeless Wedding Photography For Unforgettable Moments](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250411/20250411144833_97369.jpg)

Wedding photography is more than just snapping pictures; it’s about capturing emotions, details, and once-in-a-lifetime moments. Taking the time to find a photographer who understands your vision and style will ensure that your wedding album is something you treasure forever.

If you’re searching for the perfect wedding photographer, Blissful Brides can help. [Get a quote today](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/get-a-quote)and find a photography package that suits your needs.

From intimate beginnings to grand celebrations, NUSS Guild Houses offer three distinctive wedding venues across campus, city, and heritage settings, each supported by experienced teams for seamless and memorable celebrations. Located within the NUS Kent Ridge campus, Kent Ridge Guild House is ideal for celebrations of up to 200 guests. Its pillarless ballroom, with high ceilings and lush greenery, offers a refined setting that photographs beautifully. A wide selection of Chinese, Halal, and international cuisines ensures an inclusive and thoughtfully curated experience. In the city centre, Suntec City Guild House provides a contemporary setting for stylish wedding dinners of up to 120 guests, complemented by refined Chinese and international set menus. For more intimate celebrations, Mandalay Guild House is a charming black-and-white bungalow nestled amid greenery, ideal for ROM ceremonies or weddings of up to 40 guests.  SINGAPORE WEDDING PORTAL GUIDE 

 DEALS FROM WEDDING VENDORS 

 Blissful Brides is an all-in-one wedding guide in Singapore that strives to help all soon-to-be-married couples turn their ideal wedding into a reality by providing the necessary tools they need. With an eclectic range of available resources on our portal, we hope that couples can enjoy an enjoyable and stress-free experience when arranging their wedding. In the wedding planning industry, Blissful Brides has gained more than 20 years of experience, thus forming a solid connection with our excellent vendors. We have many different wedding vendors you can hire, each offering variety of jewellery, venues, restaurants, and dresses options. 

 Our wedding vendors are arranged according to their provided services, allowing couples to find the resources they need quickly. All you need is to enter a particular category you are looking at to discover the range of wedding vendors in that particular category. Many of those featured on our portal has been in this industry for a long time, and have earned themselves a solid reputation. Any couple who chooses either one can rest assured that they are in good hands. Couples can also better plan their wedding with the vendors’ professional assistance. Apart from the guide to different vendors available in Singapore, our website also features wedding deals that help couples keep to their set budget when planning their wedding. 

 For couples in Singapore that need more resources when planning their wedding, Blissful Brides has a magazine that will surely help any couple plan their perfect wedding. It is filled with gorgeous pictures and informative articles; couples can get lots of inspiration from browsing through. Besides our magazine, couples can also find the resources they need by looking through our website. We have many entertaining and informative articles ranging that helps couples find solutions to different problems, from financial management, relationships, and beauty and wellness. 

 Apart from our wedding planning guides, Blissful Brides is also known for being the Blissful Outdoor Wedding Shows (BOWS) organiser. Held three times a year, the highly anticipated wedding show is lined up with many exciting programmes. There are numerous deals and discounts that couples can find from the variety of exceptional wedding planners. Being one of Singapore’s most prominent events, couples can enjoy unbeatable convenience when visiting the wedding show. Besides superb deals, couples will also receive awesome door gifts and are able to win attractive prizes during the event. 

 Blissful Brides is without a doubt a one-stop guide to all the resources you need in Singapore to plan your wedding. You may send any enquiries you might have via the “Contact Us” page for any questions. Our friendly and professional team will be happy to assist you as much as they can. 

 We look forward to helping you with your wedding planning through our resources.

# Amara Singapore: Beyond One Celebration

 2025-03-02

Vendor:[Amara Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/9/hotels/detail/492/amara-singapore)

![Image 6: Amara Singapore: Beyond One Celebration](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250227/20250227155858_62201.jpg)

Nestled in the heart of vibrant Tanjong Pagar, Amara Singapore stands as a beacon of elegance and sophistication for couples seeking the perfect wedding venue. With its recent transformation, this iconic hotel has ushered in a new era of celebration, seamlessly blending modern luxury with timeless charm.

### An Elegant Setting for Your Love Story

![Image 7: Amara Singapore: Beyond One Celebration](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250227/20250227155906_11113.jpg)

The crowning jewel of Amara Singapore's renovation is undoubtedly the breathtaking Grand Ballroom. This column-free space boasts a spectacular 38-metre-long aisle, perfect for those dreaming of a grand entrance. Inspired by the diverse shophouse facades of Tanjong Pagar, the ballroom exudes an air of grandeur and warmth that will captivate up to 400 guests.

But what truly sets this venue apart is its versatility. The neutral palette serves as a blank canvas, allowing couples to bring their unique vision to life. Floor-to-ceiling windows bathe the space in natural light, creating an airy and romantic atmosphere. For those seeking a truly immersive experience, the ballroom features a stunning 7.6-metre-long LED video wall, perfect for showcasing your love story in cinematic style.

### Intimate Celebrations and Pre-Wedding Festivities

![Image 8: Amara Singapore: Beyond One Celebration](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250227/20250227155915_60272.jpg)

While the Grand Ballroom steals the spotlight, Amara Singapore offers a range of spaces to accommodate every aspect of your wedding journey. The four elegantly appointed Connection rooms are ideal for intimate ceremonies, rehearsal dinners, or pre-wedding gatherings. Each space boasts state-of-the-art audiovisual amenities and flexible seating arrangements, ensuring a tailored experience for your special moments.

### A Foyer That Flows with Celebration

![Image 9: Amara Singapore: Beyond One Celebration](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250227/20250227155924_42154.jpg)

Central to the Grand Ballroom and Connection rooms, the newly redesigned foyer serves as the perfect prelude to your wedding festivities. This contemporary space features built-in amenity counters and modular seating that can be customised to suit your needs. The emerald tiling creates a striking first impression, whilst plush armchairs and sofas offer a welcoming atmosphere for mingling guests.

For those seeking a touch of additional glamour, look no further than 'The Locale'. This charming neighbourhood bar, situated at the heart of the conference area, can provide everything from mid-morning coffees to celebratory cocktails, ensuring your wedding day flows seamlessly from ceremony to reception.

### Your Dream Wedding Curated with Care and Expertise

![Image 10: Amara Singapore: Beyond One Celebration](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250227/20250227155936_52152.jpg)

As one of the first hotels in Tanjong Pagar, Amara Singapore has a storied history of hosting memorable events. Now, with its stunning transformation, the hotel is poised to create a new legacy of love stories. The dedicated events team brings a wealth of experience and passion to every wedding, ensuring that your special day unfolds exactly as you've always dreamed.

 But Amara Singapore's appeal extends far beyond the wedding day itself. The hotel's 389 rooms and suites, newly revitalised by Studio HBA, offer a serene urban oasis for you and your guests. Drawing inspiration from the charming alleyways and vibrant neighbourhood, each space is thoughtfully adorned with luxurious amenities, ensuring a comfortable stay for all.

### Your Forever Begins Here

Amara Singapore offers an exceptional setting for your special day. From the moment you enter the elegant grand foyer to the final dance in the beautifully transformed ballroom, every detail is thoughtfully curated to ensure your wedding is a memorable celebration.

With its prime location, refined amenities, and steadfast dedication to excellence, Amara Singapore is ready to bring your vision to life.

To begin planning your dream wedding, reach out to their dedicated events team. Your unforgettable celebration awaits in the heart of Tanjong Pagar.

Besides our magazine, couples can also find the resources they need by looking through our website. We have many entertaining and informative articles ranging that helps couples find solutions to different problems, from financial management, relationships, and beauty and wellness. 

 Apart from our wedding planning guides, Blissful Brides is also known for being the Blissful Outdoor Wedding Shows (BOWS) organiser. Held three times a year, the highly anticipated wedding show is lined up with many exciting programmes. There are numerous deals and discounts that couples can find from the variety of exceptional wedding planners. Being one of Singapore’s most prominent events, couples can enjoy unbeatable convenience when visiting the wedding show. Besides superb deals, couples will also receive awesome door gifts and are able to win attractive prizes during the event. 

 Blissful Brides is without a doubt a one-stop guide to all the resources you need in Singapore to plan your wedding. You may send any enquiries you might have via the “Contact Us” page for any questions. Our friendly and professional team will be happy to assist you as much as they can.

# Dusit Thani Laguna Singapore: Editor’s Choice for Banquet Venue 2025

 2025-02-24

![Image 6](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250219/20250219163554_97046.jpg)

At _Blissful Brides_, we are committed to recognising venues that redefine the art of celebration, turning wedding dreams into reality. This year, **Dusit Thani Laguna Singapore** has earned its place as one of our Editor’s Choice Award winners for 'Banquet Venue', and it’s no surprise why. From its idyllic location to its exceptional event spaces, this venue offers everything couples could wish for - to create a wedding that is nothing short of extraordinary. Interested? Read on for more.

### Tailored Venues for Unforgettable Occasions

One of the highlights of Dusit Thani Laguna Singapore is its array of both indoor and outdoor venues, each designed to cater to different styles of weddings.

![Image 7](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250219/20250219163621_33091.jpg)

For grand celebrations, the **Laguna Ballroom** takes centre stage. With its pillarless design, high ceilings, and capacity for up to 380 guests, the ballroom allows every attendee to have an unobstructed view of the ceremony or festivities. Its elegant interiors create a sophisticated atmosphere, while its spaciousness provides flexibility for personalisation, allowing couples to make the space uniquely theirs.

![Image 8](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250219/20250219163639_27734.jpg)
For more intimate gatherings, the **Albatross & Birdie** venue offers an enchanting option. With natural daylight streaming through large windows and stunning views of the pool and golf courses, it creates a warm and inviting ambience for up to 80 guests.

![Image 9](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250219/20250219163650_13130.jpg)
For those seeking to embrace the beauty of nature, the **Laguna Lawn** is a dream come true. This lush outdoor space can host grand solemnisation ceremonies for up to 50 guests, set against a backdrop of verdant greenery. Whether under a canopy of stars or in the soft glow of daylight, the lawn provides an unforgettable setting for life’s most romantic moments.

### A Serene Escape Just Minutes Away

![Image 10](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250219/20250219163708_32891.jpg)

Located within the grounds of the prestigious Laguna National Golf Resort Club, Dusit Thani Laguna Singapore provides a tranquil haven that feels a world away from the city. Its lush surroundings of rolling greenery and pristine landscapes make it a truly unique wedding destination. Conveniently located just 10 minutes from Singapore Changi Airport and within easy reach of downtown, the venue combines accessibility with a sense of retreat, perfect for couples looking to exchange vows in an oasis of calm.

### A Seamless Blend of Elegance and Convenience

![Image 11](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250219/20250219163724_76218.jpg)

Spanning over 4,000 square metres of classy indoor and lush outdoor event spaces, Dusit Thani Laguna Singapore offers couples the ability to host their entire wedding — from solemnisation to reception — in one convenient location. Beyond its stunning venues, the hotel provides cutting-edge facilities and unparalleled attention to detail, ensuring every event is executed to perfection.

This dedication to excellence extends to the guest experience. With its serene surroundings, sophisticated design, and proximity to landmarks like Jewel Changi Airport and East Coast Park, Dusit Thani Laguna Singapore ensures that couples and their guests feel truly pampered throughout their time here.

### A Different Wedding Experience: Dusit Thani Laguna Singapore

![Image 12](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250219/20250219163741_69029.jpg)

Dusit Thani Laguna Singapore has proven itself as a venue that goes above and beyond to create weddings that are as unique as the couples they host. Its seamless combination of tranquil surroundings, versatile spaces, and luxurious facilities makes it a standout choice for couples looking to celebrate their love in a way that feels both timeless and personal.

At _Blissful Brides_, our Editor’s Choice Award for preferred banquet venues is all about celebrating venues that bring weddings to life with unparalleled elegance and thoughtfulness. For those searching for a venue where every detail is designed to elevate your special day, **Dusit Thani Laguna Singapore** truly delivers. Your love story deserves nothing less than this remarkable destination.

# Beattie Wedding Singapore: A Story Woven in Elegance 

 2025-02-12

Vendor:[Beattie Wedding](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/2/bridal-boutiques/detail/1294/beattie-wedding)

![Image 5](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250212/20250212175819_34126.jpg)

Finding the perfect wedding dress is more than just ticking a box — it’s about feeling like the best version of yourself. Beattie Wedding Singapore understands this better than most. Their boutique combines world-class bridal fashion with warm, personalised service, ensuring every bride walks away with a dress (and memories) to cherish.

### A Legacy of Excellence

![Image 6](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250212/20250212175834_40801.jpg)

Their philosophy is simple: life changes, but happiness endures. From childhood to marriage to parenthood, love is a constant, and Beattie Wedding seeks to capture that permanence in every wedding gown they offer. More than just fabric and thread, their dresses are memory keepers, designed to preserve the magic of the moment for a lifetime.

![Image 7](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250212/20250212175849_10258.jpg)

With years of experience and a strong local presence, Beattie Wedding has earned a reputation for quality service and an impeccable eye for detail. Their track record speaks for itself, with countless couples — including prestigious families — entrusting them to deliver not just a dress, but an experience.

### A Curated Collection of World-Class Designers

![Image 8](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250212/20250212175906_99599.jpg)

Beattie Wedding’s collection is a carefully curated selection of designer gowns that blend luxury with individuality. They stock internationally renowned brands such as:

*   **Pronovias:**The Spanish royal brand known for its regal elegance. 
*   **Casablanca:**An American favourite for dreamy, romantic designs. 
*   **Demetrios:**A New York-based label at the forefront of bridal fashion. 
*   **Enzoani:**A Los Angeles brand combining modern trends with timeless sophistication. 
*   **Claire Designer Gowns:**Unique, bespoke designs that include both Western-style wedding dresses and traditional Chinese gowns. 

Their range is constantly updated, ensuring that every bride has access to the latest styles, whether she dreams of a classic ballgown, a sleek mermaid silhouette, or something entirely custom.

![Image 9](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250212/20250212180136_42691.jpg)

For brides who want something uniquely theirs, Beattie Wedding also offers customisation options. Their designers work closely with each client, crafting gowns that reflect personal style while maintaining the highest standards of craftsmanship.

### Wedding Photography Meets Travel

![Image 10](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250212/20250212180150_71602.jpg)

One of the latest trends among Beattie Wedding’s clientele is **vacation wedding photography**, where couples combine pre-wedding shoots with travel. Whether it’s the vibrant streets of Taiwan or a breathtaking European backdrop, Beattie Wedding helps turn destination dreams into reality.

![Image 11](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250212/20250212180215_24746.jpg)

Their services also include:

*   **Pre-wedding p****hotography:**Capture your love story before the big day with stunning photography sessions. 
*   **Actual day photography & videography:**Document every heartfelt moment with professional wedding-day coverage. 
*   **Short films & artistic portraits:**From wedding cinematography to family portraits, they offer a comprehensive range of photography services. 
*   **Bridal styling & makeup services:**To ensure every bride looks and feels her best. 
*   **Overseas pre-w****edding photography:** For couples dreaming of a destination shoot, they offer tailored experiences abroad. 

### The Beattie Wedding Experience

![Image 12](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250212/20250212180241_36360.jpg)

Shopping for a wedding dress should be an experience, not a chore. Beattie Wedding’s boutique is designed to be warm and inviting, with friendly service and even Taiwanese snacks while you browse. Their team takes the time to understand each bride’s vision, offering expert guidance and personalised styling sessions to find ‘the one.’

With a team of dedicated professionals, an unmatched selection of gowns, and a commitment to capturing memories that last a lifetime, **Beattie Wedding Singapore** is more than a boutique — it’s a promise of elegance, quality, and lasting happiness.

# Novotel Singapore on Stevens: Editor's Choice for Banquet Venue 2025

 2025-02-21

Vendor:[Novotel Singapore on Stevens](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/9/hotels/detail/777/novotel-singapore-on-stevens-)

![Image 6: Novotel Singapore on Stevens: Editor's Choice for Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250219/20250219101045_12330.jpg)

When it comes to wedding venues, few manage to strike the perfect balance between breathtaking design, seamless service, and unforgettable experiences. **Novotel Singapore on Stevens**, located near Orchard Road, is one such gem. For us at _Blissful Brides_, this remarkable hotel has redefined what it means to host a truly magical wedding — and that’s why we’ve awarded Novotel Singapore on Stevens our Editor’s Choice award for Banquet Venues.

But what makes Novotel Singapore on Stevens stand out in a city brimming with luxury options? Read on to see why this venue has captured the hearts of couples and earned its well-deserved accolades.

### A Venue Where Elegance Meets Enchantment

![Image 7: Novotel Singapore on Stevens: Editor's Choice for Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250219/20250219101058_16426.jpg)

There’s no doubt about it — Novotel Singapore on Stevens creates an atmosphere where love stories come alive. The hotel’s signature concept, **Twilight Weddings @ Stevens**, transforms every celebration into a dreamscape. Inspired by the ephemeral beauty of twilight, the theme combines soft, romantic hues with a celestial glow, creating an ethereal setting that feels both intimate and grand. _Twilight Weddings_ manages the almost impossible, inspiring a sense of fleeting beauty and thereby symbolising the timeless nature of love.

Here, couples and their guests are treated to a venue that brings the allure of a fairy-tale realm to life, blending the elegance of modern architecture with lush natural surroundings. Whether it’s an outdoor ceremony framed by greenery or an indoor reception in a refined yet inviting space, the venues at Novotel Singapore on Stevens provide the ideal canvas for your love story, framed by nature’s beauty and twilight’s serene charm.

![Image 8: Novotel Singapore on Stevens: Editor's Choice for Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250219/20250219101122_18101.jpg)

No two love stories are the same, and at Novotel Singapore on Stevens, no two weddings are either. The _Twilight Weddings_ concept offers endless thematic interpretations, allowing couples to shape their day exactly as they envision. Whether the vibe is whimsical and romantic, celestial and mythical, or a bespoke combination of the two, this venue’s versatility ensures that each wedding is a true reflection of the couple's style.

From delicate floral arrangements to custom lighting that bathes the space in twilight’s soft glow, every element can be tailored to create a one-of-a-kind experience.

### Award-Winning Culinary Experiences

But what’s a wedding without remarkable food? Novotel Singapore on Stevens brings gastronomic excellence to the table, ensuring that every meal is as memorable as the celebration itself. Their team of chefs crafts menus that cater to diverse tastes, offering both local and international cuisines of the highest quality. Couples are even invited to personalised menu tastings, ensuring the final spread is a perfect fit for their preferences and the occasion.

The dining experience here is not just a feast for the palate but also for the senses, with presentation and flavours that leave a lasting impression on every guest.

### Flawless Service, Seamlessly Delivered

![Image 9: Novotel Singapore on Stevens: Editor's Choice for Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250219/20250219101210_45798.jpg)

Behind the scenes, the dedicated wedding team at Novotel Singapore on Stevens works tirelessly to ensure every detail is flawlessly executed. From the initial planning stages to the final moments of the celebration, they’re on hand to guide couples through the process, offering expert advice and solutions to bring their vision to life.

This team’s ability to turn ideas into reality and solve challenges with ease has earned Novotel Singapore on Stevens a reputation for reliability and excellence. The result is a wedding day where everything flows smoothly, and couples can revel in the joy of the moment without distraction.

### The Perfect Stage for New Beginnings: Novotel Singapore on Stevens

![Image 10: Novotel Singapore on Stevens: Editor's Choice for Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250219/20250219101236_36396.jpg)

At Novotel Singapore on Stevens, a wedding is a transformative experience that lingers in the hearts of couples and their guests long after the day has passed. The hotel’s combination of innovative themes, flawless execution, and culinary artistry has earned it our Editor's Choice Award for 'Banquet Venues.'

For couples looking to write the opening chapter of their marriage in a venue that feels entirely their own, **Novotel Singapore on Stevens** offers a backdrop that inspires and impresses.

Your love story deserves nothing less than a setting as extraordinary as this.

### Our Services

**A unique hilltop destination to begin your lifetime of happiness**

Create blissful memories to last a lifetime at**Mount Faber Peak**, surrounded by magnificent views of the city and glistening harbour vista. At 100m above sea level, the extraordinary hilltop wedding destinations at Mount Faber Peak artfully incorporate lush greenery and natural elements into a unique charm that is sure to inspire many beautiful memories.

Encased with glass walls that overlooks panoramic sea views, our**Angsana Glasshouse**offers an intimate wedding ceremony and deck solemnisation experience for your guests to feel on top of the world. For large weddings up to 200 guests,**The Ballroom**features floor-to-ceiling glass windows that treat guests to magnificent views of the cable car line and picturesque harbour, bound to leave your guests in awe. The botanical-themed**Arbora**sets the scene for a unique alfresco wedding amid a natural ambience. Our venues all come with the option to add on a **Garden Solemnisation**, where you can make a grand entrance down the elegant spiral staircase and commemorate your love by ringing the Bells of Happiness as a symbol of everlasting bliss.

Whether it’s a sophisticated wedding dinner, an intimate solemnisation ceremony or a cosy reception,bring together your closest loved ones for an intimate celebration at Mount Faber Peak.

For more information, visit us at [https://mountfaberdining.com/pages/celebrations-catering](https://mountfaberdining.com/pages/celebrations-catering)
