# Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025

 2025-02-20

Vendor:[Mount Faber Peak](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/15/restaurants/detail/306/mount-faber-peak)

![Image 5: Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218124420_82536.jpg)

When it comes to wedding venues that truly elevate the experience — literally and figuratively — **Mount Faber Peak** stands in a league of its own.

With panoramic views that stretch over the harbour and Sentosa Island, this hilltop haven is a dream come true for couples seeking a wedding venue that feels both unique and intimate. Blissful Brides is proud to honour Mount Faber Peak with our coveted Editor’s Choice Award for Preferred Banquet Venue, and here’s why it deserves a place on your shortlist.

### Versatile Venues for Every Celebration

![Image 6: Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218124443_89321.jpg)

Mount Faber Peak offers a selection of exquisite venues that cater to every type of celebration, from intimate receptions to grand gatherings. For those dreaming of a cosy yet sophisticated affair, the **Angsana Glasshouse** provides an ethereal setting. Surrounded by floor-to-ceiling glass windows, this crystalline space is perfect for up to 70 guests. Its elevated location at the highest point of Mount Faber ensures awe-inspiring views of the HarbourFront and beyond.

![Image 7: Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218124458_56770.jpg)

For larger celebrations, **The****Ballroom** is nothing short of breathtaking. With its floor-to-ceiling glass windows and sophisticated design, it comfortably accommodates up to 200 guests. The venue’s unique charm lies in its view of the iconic cable car cabins gliding against a backdrop of shimmering waters. Guests can even begin the festivities with a stylish cocktail reception at the veranda or bar, setting the tone for an unforgettable evening.

![Image 8: Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218124515_82856.jpg)

For couples who dream of an outdoor ceremony surrounded by nature, the **Arbora Garden** offers a picturesque setting like no other. This lush hilltop garden, adorned with heritage Angsana trees and whimsical landscaping, is the ideal spot for exchanging vows under the open sky. The centrepiece of the garden, Poland’s Bells of Happiness, adds a touch of enchantment and tradition, inviting couples to ring in good fortune for their new chapter together.

### Simply Unforgettable Experiences

![Image 9: Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218124537_58988.jpg)

Mount Faber Peak is all about creating magical moments, and it all begins with a breathtaking first impression! Couples can make a dramatic entrance via the stunning spiral staircase that leads to Arbora Garden for their solemnisation, setting the stage for a day brimming with elegance and romance. Guests will also have a blast arriving in style by cable car rides, adding an extra layer of excitement and uniqueness to the event!

### A Setting Like No Other

![Image 10: Mount Faber Peak: Editor's Choice for Preferred Banquet Venue 2025](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250218/20250218124605_47310.jpg)

Beyond the venues themselves, Mount Faber Peak’s hilltop location offers something few others can match: an escape from the city’s hustle without straying too far from its conveniences. Just minutes from downtown Singapore, this hidden gem provides a serene retreat with panoramic views, lush greenery, and a sophisticated atmosphere. It’s a place where nature meets modern luxury, creating the perfect backdrop for unforgettable celebrations.

### Award-Winning Excellence @ The Peak

With its slogan “Celebrate Love @ The Peak,” Mount Faber Peak encapsulates everything a wedding venue should be — romantic, versatile, and utterly breathtaking. Just imagine exchanging vows or hosting a reception where every corner reveals a new picture-perfect scene.

It’s no wonder, then, that Mount Faber Peak has earned our Editor’s Choice Award for Preferred Banquet Venue. From its charming spaces to its spectacular views and unique offerings, every element is designed to make your wedding day truly extraordinary. For couples looking to start their forever on a high note, **Mount Faber Peak** is the venue that delivers on every promise.

# Copthorne King’s Hotel Singapore: A Blend of Timeless Elegance and Personality

 2025-01-22

Vendor:[Copthorne King's Hotel](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/9/hotels/detail/53/catering-cks-millenniumhotels-com)

![Image 6: Copthorne King’s Hotel Singapore: A Blend of Timeless Elegance and Personality](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250122/20250122150611_88088.jpg)

When it comes to planning a wedding that marries impeccable service, exquisite cuisine, and enchanting decor, Copthorne King’s Hotel Singapore is an outstanding choice. Located along Havelock Road, this hotel combines convenience, sophistication, and heartfelt hospitality to make your special day unforgettable.

### A Feast to Remember: Iconic Teochew Cuisine

![Image 7: Copthorne King’s Hotel Singapore: A Blend of Timeless Elegance and Personality](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250122/20250122150630_65292.jpg)

A wedding at Copthorne King’s Hotel promises a culinary experience like no other. Tien Court, the hotel’s award-winning restaurant, offers a menu crafted by MasterChef Lui, renowned for his mastery of Teochew cuisine. With dishes rooted in tradition yet crafted to perfection, it’s the kind of dining that keeps people talking long after the last bite. Plus, Vegetarian and Muslim-friendly options ensure that every guest leaves satisfied and impressed.

### Your Love Story, Your Style: Stunning Décor and Versatile Spaces

![Image 8: Copthorne King’s Hotel Singapore: A Blend of Timeless Elegance and Personality](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250122/20250122150648_43854.jpg)

If you’ve ever dreamed of walking into a wedding venue that feels uniquely yours, Copthorne King’s is ready to deliver.

Couples can choose from three mesmerising elemental themes: Azure, with its tranquil sky-and-sea hues; Terrestrial, inspired by the earth's warm tones; and Scarlett, an ode to romance and sophistication. Each theme is brought to life with carefully curated decor that frames your love story in elegance.

Whether you envision an intimate solemnisation or a grand banquet, Copthorne King’s Hotel offers versatile event spaces to suit your needs. The sleek ballrooms and elegant function rooms can be tailored to your style, while the hotel’s dedicated wedding planners ensure every detail is flawless.

### A Simply Unbeatable Location

Situated just minutes from Havelock MRT Station, the Central Business District, and popular spots like Orchard Road and Clarke Quay, Copthorne King’s Hotel is an ideal choice for local and international guests. With the nearby Havelock MRT Station making it a breeze to get around, it’s the kind of convenience that takes one more thing off your wedding planning plate.

Watabe Singapore is delighted to present the CHIJMES Wedding Experience 2025, along with the opening of new wedding dates extending through December 2026!

Join us for an unforgettable day with our planners, exquisite food and drinks, and the stunning ambiance of CHIJMES Hall with its soaring ceiling and stained glass windows. For a more intimate setting, step into Alcove at Caldwell House, an elegant venue featuring a unique dome shape and timeless charm. Our bridal boutique, Etoriaru, will also be part of the showcase, offering a seamless one-stop solution for all your wedding needs

Location: 30 Victoria Street

CHIJMES Hall (#01-28) – Main Event Hall

Alcove at Caldwell House (#02-04/05)

*    Enjoy a luxurious two-night retreat at The Capitol Kempinski Hotel Singapore. 
*    Celebrate your special day with a complimentary rental of a stunning white gown from Etoriaru. 
*    1.5 hours Pre-Wedding Photoshoot by Germaine from Bridelope Productions. 

Furthermore, additional prizes await, so be sure not to miss this exclusive opportunity!

[Register now](https://www.watabe-wedding.com.sg/cwe-2025-chijmes-wedding-show) to redeem an exclusive welcome bag filled with amazing vouchers and gifts, limited to the first 60 CWE 2025 show registrants!

### Curated Vendors Just for You

The tranquil environment of our breezy tropical island will set the mood for an elegant tropical ceremony and set the stage for a catered reception to remember. Your solemnization can be hosted at our outdoor venues: W Lawn or the more intimate English garden. The tropical air and surroundings will make this solemnization feel like a breeze of love for you and your guests. It is all about celebrating the two of you in a stylish location.

Our innovative planners transform the hotel’s breathtaking banquet venues into an out-of-the-world wedding setup that’s unique to you, whether that means glamour, fun, simple, chic or all of the above.

Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall
Have you heard? Couples who desire atypical or unique wedding spots are turning their gaze skyward — specifically to the rooftop of
Grand Park City Hall
. Here, among wrought iron domes and gentle fountains, urban weddings take on an unexpected botanical twist. It's where "I do" comes with a view and wedding stress checks out before you do.
For those who believe marriage should start on a high note, this skyward sanctuary might just be your match made in heaven — or at least, several stories closer to it.
Read
here
for more!

# Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall

 2025-03-04

![Image 5: Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250304/20250304111414_25711.jpg)

Have you heard? Couples who desire atypical or unique wedding spots are turning their gaze skyward — specifically to the rooftop of Grand Park City Hall. Here, among wrought iron domes and gentle fountains, urban weddings take on an unexpected botanical twist. It's where "I do" comes with a view and wedding stress checks out before you do.

For those who believe marriage should start on a high note, this skyward sanctuary might just be your match made in heaven — or at least, several stories closer to it. Read on for more.

### A Garden in the Sky

Tucked away from the hustle and bustle of Singapore's central business district lies a hidden gem for couples seeking a memorable wedding venue. Grand Park City Hall offers not one, but two distinctive spaces that transform wedding dreams into reality.

![Image 6: Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250304/20250304111455_89760.jpg)

The crown jewel of this urban retreat is undoubtedly the Rooftop Sky Garden. Perched at the building's summit, this outdoor venue draws inspiration from the surrounding nature and neoclassical architecture of Singapore's historic Civic District. The wrought iron dome structure creates a stunning focal point, while gentle water fountains provide a soothing soundtrack to your ceremony; one couldn’t ask for a more perfect backdrop for rustic outdoor garden weddings and intimate solemnisations.

![Image 7: Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250304/20250304111511_91323.jpg)

![Image 8: Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250304/20250304111521_48712.jpg)

For couples concerned about capacity, the Rooftop Sky Garden comfortably accommodates up to 120 guests for ceremonies and 80 for receptions, making it ideal for those who prefer quality time with a select gathering rather than an overwhelming crowd.

### Fine Dining Excellence

![Image 9: Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250304/20250304111543_36882.jpg)

For indoor celebrations, Tablescape Restaurant on Level 3 presents an equally impressive option. Widely regarded as one of the finest dining establishments in Singapore's CBD, Tablescape transports guests to an era when restaurant dining was a truly special occasion.

![Image 10: Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250304/20250304111556_86493.jpg)

![Image 11: Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250304/20250304111610_45371.jpg)

The restaurant's interior showcases neoclassical beauty with meticulous attention to detail, creating an atmosphere of refined elegance. Here, up to 120 guests can enjoy a reception featuring impeccable table service and classic dishes reimagined with contemporary flair.

Seamless Planning Support

Understanding that wedding planning can be overwhelming, Grand Park City Hall offers dedicated support to ensure a stress-free experience. Each couple is assigned a designated Event Services Planner who handles pre-event logistics and coordinates all details, ensuring everything runs smoothly on the big day.

### The Grand Park Promise

![Image 12: Sky High Vows: Celebrate Your Special Day at Grand Park City Hall](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20250304/20250304111655_71931.jpg)

Wedding dates are precious, and securing your preferred venue is paramount. Grand Park City Hall recommends that couples place their deposit as soon as they finalise their date. With packages starting from $178++ to $198++ per person, Grand Park City Hall offers competitive pricing for a premium wedding experience in a central Singapore location.

For couples seeking a wedding venue that balances urban convenience with natural beauty, historical character with modern amenities, and intimate atmosphere with generous capacity, **Grand Park City Hall** stands ready to host your celebration of love.

# JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La: Where Dreams Turn into Wedding Day Reality

 2024-12-20

Vendor:[JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/9/hotels/detail/513/jen-singapore-tanglin-by-shangri-la-)

![Image 6: JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La: Where Dreams Turn into Wedding Day Reality](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241219/20241219125224_77523.jpg)

A wedding venue sets the stage for one of the most important days of your life, and **JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La** delivers on every front. Combining contemporary style with timeless charm, this venue offers couples a modern yet warm space to celebrate their union. Here, every detail is designed to honour your unique vision and bring your dream day to life. How so? Read on for more.

### A Venue That Combines Modern Elegance and Customisation

![Image 7: JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La: Where Dreams Turn into Wedding Day Reality](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241219/20241219125319_76221.jpg)

Weddings at JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La are anything but ordinary. The hotel’s signature style blends modern vibes with sophisticated touches, offering couples a canvas to create a celebration that feels uniquely theirs.

Their newly refreshed wedding themes cater to diverse tastes, ranging from minimalist chic to opulent elegance. JEN Singapore Tanglin ensures that every couple can find a design that resonates with their love story. Each theme is a different story waiting to unfold, adding a touch of magic to the day.

![Image 8: JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La: Where Dreams Turn into Wedding Day Reality](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241219/20241219125344_40353.jpg)

![Image 9: JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La: Where Dreams Turn into Wedding Day Reality](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241219/20241219125414_54087.jpg)

The ballrooms, adorned with these exclusive themes, exude a sense of refined charm while maintaining a contemporary edge. And that’s not to mention the flexibility of these venues, of course. Be it a close-knit gathering or a grand banquet, the hotel’s team ensures every detail aligns seamlessly with your preferences.

![Image 10: JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La: Where Dreams Turn into Wedding Day Reality](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241219/20241219125448_90838.jpg)

![Image 11: JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La: Where Dreams Turn into Wedding Day Reality](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241219/20241219125506_18748.jpg)

### A Perfect Location for Picture-Perfect Moments

![Image 12: JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La: Where Dreams Turn into Wedding Day Reality](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241219/20241219125522_76228.jpg)

Located in the quiet Tanglin neighbourhood yet close to the bustling heart of Orchard Road, JEN Singapore Tanglin is a dream location for couples and guests alike. A short stroll from the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Singapore Botanic Gardens, it offers endless opportunities for capturing beautiful pre- or post-ceremony moments. Imagine walking hand-in-hand through lush greenery or posing against the timeless charm of Tanglin’s quaint enclave.

Accessibility is another winning factor. Just a two-minute walk from Orchard Boulevard MRT station, the hotel is convenient for locals and out-of-town guests alike. Whether exploring nearby shopping districts or retreating into nature, the location offers the best of both worlds.

### Gourmet Cuisine for a Diverse Guest List

![Image 13: JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La: Where Dreams Turn into Wedding Day Reality](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241219/20241219125601_82987.jpg)

Food is a love language of its own, and JEN Singapore Tanglin speaks it fluently — each dish is meticulously prepared to ensure a feast that’s as memorable as the day itself. For couples who want to elevate their dining experience, the hotel also offers customised food tasting sessions.

What truly sets JEN Singapore Tanglin apart, however, is their dedication to inclusivity. Their standout halal-certified banquet menu is thoughtfully curated to cater to inter-racial couples and Muslim guests, ensuring that every guest at your wedding feels welcomed and celebrated.

### Crafting Memories That Last a Lifetime: JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La

![Image 14: JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La: Where Dreams Turn into Wedding Day Reality](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241219/20241219125629_57358.jpg)

If you’re searching for a venue that strikes the perfect balance of sophistication, versatility, and heartfelt hospitality, JEN Singapore Tanglin is the answer.

So, create memories around the hotel, steps away from the greenery at Botanic Gardens and the quaint enclave at Tanglin. Capture moments where their playful designs and wedding themes are ideal for hosting weddings of various sizes — from intimate ceremonies to grand banquets. The possibilities are endless to your special day as JEN Singapore Tanglin offers specially curated packages to suit each need.

Want to know more about celebrating your wedding at JEN Singapore Tanglin? You’re in luck. Come join us at our Blissful One-Stop Wedding Show (BOWS) held on 4–5 January 2025 and say “I Do” to your wedding story at JEN Singapore Tanglin’s Booth B24. Enjoy up to $3,888++ off with exclusive perks on JEN Singapore Tanglin — including free-flow draught beer or house pour, an additional 1-night stay in Bridal Suite, and many more other perks.

If you’re looking for a venue that offers a storybook beginning to your lifelong adventure, then **JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La** is the one. Start your forever here and make your wedding everything you’ve imagined and more.

* * *

Join us at our in-house wedding show, the ultimate one-stop destination for couples seeking the perfect venue for their special day. At Four Points Singapore, we believe every wedding should be as unique as the couple it celebrates, and we’re here to make that dream a reality.

Explore a curated selection of participating vendors, from stunning wedding gowns to essential décor and live bands ready to set the perfect mood. Consult directly with these experts and our dedicated wedding team, who will be on hand to guide through the planning process.

Stroll through our beautifully set-up ballrooms and immerse in an array of wedding themes and favors, helping to envision every detail of a big day. This unforgettable experience promises to inspire and excite, setting the stage for a celebration filled with love, joy, and cherished memories.

# YWCA Fort Canning: Where Love Meets Legacy

 2024-12-19

Vendor:[YWCA Fort Canning](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/18/wedding-venues/detail/958/ywca-fort-canning)

![Image 6: YWCA Fort Canning: Where Love Meets Legacy](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241218/20241218163530_19957.jpg)

In the bustling heart of Singapore, nestled between the verdant Fort Canning Park and the vibrant Orchard Road, lies a wedding venue that is no ordinary. YWCA Fort Canning isn't just another picturesque location to say "I do". Here, you’re stepping into a legacy of community service that spans over a century and a half — and here’s why.

### Celebrating Love for a Good Cause

At YWCA Fort Canning, weddings are not only a beautiful union between the couple, but they are also events that can transform the lives of the marginalised community. What if your first act as a married couple could be one of community service? What if the joy of your celebration could ripple outwards, touching lives beyond your guest list?

This isn't just marketing speak. Every wedding hosted at YWCA Fort Canning directly contributes to funding community service programmes. It's a concept that's as refreshing as it is impactful, offering couples a chance to celebrate their union while making a tangible difference in the lives of others.

But make no mistake — choosing YWCA Fort Canning doesn't mean compromising on the dream wedding you've always envisioned. This venue also offers a diversity of spaces to suit every couple's taste and vision, as we’ll cover below, too.

### The Sophia Cooke Ballroom: Timeless Elegance

![Image 7: YWCA Fort Canning: Where Love Meets Legacy](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241218/20241218163618_97015.jpg)

![Image 8: YWCA Fort Canning: Where Love Meets Legacy](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241218/20241218163628_57651.jpg)

For those seeking a perfect blend of simplicity and sophistication, the Sophia Cooke Ballroom is ideal. This column-less space comfortably accommodates up to 23 tables, allowing guests to enjoy an unobstructed view of the raised stage. The ballroom's neutral colour palette and minimalistic floral arrangements create a romantic ambience that serves as the perfect backdrop for your love story.

Bathed in the soft glow of overhead lighting, the Sophia Cooke Ballroom exudes warmth and refinement. Its spacious interior and lofty ceilings provide an impressive setting for your celebration, complete with a comprehensive projector, light, and sound system.

### The Peace Room: Intimate Charm

![Image 9: YWCA Fort Canning: Where Love Meets Legacy](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241218/20241218163650_35503.jpg)

Couples looking for a cosier setting will find the Peace Room enchanting. This smaller venue overlooks the outdoor swimming pool, offering a bright and welcoming atmosphere. The Peace Room presents the perfect opportunity for a romantic outdoor pool ceremony before seamlessly moving indoors.

### Outdoor Bliss

![Image 10: YWCA Fort Canning: Where Love Meets Legacy](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241218/20241218163713_92977.jpg)

For those who dream of saying "I do" under the open sky, YWCA Fort Canning offers delightful outdoor options. Host your solemnisation by the poolside or in the al fresco courtyard.

### Your Dream Wedding Awaits

At YWCA Fort Canning, your wedding becomes an opportunity to make a real difference in the world. For couples who believe in the power of love and giving, YWCA Fort Canning offers the perfect blend of romance and purpose. Here, you can celebrate your commitment whilst supporting those in need, making your special day truly extraordinary.

But don't just take our word for it—come and see for yourself why YWCA Fort Canning has earned the title of Blissful Brides' Editor's Choice Winner for both 2021 and 2022. Experience firsthand the exceptional service, stunning venues, and meaningful impact that have made this hidden gem a favourite among discerning couples.

Don't just dream of a magical wedding — make it a reality at YWCA Fort Canning, where love and charity go hand in hand.

### Sitting in the heart of the central business district and Marina Bay, with panoramic views of the Singapore city skyline, the 583-room PARKROYAL COLLECTION Marina Bay, Singapore is the country's first 'Garden-in-a-Hotel'.

A champion of sustainability, environmental responsibility and advocate for green innovations in the hospitality industry, the hotel is home to one of Southeast Asia's largest indoor sky-lit atrium, containing over 2,400 plants, trees, shrubs and groundcovers from more than 60 varieties of flora spread across 15,000 square feet of space throughout.

Distinctive dining options are available for every palate and occasion, from international and Asian culinary creations at Peppermint, progressive Cantonese cuisine at Peach Blossoms, a selection of over 90 varieties of whiskies and craft cocktails at Portman's Bar, and outdoor relaxation and dining at Skyline Bar. A rooftop Urban Farm spanning 150 square metres houses over 60 varieties of fruits, vegetables, herbs and edible flowers, forming the backbone of the hotel's farm-to-table, farm-to-bar and farm-to-spa concepts.

The 25-metre swimming pool comes alive with 1,380 glowing fibre optic lights at dusk, and a refreshing dip in the pool articulates an experience not unlike the sensation of floating amongst a star-studded galaxy. Fitness facilities are also available for travellers to maintain an active lifestyle on-the-go, including a dedicated Spin Bike Studio with 10 TechnoGym spin bikes, while St. Gregory offers spa treatments and traditional therapies.

Catering to environmentally conscious travellers, PARKROYAL COLLECTION Marina Bay, Singapore focuses on contemporary vibes brought to life through biophilic design, iconic architecture, eco-friendliness and lifestyle experiences.

# York Hotel Singapore: Your Perfect Wedding Haven in the Heart of the City

 2024-12-17

Vendor:[York Hotel Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/9/hotels/detail/1282/york-hotel)

![Image 6: York Hotel Singapore: Your Perfect Wedding Haven in the Heart of the City](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241217/20241217123831_24640.jpg)

Imagine a place where the excitement of urban life gently fades into the background, replaced by an atmosphere of romance and celebration. This is York Hotel Singapore — a surreal sanctuary where love takes center stage, offering a perfect blend of convenience and charm, and creating the ideal backdrop for your special day. Read on to discover more.

### Your Dream Wedding, Perfectly Set

![Image 7: York Hotel Singapore: Your Perfect Wedding Haven in the Heart of the City](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241217/20241217123848_57813.jpg)

York Hotel Singapore boasts an impressive array versatile function rooms to suit every celebration. **Rosemarie Hall,** one of the hotel’s most sought-after venues, is loved for its elegant ambiance and flexible layout. The space can accommodate up to 30 tables, giving your cherished guests ample room to celebrate alongside you on your special day.

For couples envisioning a more intimate setting, exchange your vows in the cosy and exclusive ambiance at **Top of Top York**. Frame by the city skyline, the venue is bathed in natural daylight and complemented by sleek, contemporary interiors for a romantic ceremony.

On the big day, the spacious Bridal Suite also provides the private retreat for the couple to share quiet moments together before making your grand entrance.

### Culinary Creations for Your Perfect Celebration

![Image 8: York Hotel Singapore: Your Perfect Wedding Haven in the Heart of the City](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241217/20241217123920_18484.jpg)

The hotel's culinary team takes pride in crafting exquisite menus that elevate every celebration. Couples are invited to personalise their wedding menu, selecting from a wide range of dishes that cater to diverse tastes and dietary needs.

The menu is meticulously designed to reflect the couple's style and preference, ensuring a memorable dining experience for all.

### Your Wedding, Their Commitment

Planning a wedding is a beautiful journey, and at York Hotel Singapore, their experienced wedding specialists ensure that every step is seamless.

Whether you envision a charming themed celebration or a grand, elegant soiree, York Hotel Singapore takes pride in bringing your dream wedding to life. It’s your moment to shine, and the team is dedicated to making sure all eyes are on you as you bask in the spotlight.

# The Interior Collections: Crafting Affordable Luxury for Your Wedding Day

 2024-12-18

Vendor:[The Interior Collections](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/6/florists-stylists/detail/487/the-interior-collections)

![Image 5](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241220/20241220142046_80370.jpg)

In the bustling world of wedding planning, one name has proven itself time and time again through its commitment to elegance, creativity, and budget-friendly solutions: The Interior Collections. This innovative group of creative stylists has carved a niche in the wedding industry by proving that true luxury doesn't always come with an exorbitant price tag. Their philosophy is simple yet powerful — impeccable taste and boundless creativity can transform any wedding into a splendid affair, regardless of budget constraints.

### Colour and Versatility

![Image 6](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241220/20241220142055_10594.jpg)

One of the most impressive aspects of The Interior Collections is their versatility in design. Recognising that preferences can be as diverse as the couples they serve, the team prides itself on not being limited to any single style. From classic whites and greens to vibrant spring themes, moody autumn vibes, and rich pops of blues and whites, their experienced florists excel in bringing a wide array of creative visions to life.

How it works: The Interior Collections usually sends mock-ups in the form of faux floral hedges once the details are confirmed and a 50% deposit has been paid. For faux flowers, couples are typically free to adjust the ratio of flowers and foliage to match their preferred look. For fresh flowers, costs may require revision if the colour scheme or ratio of flowers and foliage is changed.

### Quality Design on A Budget

![Image 7](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241220/20241220142103_63248.jpg)

At the heart of The Interior Collections' ethos is the belief that every couple deserves a touch of luxury on their special day. The team's approach to wedding decoration and floral arrangements is rooted in this principle, constantly seeking innovative ways to create stunning designs that are flexible enough to accommodate various budgets.

In terms of decorating packages, the pricing for full venue decor typically ranges from SGD $2,500 to SGD $4,000 nett, including a stage backdrop, aisle markers, and reception table decor. However, the overall costs depend on the scale and level of detail in their preferred designs. Fresh flower costs may also vary depending on the colour scheme and any request for specific types of flowers.

Additionally, The Interior Collections also provides setup and teardown services alongside their affordable decoration services; these fees are usually calculated together before the final invoice is sent over to their clients.

Should there be additional fees chargeable, The Interior Collections will inform the couple through the initial draft quote (based on the confirmed items) to minimise any surprises after the deposit has been placed. They recommend that all clients read through the invoice and draft quotes with care before placing a deposit with them.

The Interior Collections is also running a special BOWS 2024 promotion which includes a 10% discount for $3500 spending* and above, as well as $200 store credits for spending above $1000*. Do take note that the promotions above are stackable, and are limited to booth customers who have registered with The Interior Collections.

*Price is not inclusive of GST, setup, and teardown fees

### Creating Memorable Experiences

![Image 8](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241220/20241220142143_82410.jpg)

The team at The Interior Collections understands that a wedding day is more than just beautiful decorations — it's about creating an atmosphere that reflects the couple's unique love story. Their highly customisable designs are crafted to convey the intricate mood and ambience that couples wish to share with their loved ones and guests. By incorporating the latest trends, spotlights, interesting props, and elegant decor, they ensure that each wedding stands out as a truly unforgettable experience.

To that end, The Interior Collections takes pride in its extensive inventory, striving to meet each client's specific preferences and ideal vision. In cases where particular props are needed to recreate a desired effect, the team is more than willing to source and bring in necessary items, especially when wedding decorations are planned well in advance.

 Their commitment to customisation extends to offering alternatives that balance aesthetic goals with budget considerations, ensuring that every couple's unique story is reflected in their wedding decor.

### Elegant Visions, Affordable Dreams

The Interior Collections strongly believes that your wedding day is a special occasion for you and your partner. Their highly customisable designs should only reflect the intricate mood and ambience that you wish to convey to loved ones and guests. So, if you're looking for a renowned 'floral “art”-elier' to spruce up your wedding, why wait?

For couples interested in The Interior Collections' services, it's recommended to book 3 to 6 months in advance, especially for peak wedding seasons (September to December). However, the team has proven their expertise by delivering stunning results even for last-minute bookings. To avoid disappointment, in any case, do book their services as early as possible.

All in all, The Interior Collections offers a refreshing approach to wedding decor, proving that luxury and affordability can indeed go hand in hand. With their creative flair, commitment to customisation, and budget-friendly solutions, they're transforming the wedding industry one beautiful celebration at a time. For couples dreaming of a wedding that's both stunning and sensible, The Interior Collections is undoubtedly a name to remember.

 Blissful Brides is an all-in-one wedding guide in Singapore that strives to help all soon-to-be-married couples turn their ideal wedding into a reality by providing the necessary tools they need. In the wedding planning industry, Blissful Brides has gained more than 20 years of experience, thus forming a solid connection with our excellent vendors. We have many different wedding vendors you can hire, each offering variety of jewellery, venues, restaurants, and dresses options. 

 Our wedding vendors are arranged according to their provided services, allowing couples to find the resources they need quickly. All you need is to enter a particular category you are looking at to discover the range of wedding vendors in that particular category. Many of those featured on our portal has been in this industry for a long time, and have earned themselves a solid reputation. Any couple who chooses either one can rest assured that they are in good hands. Couples can also better plan their wedding with the vendors’ professional assistance. Apart from the guide to different vendors available in Singapore, our website also features wedding deals that help couples keep to their set budget when planning their wedding.

Besides our magazine, couples can also find the resources they need by looking through our website. We have many entertaining and informative articles ranging that helps couples find solutions to different problems, from financial management, relationships, and beauty and wellness. 

 Apart from our wedding planning guides, Blissful Brides is also known for being the Blissful Outdoor Wedding Shows (BOWS) organiser. Held three times a year, the highly anticipated wedding show is lined up with many exciting programmes. There are numerous deals and discounts that couples can find from the variety of exceptional wedding planners. Being one of Singapore’s most prominent events, couples can enjoy unbeatable convenience when visiting the wedding show. Besides superb deals, couples will also receive awesome door gifts and are able to win attractive prizes during the event. 

 Blissful Brides is without a doubt a one-stop guide to all the resources you need in Singapore to plan your wedding. You may send any enquiries you might have via the “Contact Us” page for any questions. Our friendly and professional team will be happy to assist you as much as they can.

# A Timeless Romance: Your Dream Wedding at Concorde Hotel Singapore

 2024-11-15

Vendor:[Concorde Hotel Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/9/hotels/detail/500/concorde-hotel-singapore)

![Image 5: A Timeless Romance: Your Dream Wedding at Concorde Hotel Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241115/20241115100033_36892.jpg)

Love stories deserve an extraordinary stage, and **Concorde Hotel Singapore** delivers precisely that. Rising gracefully along the prestigious Orchard Road, this sophisticated venue has established itself as one of Singapore's premier wedding destinations. With its perfect fusion of contemporary luxury and classic refinement, Concorde Hotel Singapore creates celebrations that transcend the ordinary, offering couples a distinctive setting to write their own chapter of romance.

### The Grand Concorde Ballroom: Where Dreams Take Flight

![Image 6: A Timeless Romance: Your Dream Wedding at Concorde Hotel Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241115/20241115100148_52182.jpg)

The jewel in Concorde's crown is undoubtedly its exclusive Main Concorde Ballroom, a spectacular space that transforms into a couple's private sanctuary for their special day. With soaring ceilings and an expansive, open design, the ballroom accommodates up to 450 guests whilst maintaining an intimate atmosphere.

![Image 7: A Timeless Romance: Your Dream Wedding at Concorde Hotel Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241115/20241115100206_63896.jpg)

The venue's romantic and timeless ambience is enhanced by exquisite wedding decorations, featuring beautifully bedecked floral arrangements and a dramatic red-carpet aisle complete with an enchanting dry ice effect for that magical march-in moment.

### Location and Distinctive Features

![Image 8: A Timeless Romance: Your Dream Wedding at Concorde Hotel Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241115/20241115100231_88006.jpg)

Strategically positioned between two MRT stations on Orchard Road, the hotel offers unparalleled convenience for guests. During the year-end festivities, couples and their guests are treated to stunning views of the celebrated Orchard Road light-up, adding an extra touch of magic to winter weddings.

![Image 9: A Timeless Romance: Your Dream Wedding at Concorde Hotel Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241115/20241115100246_21044.jpg)
The hotel also provides various picturesque spots for wedding photography, including its elegant lobby, serene poolside, and the vibrant Orchard Road backdrop.

### Culinary Excellence

![Image 10: A Timeless Romance: Your Dream Wedding at Concorde Hotel Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241115/20241115100306_15190.jpg)

Couples can expect a remarkable dining experience at Concorde Hotel Singapore, where culinary excellence meets generous hospitality. The customisable 8-course Chinese banquet forms the cornerstone of the celebration, crafted to perfection by the hotel's skilled chefs. Before the big day, couples can fine-tune their menu choices through a complimentary food tasting session for 10 guests.

![Image 11: A Timeless Romance: Your Dream Wedding at Concorde Hotel Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241115/20241115100325_19326.jpg)

The beverage selection is equally impressive, featuring unlimited soft drinks, mixers, and premium Chinese tea, including chilled Authentic Tea House Oolong. Each celebration includes a champagne tower for the quintessential toasting moment, complemented by two substantial barrels of Carlsberg beer (22.7L each) and a bottle of house wine per table. For those wishing to bring their own special bottles, the hotel offers a corkage waiver for duty-paid sealed wines and spirits.

The experience begins with welcome cocktails served in the elegantly appointed foyer, while the traditional cake-cutting ceremony features a beautifully crafted decorative wedding cake, ensuring picture-perfect moments throughout the celebration.

A-la-carte dining options are also available at the hotel's various establishments, including Spices Cafe, which offers local flavours by day and seafood delights by night, and the tranquil Lobby Lounge for casual refreshments.

### A Dedicated Wedding Excellence

![Image 12: A Timeless Romance: Your Dream Wedding at Concorde Hotel Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241115/20241115100345_22190.jpg)

What truly sets Concorde Hotel Singapore apart is its commitment to personalised service. Each wedding is overseen by an experienced wedding manager who serves as a dedicated point of contact throughout the planning journey. From the initial consultation to the final moments of the celebration, couples can rest assured that every detail is handled with meticulous care and genuine passion.

### Where Moments Become Memories: Concorde Hotel Singapore

![Image 13: A Timeless Romance: Your Dream Wedding at Concorde Hotel Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241115/20241115100401_74905.jpg)

Starting from S$1,398++ for lunch and S$1,598++ for dinner per table, the hotel's 2025 wedding packages are well curated with a multitude of perks. For instance, each package includes a complimentary stay in the luxurious Bridal Suite (Premier Suite) with 2 breakfasts and even a welcome fruit basket! Prepare to be utterly pampered on your big day.

Given the venue's popularity, couples are advised to book approximately one year in advance to secure their preferred date. This foresight ensures ample time for detailed planning and personalisation of their celebration.

For couples seeking a sophisticated urban wedding venue that combines convenience, elegance, and dedicated service, **Concorde Hotel Singapore** presents a compelling choice. With its blend of romantic ambience and exceptional service, it continues to be one of Singapore's most sought-after wedding destinations.

## FAQ

### Why You Can't Miss ![Image 25](https://events.blissfulbrides.sg/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Voyage-of-Love-Event-title_2.png) Wedding Showcase at M Hotel Singapore City Centre

The Voyage of Love Wedding Show at M Hotel Singapore offers couples an exceptional opportunity to experience the full spectrum of wedding planning. From exclusive in-house wedding themes curated specifically for M couples to a tasting of signature wedding dishes, this event provides a comprehensive preview of what your big day could look like. You'll also get to explore the Bridal Suite and actual wedding themes in the Banquet Suite and Anson Ballroom, giving you the perfect chance to visualise your dream wedding

 On top of this, attendees can unlock up to $5,500 in exclusive perks, Including cash rebates, free-flow beverages, and luxurious upgrades. Confirm your wedding during the event to enter a lucky draw with amazing prizes, such as a 3D2N staycation at M Social Phuket with a $300 travel voucher, and many more! 

 It’s a perfect event to plan your dream wedding, all under one roof.

### Why should couples choose M Hotel Singapore City Centre for their special day?

Celebrate your love in style at M Hotel Singapore City Centre, where dream weddings come to life. For grand celebrations, the Banquet Suite offers an elegant setting with majestic gold pillars, sparkling crystal chandeliers, and seating for up to 320 guests. Equipped with three state-of-the-art panoramic LED video walls and a private kitchen led by an expert culinary team, the suite promises a top-notch banquet experience. The adjoining refurbished VIP lounge makes gown changes effortless, ensuring you’re always picture-perfect. 

 For a more intimate yet equally enchanting experience, the Anson Room features a romantic long aisle, ideal for that unforgettable march-in. With seating for up to 320 guests, it provides a beautiful space for heartfelt celebrations. As your day winds down, retreat to the elegantly designed Bridal Suite complete with an in-room Jacuzzi — the perfect place to relax and relish the beginning of your forever. With M Hotel’s dedicated planners and impeccable service, your wedding will be seamless, personalised, and truly unforgettable.

From exclusive in-house wedding themes curated specifically for M couples to a tasting of signature wedding dishes, this event provides a comprehensive preview of what your big day could look like. You'll also get to explore the Bridal Suite, Banquet Suite and Anson Ballroom, giving you the perfect chance to visualise your dream wedding

 On top of this, attendees can unlock up to $5,500 in exclusive perks, Including cash rebates, tree-flow beverages, ano luxurious upgrades. Confirm your wedding during the event to enter a lucky draw with amazing prizes, such as a 3D2N staycation at M Social Phuket with a $300 travel voucher, and many more! 

 It’s a perfect event to plan your dream wedding, all under one roof.

# How To Create A Wedding Checklist At A Singapore Wedding Fair

 2024-11-22

![Image 5: How To Create A Wedding Checklist At A Singapore Wedding Fair](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241202/20241202093352_89862.jpg)

Wedding fairs are an exciting gateway to planning your dream wedding, but they can feel like a whirlwind if you don’t come prepared. With rows upon rows of vendors, each offering a range of packages, styles, and ideas, it’s easy to become overwhelmed, especially if this is your first time at a [wedding fair in Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/event "Wedding Fair Singapore"). Imagine walking through endless booths of photographers, florists, and planners all vying for your attention. Without a clear plan, you might find yourself missing out on the very details that could bring your wedding vision to life.

Creating a checklist can help you cut through the noise, keeping you focused on the essentials and ensuring that you leave the fair feeling accomplished rather than frazzled. With a solid list in hand, you can explore each booth with intention, compare options confidently, and ultimately have a smooth experience, gaining valuable insights for your big day. Here’s a helpful guide to building that checklist and making the most out of your time at a wedding fair!

### 1.Define your vision beforehand

![Image 6: How To Create A Wedding Checklist At A Singapore Wedding Fair](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241202/20241202093454_82083.jpg)

Before you even step foot into the wedding fair, take some time to envision your ideal wedding. Are you aiming for a grand ballroom affair or a cosy garden ceremony? Do you picture timeless elegance or a modern twist? Knowing your style and general aesthetic preferences will help you quickly identify which vendors align with your vision and which don’t.

A helpful tip is to gather some inspiration from Pinterest, bridal magazines, or social media. Bringing mood boards or inspiration photos can help communicate your vision to potential vendors, making it easier for them to showcase relevant ideas or packages. This is also an excellent time to discuss your budget with your partner – how much are you willing to spend on the venue, the food, and other must-haves?

Having a ballpark figure for your budget will help you ask vendors the right questions. For example, if you have a specific budget for photography, you can immediately ask about packages within your range. This keeps your time focused and prevents you from getting sidetracked by options that don’t match your vision or financial plan. Furthermore, wedding fairs often feature exclusive discounts or promotions that could save you money. Don’t be shy about asking vendors if they’re offering any fair-only deals. However, remember to compare these offers with other quotes you’ve received to ensure you’re still getting the best deal. While discounts can be enticing, staying true to your budget is key to avoiding post-fair regrets.

### 2.Create a priority list and plan key questions for each vendor

![Image 7: How To Create A Wedding Checklist At A Singapore Wedding Fair](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241202/20241202093521_43519.jpg)

To maximise your time, create a priority list of categories you want to explore first, like venues, catering, and photography. Think of this as your [guide to a regret-free wedding](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/trending/the-ultimate-guide-to-a-regret-free-wedding-with-smart-tips "The Ultimate Guide to a Regret-Free Wedding With Smart Tips")! Whether it’s finding the perfect gown or securing a talented photographer, knowing your priorities will help you navigate the fair with ease. Ranking these categories by importance also helps you allocate more time to the must-haves, ensuring you don’t overlook key details.

By making a priority list, you’ll also know where to go first when you arrive. Vendors tend to get busier as the day goes on, so starting with your top picks can mean shorter wait times and more personalised attention.

Additionally, with so many vendors available, having questions prepared in advance helps you make the most out of each interaction. Here are some sample questions to ask:

*   **For venues:**What’s the maximum guest capacity? Are there any in-house services included, like catering or décor? 
*   **For photographers/videographers:**What is included in the package? Do they have experience with your preferred wedding style? 
*   **For florists:**Can they work with your budget? Do they offer seasonal flowers? 
*   **For caterers:**Are there options for dietary restrictions? Do they provide menu tastings? 

 This way, you’ll have a clear picture of what each vendor offers and can make faster, better-informed decisions on the spot. 
### 3.Bring a notebook or use a checklist app

![Image 8: How To Create A Wedding Checklist At A Singapore Wedding Fair](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241202/20241202093708_73064.jpg)

Stay organised by bringing along a notebook or using a checklist app on your phone. Take notes at each vendor booth to track important information like costs, availability, and the services included in each package. Recording these details helps you keep track of each vendor’s unique offerings and can serve as a helpful reference later. Apps like Evernote or Google Keep allow you to take quick notes and capture photos, keeping everything organised in one place.

### 4.Compare options before making decisions

![Image 9: How To Create A Wedding Checklist At A Singapore Wedding Fair](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241202/20241202093729_58890.jpg)

While some vendors may offer deals that seem too good to pass up, avoid making hasty commitments at the fair. Collect information, compare your options afterwards, and discuss with your partner. If you’re leaning towards a particular vendor, note that down and circle back with them after the fair once you’ve weighed all your options. This approach helps you avoid any impulsive decisions and ensures that you’re truly satisfied with each choice.

### 5.Enjoy the process

![Image 10: How To Create A Wedding Checklist At A Singapore Wedding Fair](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241202/20241202093746_62528.jpg)

Lastly, remember to have fun! Attending a wedding fair can be a joyful experience, giving you a chance to bring your wedding vision to life and meet the people who will play a role in your big day. Don't put too much pressure on yourself to get every detail perfect. Your checklist will keep you focused but allow you to explore and enjoy the atmosphere. Who knows, you might even discover unique elements that you hadn't considered.

### Plan your dream wedding with ease

![Image 11: How To Create A Wedding Checklist At A Singapore Wedding Fair](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241202/20241202093803_51376.jpg)

A wedding fair can be a fantastic way to check off items on your [wedding checklist](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/wedding-tools "Wedding Planning Checklist, Wedding Planning Checklist Singapore"). With a bit of preparation, you’ll leave feeling accomplished rather than overwhelmed. By making a comprehensive checklist, bringing essential documents, and setting reminders, you can confidently plan a wedding that matches your vision.

### Sitting in the heart of the central business district and Marina Bay, with panoramic views of the Singapore city skyline, the 583-room PARKROYAL COLLECTION Marina Bay, Singapore is the country's first 'Garden-in-a-Hotel'.

A champion of sustainability, environmental responsibility and advocate for green innovations in the hospitality industry, the hotel is home to one of Southeast Asia's largest indoor sky-lit atrium, containing over 2,400 plants, trees, shrubs and groundcovers from more than 60 varieties of flora spread across 15,000 square feet of space throughout.

Distinctive dining options are available for every palate and occasion, from international and Asian culinary creations at Peppermint, progressive Cantonese cuisine at Peach Blossoms, a selection of over 90 varieties of whiskies and craft cocktails at Portman's Bar, and outdoor relaxation and dining at Skyline Bar. A rooftop Urban Farm spanning 150 square metres houses over 60 varieties of fruits, vegetables, herbs and edible flowers, forming the backbone of the hotel's farm-to-table, farm-to-bar and farm-to-spa concepts.

The 25-metre swimming pool comes alive with 1,380 glowing fibre optic lights at dusk, and a refreshing dip in the pool articulates an experience not unlike the sensation of floating amongst a star-studded galaxy. Fitness facilities are also available for travellers to maintain an active lifestyle on-the-go, including a dedicated Spin Bike Studio with 10 TechnoGym spin bikes, while St. Gregory offers spa treatments and traditional therapies.

Catering to environmentally conscious travellers, PARKROYAL COLLECTION Marina Bay, Singapore focuses on contemporary vibes brought to life through biophilic design, iconic architecture, eco-friendliness and lifestyle experiences.

# Happily Ever After: Disney-Inspired Wedding Dresses

 2024-01-26

Vendor:[Cang-Ai Wedding](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/2/bridal-boutiques/detail/11/cangai-wedding)[France Paris International](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/2/bridal-boutiques/detail/14/franceparis-international)[Korea Artiz Studio](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/2/bridal-boutiques/detail/592/official_sg-koreaartizstudio-com)[Alisha & Lace Wedding Collection](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/2/bridal-boutiques/detail/678/alisha-and-lace-wedding)[Z Wedding Design](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/2/bridal-boutiques/detail/1169/z-wedding)

![Image 6: Happily Ever After: Disney-Inspired Wedding Dresses](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240124/20240124095627_75142.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/woman-holding-her-high-hills-313702/)_

Each of us harbours a fragment of a childhood dream – a yearning to step into the shoes of a Disney princess, to be carried off by a prince, and to experience the enchantment of a fairy tale wedding. Among these milestones, the journey of marriage stands out as a moment that allows us to embrace that princess-like feeling once again. In order to transform this moment into something truly extraordinary and to bring our childhood aspirations to life, we have curated a collection of wedding dresses that appear to have been plucked directly from the world of Disney-inspired tales.

### 1.Sleeping Beauty

![Image 7: Happily Ever After: Disney-Inspired Wedding Dresses](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240124/20240124095656_11032.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Luna Bianca Bridal](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/gowns-dresses-info/3611)_

Sleeping Beauty stands as an iconic fairy tale, its narrative woven around a princess roused from slumber by the gentle kiss of a prince. Though this dress by[Luna Bianca Bridal](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/detail/697/Luna-Bianca-Bridal) may not boast the enchanting capability to change colours while you twirl with your prince, the off-shoulder style and extended sleeves elegantly conform to your body's lines, delicately highlighting your graceful collarbones. This design resonates with the essence of the iconic gown Aurora donned as she danced alongside Prince Philip.

**Address:** 10 North Canal Road Singapore 048823

**Opening Hours:**Monday:12 PM - 8:30 PM | Wednesday - Sunday:12 PM - 8:30 PM

**Telephone:**+65 8114 2888

**Email:**[hello@lunabianca.com.sg](mailto:hello@lunabianca.com.sg)

**Profile:**Click [Here](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/detail/697/Luna-Bianca-Bridal) for our latest information & collection

**Instagram:**[@lunabiancabridal](https://www.instagram.com/LunaBiancaBridal/)

### 2.Ariel

![Image 8: Happily Ever After: Disney-Inspired Wedding Dresses](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240124/20240124095742_32798.jpg)

_Source:_ _[CangAi Wedding](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/gowns-dresses-info/278)_

Capturing the enchantment of the "Little Mermaid" with[CangAi Wedding's mermaid wedding dress](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/gowns-dresses-info/278). The gown's intricate craftsmanship and delicate ruffles mimic a mermaid's tail, while the open-back design adds elegance to the overall dress. This dress embodies the ocean's mysteries and the romanticism of fairy tales, making it a wearable work of art that tells a captivating story with every step. For brides seeking whimsy and a connection to magical narratives, this mermaid wedding dress is a dreamy choice.

**Address**: 85 Tg Pagar Rd, Singapore 088506

**Opening Hours:** Monday - Sunday: 12 PM - 8 PM | Saturday: 11 AM - 9 PM | Sunday: 11 AM - 8 PM

**Telephone:**+65 6220 8520

**Profile:**Click [Here](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/detail/11/cangai-wedding) for our latest information & collection

**Instagram:**[@sg.cangai.wedding](https://www.instagram.com/sg.cangai.wedding/?hl=en)

**Facebook:**[CangAi Wedding SG](https://www.facebook.com/cangaiwedsg/)

Click [Here](https://www.cangaisg.com/) to view their website

### 3.Snow White

![Image 9: Happily Ever After: Disney-Inspired Wedding Dresses](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240221/20240221160103_67932.jpg)

_Source:_ _[La Belle](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/gowns-dresses-info/3019)_[_Couture_](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/gowns-dresses-info/3019)

Although you may not have seven dwarfs at your side, you do have an entourage that includes your seven bridesmaids and a prince ready with a true love's kiss. Embracing the essence of the iconic fairytale, [La Belle Couture](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/gowns-dresses-info/3019) presents a wedding dress perfect for brides enchanted by the tale of Snow White. Adorned with puffy sleeves and a ballgown silhouette with beautiful shimmers, this gown guarantees you'll be the fairest of them all on your wedding day.

**Address**: 87 Tanjong Pagar Rd Singapore 088508

**Opening Hours:** Monday - Sunday: 12:30 PM - 8:30 PM | Sunday: 11:30 AM - 7:30 PM

**Telephone:**+65 6327 3983

**Profile:**Click [Here](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/detail/17/la-belle-couture) for our latest information & collection

**Instagram:**[@labelle_couture](https://www.instagram.com/labelle_couture/)

Click [Here](https://labellecouture.com.sg/) to view their website

### 4.Cinderella

![Image 10: Happily Ever After: Disney-Inspired Wedding Dresses](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240124/20240124095954_52817.jpg)

_Source:_ _[@alisha\_lace.sg](https://www.instagram.com/alisha\_lace.sg/?hl=en)_

Cinderella's enchanting transformation is undeniably one of the most captivating moments. It's hard to deny that at some point, the thought of being touched by the magic of "bibbidi bobbidi boo" and becoming a stunning princess hasn't crossed your mind. Within Alisha & Lace's collection of splendid gowns, a specific creation draws parallels to Cinderella's timeless ensemble. This gown features intricate lace embellished with glistening beads, and its ethereal puffy sleeves are nearly translucent, reminiscent of the enchanting glass slipper. What sets this gown apart is that it won't vanish as the clock chimes midnight, allowing you to bask in its splendour all night long.

**Address:**25 Kreta Ayer Rd, Singapore 088993

**Opening Hours:**Monday - Sunday: 12 PM - 8 PM

**Telephone:**+ 65 9271 5720

**Profile:**Click [Here](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/detail/678/alisha-lace-wedding-collection) for our latest information & collection

**Instagram:**[@alisha_lace.sg](https://www.instagram.com/alisha_lace.sg/?hl=en)

**Facebook:**[Alisha & Lace Singapore](https://www.facebook.com/Alishalacesg)

### 5.Pocahontas

![Image 11: Happily Ever After: Disney-Inspired Wedding Dresses](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240124/20240124100112_15286.jpg)

_Source:_ _[@zwedding](https://www.instagram.com/zwedding/?hl=en)_

With a svelte frame reminiscent of Pocahontas, what wedding ensemble could be more fitting than this gown? It's undoubtedly the living manifestation of what Pocahontas herself would choose. Sculpting the form with grace, this [Z Wedding creation](https://www.instagram.com/p/Crj8SBxSt_n/?hl=en) embraces a tall torso, spotlighting your stunning silhouette. The exquisite floral and leaf embroidery further extends the allure of the jungle, akin to Pocahontas' own natural connection.

**Address:**79B Tg Pagar Rd, Singapore 088500

**Opening Hours:**Tuesday: 12 PM - 9 PM | Thursday - Sunday: 12 PM - 9 PM

**Telephone:**+ 65 9328 6979

**Profile:**Click [Here](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/detail/1169/z-wedding-design) for our latest information & collection

Click [Here](https://www.zwedding.com.sg/) to view their website

### 6.Mulan

![Image 12: Happily Ever After: Disney-Inspired Wedding Dresses](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240124/20240124100215_60669.jpg)

Source: [@the.proposal.bridal](https://www.instagram.com/the.proposal.bridal/)

The classic Chinese narrative of Mulan calls for a traditional Chinese wedding dress as a suitable match. The Bridal Proposal has a beautiful red cheongsam that would be ideal for your journey down the aisle. The exquisite embroidery on the cheongsam adds an extra layer of elegance to it. When you wear this dress, you can be certain that you'll bring honour and joy to your family, just as Mulan did.

**Address:**Capitol Singapore, #01-67&68, Stamford Rd, 178906

**Telephone:**+65 6835 7077

**Opening Hours:**Monday - Sunday 11:00 AM - 9:00 PM

**Instagram:**[@the.proposal.bridal](https://www.instagram.com/the.proposal.bridal/)

**Facebook:**[The Proposal Bridal](https://www.facebook.com/theproposalbridal)

Click [Here](https://www.theproposal.com.sg/) to view their website

### 7.Jasmine

![Image 13: Happily Ever After: Disney-Inspired Wedding Dresses](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240124/20240124103027_64871.jpg)

# Things to Avoid for Your Wedding Skin Care

 2024-10-21

![Image 6: Things to Avoid for Your Wedding Skin Care](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241011/20241011121459_30548.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/white-and-black-plastic-bottle-beside-white-heart-shaped-ornament-KiQt6CC0BvY)_

In order to have glowing skin on your wedding day, you need to make time for a proper skincare routine. If you have any skin issues, a dermatologist can help create a personalized plan, whether you start a year or a week ahead. Let's dive into some skincare tips for couples with Blissful Brides and help you both look and feel your best on your wedding day. Plus, it's a great way to bond over a shared beauty routine!

### Skin Assessment

kin health is a top priority not only for brides but also for grooms, especially as the wedding day approaches. If you and your partner are planning a wedding within 6 months to a year, visiting a dermatologist will provide a thorough skin assessment and personalized skincare and treatment plans.

Dermatologists can also evaluate your current skincare routine based on the specific timeline leading up to your wedding, offering additional or adjusted recommendations to achieve your desired skin goals for your big day.

![Image 7: Things to Avoid for Your Wedding Skin Care](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241011/20241011121616_83521.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/vi-vn/anh/ng-i-ph-n-m-c-ao-khong-tay-mau-nau-819808/)_

### Stay Hydrated and Get Enough Sleep

Dehydration and lack of sleep are two of the biggest enemies of healthy skin. When your body is dehydrated, your skin loses elasticity, becomes dry and irritated, and makeup can appear flaky and uneven.

Additionally, sleep deprivation hinders the skin's cell regeneration process, leading to dullness, dark circles, and increased oil production, which can contribute to breakouts.

Therefore, be sure to drink 6-8 glasses of water daily (approximately 1.5-2 liters) and get 7-8 hours of sleep each night to maintain a fresh, healthy complexion. This routine will not only help you prepare for your wedding but also ensure that you and your partner radiate on your special day.

![Image 8: Things to Avoid for Your Wedding Skin Care](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241011/20241011121728_98063.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/vi-vn/anh/ly-u-ng-n-c-trong-su-t-1633940/)_

### Nurture Silky and Shiny Hair

A healthy, lustrous head of hair is the crowning glory that completes a bride or groom's overall look on their special day. Beautiful hair not only boosts confidence when wearing a wedding gown or a dapper suit but also creates striking highlights in wedding photos. Starting hair care early ensures a strong, versatile mane that's ready to shine on your wedding day.

Consult with a makeup and hair stylist for expert advice on potential hairstyles or color changes to ensure your overall appearance harmonizes with your facial features, makeup style, and desired hairstyle.

![Image 9: Things to Avoid for Your Wedding Skin Care](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241011/20241011121824_43704.jpg)

_Source:_[_Pexels_](https://www.pexels.com/vi-vn/anh/ng-i-ph-n-m-m-c-i-n-m-tren-gi-ng-tr-ng-206509/)

### Avoid Over-Exfoliating

We often hear about the importance of exfoliation, and this becomes even more critical when preparing for a wedding. When done correctly, exfoliation not only removes dead skin cells but also reveals radiant, glowing skin. However, over-exfoliating or using harsh products can damage the skin.

To ensure you choose the right products and frequency for your skin type, consult with a dermatologist. They can help you select the optimal exfoliation method to keep your skin in its best condition for your big day.

![Image 10: Things to Avoid for Your Wedding Skin Care](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241011/20241011121913_46945.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/vi-vn/anh/ng-i-d-i-m-t-tim-ki-m-m-m-c-i-6543489/)_

### Avoid Sudden Changes to Your Skincare Routine and Products

If you're considering treating yourself to a new skincare set or beauty treatments before your big day, go for it! However, remember that suddenly changing your skincare routine or trying out new treatments right before your wedding might not be the best idea. To ensure your skin is in its best condition on your wedding day, give your skin time to adjust to new products.

It's best to start by trying one or two products a few months before your wedding, then gradually incorporate them into your current skincare routine. Additionally, consider the worst-case scenario: what if the product doesn't suit you and causes a reaction or breakout? Will you have enough time to adjust, treat it, and return to your usual routine?

Consulting a dermatologist before adding any new ingredients to your skincare routine is especially important.

![Image 11: Things to Avoid for Your Wedding Skin Care](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241011/20241011122021_22414.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/vi-vn/anh/anh-sang-nha-ngoi-nha-can-nha-4239013/)_

### Limit Sun Exposure

For brides who love beach parties and sunbathing: a tanned complexion gives a healthy, radiant look and evokes memories of wonderful family vacations. However, excessive sun exposure can lead to sunburn and, worse, long-term skin damage. Especially for brides who prefer backless or strapless wedding dresses, tan lines can make you feel less confident on your big day.

To ensure you have healthy, glowing skin, brides and grooms should use sunscreen or prepare cooling gel packs and limit sun exposure. This will help prevent redness, sunburn, and heatstroke, which can affect your mood on your wedding day.

![Image 12: Things to Avoid for Your Wedding Skin Care](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241011/20241011122124_61204.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/vi-vn/anh/ng-i-dan-ong-va-ph-n-n-m-tren-bai-cat-tr-ng-g-n-b-bi-n-1198839/)_

_In addition to skincare, remember to relax, exercise regularly, and eat a healthy diet to maintain optimal health. A healthy body will make you shine brighter on your wedding day. Blissful Brides believes that with these skincare tips, you can confidently shine on your big day and take care of each other not only before the wedding but also throughout your life. Additionally, you two can go to reputable [beauty centers](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/merchant/1/beauty-wellness)to find suitable treatments._
