# Preferred Banquet Venues – Mount Faber Peak 

 2024-07-10

Vendor:[Mount Faber Peak](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/15/restaurants/detail/306/mount-faber-peak)

Mount Faber Peak stands as a beacon of elegance and natural beauty, earning its nomination for the Editor's Choice Award for Preferred Banquet Venues. Nestled atop the verdant hills, it offers couples an unparalleled setting for their wedding celebrations, combining breathtaking views of the cityscape with the tranquillity of the harbour below. Its uniqueness lies in the seamless integration of lush greenery and modern sophistication, providing couples with a picturesque backdrop and an unforgettable experience. With venues ranging from intimate dining rooms to expansive ballrooms, Mount Faber Peak caters to every couple's vision, ensuring that each celebration is as unique as the love it commemorates.

![Image 6: Preferred Banquet Venues – Mount Faber Peak ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240709/20240709094616_64511.jpg)

Nestled within Mount Faber Peak, the Angsana Glasshouse beckons couples seeking an intimate and enchanting space to celebrate their love surrounded by their nearest and dearest. Enclosed in glass walls revealing gorgeous sea panoramas and lush garden vistas, this ethereal alcove elevates wedding celebrations to new heights of luxury and romance. With the city's skyline as its backdrop, the Angsana Glasshouse offers nature-loving couples a serene oasis, capturing the essence of Singapore as a verdant garden city.

![Image 7: Preferred Banquet Venues – Mount Faber Peak ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240709/20240709094701_61424.jpg)

For couples who are envisioning a grander celebration, Mount Faber Peak presents two stunning options. Firstly, their signature Ballroom sets the stage for larger gatherings, accommodating up to 200 guests with unparalleled elegance. Featuring floor-to-ceiling glass windows that showcase the mesmerising cable car line and picturesque harbour, the Ballroom promises a breathtaking backdrop for memorable festivities. Secondly, the botanical-themed Arbora restaurant offers an alfresco wedding experience amidst lush greenery, catering to 120 guests. With its natural ambience and captivating surroundings, Arbora is an idyllic setting for couples seeking an intimate yet enchanting celebration amidst nature's embrace.

![Image 8: Preferred Banquet Venues – Mount Faber Peak ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240709/20240709094718_37385.jpg)

Moreover, couples can opt for the Garden Solemnisation—a romantic addition to their celebration. Couples get to enjoy a grand entrance down the elegant spiral staircase, surrounded by the serene beauty of nature. Seal your love by ringing the Bells of Happiness, an enchanting symbol of everlasting bliss that echoes through the hilltop sanctuary.

![Image 9: Preferred Banquet Venues – Mount Faber Peak ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240709/20240709094737_53397.jpg)

Beyond the gorgeous location, Mount Faber Peak boasts a large array of food options guaranteed to accommodate every couple’s and their guest’s preferences. With an exquisite selection of menus ranging from Chinese banquets to modern European sets and international buffets, couples have the freedom to choose a dining experience that perfectly reflects their tastes and preferences. Complimentary food tastings for four guests, available for the Asian Fusion and Modern European Set based on the confirmed menu, ensuring every dish surpasses expectations.

![Image 10: Preferred Banquet Venues – Mount Faber Peak ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240709/20240709094753_24270.jpg)

Additionally, during the wedding day itself, guests can indulge in a free flow of soft drinks, orange juice, and lime juice throughout the event. For those looking to raise a toast, each event includes a barrel of Tiger draught beer (30 Litres) and one bottle of house wine per 10 guests, available in red wine, white wine, or Moscato varieties. From refreshing beverages to culinary delights, every detail is meticulously crafted to elevate the dining experience and make each moment unforgettable.

Mount Faber Peak brings wedding decorations to a new level with an exquisite array of offerings designed to elevate every moment of your special day. Fresh floral centrepieces adorn each table, including two special arrangements for VIP tables, while elegant floral stands grace the stage or aisle, creating an ambience of natural beauty and sophistication. Specially adorned VIP tables and chairs, complete with complimentary seat covers, welcome guests with grace and charm. The highlight of the décor is the elegant five-tier model wedding ceremonial cake, a piece that adds grandeur to the occasion. The champagne pyramid, accompanied by a complimentary bottle of champagne for toasting, adds sparkle and effervescence to the celebrations. Last but not least, the march-in is enhanced by a mesmerising dry ice effect.

![Image 11: Preferred Banquet Venues – Mount Faber Peak ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240709/20240709094816_83302.jpg)

In addition to the stunning décor, Mount Faber Peak offers an array of privileges to enhance your wedding experience. Couples enjoy complimentary wedding invitation cards, a choice of wedding favours for all confirmed guests, and a stylish red packet box and guest book for the reception table! Lastly, the VIP bridal car lot and complimentary valet parking, along with a complimentary two-way 49-seat coach service, add convenience and luxury to the celebration.

In essence, Mount Faber Peak stands as a testament to elegance and natural allure, deserving its recognition as the Editor's Choice Award for Preferred Banquet Venues, with its breathtaking views and impeccable services. Don't miss the opportunity to create unforgettable memories at Mount Faber Peak, where every detail has been carefully curated and prepared for your special day. Join the ranks of delighted couples and choose Mount Faber Peak as your dream wedding destination today!

# Dive into Forever: Exchange Vows at a One-of-A-Kind Solemnisation Venue, The Robertson House

 2024-07-09

A calm, radiant and historically significant oasis tucked in Central Singapore. The best kept secret for your momentous occasion.

The Robertson House by The Crest Collection is situated at the heart of bustling Clarke Quay, where important commodity trades once took place along the Singapore River. By carefully preserving a piece of history through its sleek monochrome interior, The Robertson House hopes to provide guests with a refreshing experience through its meticulously designed rooms and event facilities, complemented by warm hospitality.

![Image 6: Dive into Forever: Exchange Vows at a One-of-A-Kind Solemnisation Venue, The Robertson House](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708140635_13131.jpg)

![Image 7: Dive into Forever: Exchange Vows at a One-of-A-Kind Solemnisation Venue, The Robertson House](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708140643_26396.jpg)

### Poolside Promises

Beyond timeless narratives, The Robertson House by The Crest Collection is the refined venue perfect for your intimate solemnisations and cosy soirées at sunset.

![Image 8: Dive into Forever: Exchange Vows at a One-of-A-Kind Solemnisation Venue, The Robertson House](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708140708_82642.jpg)

Robertson 4, the main function room of The Robertson House, boasts a fresh semi-outdoor concept which enables guests to enjoy the best of both worlds. Witness the couple exchange promises which last a lifetime in the cool comfort of a sophistically decorated function room, as sunlight dances across brilliant blue waters beyond the floor-to-ceiling windows.

![Image 9: Dive into Forever: Exchange Vows at a One-of-A-Kind Solemnisation Venue, The Robertson House](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708140724_39773.jpg)
This once-in-a-lifetime occasion deserves only to be captured in the best light. Step out onto the wooden pool deck with your partner in hand, with radiant early morning rays or crimson hues of sunset serving as the perfect complement for immaculate outfits and wide smiles.

![Image 10: Dive into Forever: Exchange Vows at a One-of-A-Kind Solemnisation Venue, The Robertson House](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708140738_18477.jpg)
### Familiar Recipes with a Delightful Twist

After the solemnization ceremony, adjourn for a delightful dining experience by Entrepôt, The Robertson House’s signature restaurant. Curate tantalising dishes according to the tastes of you and your guests. For the adventurous, seize the opportunity to feature a novel memu which will definitely be the talk of the town.

The team behind Entrepôt is committed to ensure a wonderful and exotic dining experience for your special occasion. Entrepôt’s menu showcases a unique medley of Anglo-Asian culinary excellence, where familiar Asian flavours meet European influences in perfect harmony. Besides using premium cuts of meat, freshest catches of the sea and seasonal produce, even the simplest ingredients are elevated. The wonderful fusion of flavours culminates in enticing dishes, which are spin-offs from local favourites such as _Claypot Rice_ and _Satay._

Relax and clink wine glasses under the city lights, as attentive servers ensure that your needs are well taken care of.

![Image 11: Dive into Forever: Exchange Vows at a One-of-A-Kind Solemnisation Venue, The Robertson House](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708140755_81440.jpg)
### Make your One-of-A-Kind Wedding a Reality

With its unique combination of beautiful waters under a clear sky, The Robertson House by The Crest Collection presents itself as the perfect location to begin the next phase of your life with your other half.

With The Robertson House by The Crest Collection’s recent soft-opening, register for your solemnisation by 31 March 2024 to enjoy a 2D1N anniversary stay in the stunning Panoramic Room and a delectable breakfast for two.

# Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day

 2024-07-08

Vendor:[Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/15/restaurants/detail/1249/jumbo-restaurant)

![Image 6: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115540_98096.jpg)

_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

Marriage is a momentous occasion for all involved, from the couple at the centre of it all to your loved ones. As you prepare to embark on a new and exciting chapter of your life, Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine promises to deliver an experience that exudes understated refinement and classic elegance with overtones of traditional Chinese décor and delicate, light and heartwarming culinary dishes. With Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine’s catering expertise, you can be assured that every step of your wedding banquet will be an enjoyable experience.

### Choose From a Range of Stunning Venues

At Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine, you’re spoilt for choices with the four ballrooms available for weddings. If you’re keen on a grand wedding to accommodate all your loved ones, go for the bright and spacious **Amber Hall** capable of holding up to 24 banquet tables.

![Image 7: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115607_38239.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

On the other hand, if you’d prefer a smaller and more intimate ceremony, the **Beryl Hall** is perfect for you. Capable of holding 14 banquet tables, its smaller area lends itself to creating a cosier atmosphere where you can really soak in and enjoy the company of those most important to you on your important day.

![Image 8: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115633_59785.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

Alternatively, for those looking for a grand venue large enough to hold massive celebrations and a great number of guests there to witness your love, the **Amber Hall and Beryl Hall** can be combined into a majestic ballroom capable of holding up to 42 tables. You can be sure with this option that there will be ample space for all those special and dear to you!

![Image 9: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115652_40546.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

For those looking to add extra oomph with their wedding decorations, the **Celestine Hall**, which holds up to 18 banquet tables, allows for flower standees to be arranged along the aisle to add a refreshing pop of colour to your wedding. Picture yourself taking each step down the aisle towards your future while flanked by the fragrance of the beautiful flowers.

![Image 10](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115710_59707.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

![Image 11: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115726_91402.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

If you’re looking for ultimate privacy and a space just big enough to hold your closest family and friends, you can consider the **VIP private rooms**. Available for use with a minimum spend, enjoy a dedicated butler service and delicious Teochew dishes in utmost comfort and privacy.

![Image 12: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115749_73092.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

### Transform Your Venue to the Ballroom of Your Dreams

Regardless of which venue you choose, they’ll need to be absolutely decked out and decorated to give that extra oomph to your wedding. Opt for one of Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine’s three decoration packages and entrust your venue to the hands of their team of expert wedding stylists. From the **Pretty Pastel** theme which offers light and bright colours for a whimsical wedding, to the **Boho Bliss** theme of warm and cosy beige shades for an elegant setting and the **Scarlet Romance** theme which will have your chosen ballroom decked out in the passionate red and pink shades of love, turn your venue into the one of your dreams under the expertise of Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine and their team of wedding stylists.

### Serve up the best of the best Teochew dishes for your banquet

What’s a wedding without the banquet dinner? Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine specialises in creating iconic Teochew classics, taking familiar homely tastes to the next level in flavours and textures. Highlights from the wedding menu span from a delicate steamed pomfret to a stunning wok-fried mud crab, from a crisp-skinned yet succulent roasted suckling pig to a luxuriously smooth yam paste. Experience a variety of flavours and textures with each dish you eat to create an elevated oriental dining experience.

![Image 13: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115826_44346.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

![Image 14: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115842_11364.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

Choose from 3 different 8-course menus with different price points and dishes available. With the range of menu options, there’s sure to be the perfect lineup of dishes at your price preference!

### The Bliss Menu

The Bliss Menu comes in at $899++ per table of 10 guests and offers delicacies like Pig Trotter Terrine as part of a Combination Platter as well as the Teochew ‘Puning’ Fermented Bean Chicken.

![Image 15: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115903_43893.jpg)

_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

![Image 16: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115920_88833.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

### The Everlasting Menu

The Everlasting Menu, priced at $1,299++ per table of 10 guests, shares similar dishes with the Bliss Menu but made with elevated ingredients to offer the ultimate eating experience for you and your guests. Some dishes on this menu include the Braised Duck with Beancurd and Wok Fried Shelled King Prawn with Golden Salted Egg.

![Image 17: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115939_14128.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

![Image 18: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708115954_92493.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

### The Celestial Menu

Coming in at the price tag of $1,699++ per table of 10 guests, expect to be stunned by the most exquisite and splendid dishes that Teochew cuisine has to offer as they are brought to your table one by one. Among these iconic and show-stopping dishes are the Roasted Suckling Pig Marinated with Five Spices and Teochew Superior Shark’s Fin Soup, in Claypot Style to wow your taste buds and weave a truly unforgettable dining experience.

![Image 19: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708120012_18936.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

![Image 20: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine: Timeless and Traditional Cuisine for Your Big Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240708/20240708120031_63200.jpg)
_Source: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine_

### The Vegetarian Menu

Fret not if you have special dietary requirements for your banquet! Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine has a unique vegetarian menu composed of vegetarian dishes for only an additional $88++ per person. No pork no lard menus are also available on request to accommodate any and every eating preference!

### Craft the Wedding of Your Dreams in Tradition

At Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine, their menus feature a repertoire of authentic Teochew delicacies, using only the freshest ingredients and purest methods of preparation. As you celebrate your love and the future ahead, feast on the epitome of Teochew dishes that pays tribute to the long-standing culinary traditions of one of Singapore’s founding Chinese dialect groups at your wedding banquet. With Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine’s expertise in wedding banquets, the wedding of your dreams will be a truly unforgettable experience for you and your family.

The Wedding Naturalist
Tucked away in the eastern corner of Singapore lies
Changi Cove
, a serene and picturesque venue for couples looking to tie the knot. It is also conveniently located near Changi Airport and easily accessible by public transportation, certainly ideal for the couple and their guests. Beyond the prime location, Changi Cove does not disappoint with their venues, top-notch service and quality food.
💍
For couples,
read on
to find out why Changi Cove is the number one choice for your special day.

# The Wedding Naturalist 

 2024-06-28

### Unparalleled luxury, distinctive charm

Changi Cove Singapore is a unique destination experience with modern contemporary venues set in nature. Being seamlessly integrated with nature, the venue offers guests a tranquil retreat amidst lush greenery and serene surroundings. Notwithstanding, Changi Cove also has a reputation for being a stellar choice among couples looking to experience the wedding of their dreams. From the Auditorium for weddings, to the Conservatory and Pulai Deck for solemnisations, couples can opt for whichever their heart desires.

The Auditorium is a 4,000 sq ft pillarless woody & whimsical themed space with a 2-storey high ceiling looking out to a lush green slope. Covered in natural earthy tones and accompanied by a full length two-storey glass window facing Changi Coves’ scenic foliage, it makes a perfect spot for couples looking for something out-of-the-ordinary and in touch with nature. To add, the windows allow for natural light to filter in, creating a bright and airy atmosphere that is guaranteed to produce the most picturesque shots. With its elegant long tables and dainty decorations, the venue itself is nothing short of being ethereal. This indoor venue can accommodate up to 220 people and will be suitable for couples looking to host a grand affair.

![Image 5: The Wedding Naturalist ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240628/20240628175510_51885.jpg)

_First variation of decorations in The Auditorium_

![Image 6: The Wedding Naturalist ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240628/20240628175529_34682.jpg)

_Second variation of decorations in The Auditorium_

![Image 7: The Wedding Naturalist ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240628/20240628175551_95077.jpg)

_Third variation of decorations in The Auditorium_

Conversely, outdoor venues like the Pulai Deck or conservatory are suited for more intimate affairs of up to 40 people. The conservatory, which is indoors, offers panoramic views of the surrounding greenery, allowing guests to immerse themselves in nature while being comfortably seated indoors. The Pulai Deck is located outdoors and allows for couples to fully immerse themselves amidst the verdant foliage and scenic views. Both of these smaller venues boast of a distinct, charming style that couples are guaranteed to fall in love with.

 SINGAPORE WEDDING PORTAL GUIDE 

 DEALS FROM WEDDING VENDORS 

 Blissful Brides is an all-in-one wedding guide in Singapore that strives to help all soon-to-be-married couples turn their ideal wedding into a reality by providing the necessary tools they need. With an eclectic range of available resources on our portal, we hope that couples can enjoy an enjoyable and stress-free experience when arranging their wedding. In the wedding planning industry, Blissful Brides has gained more than 20 years of experience, thus forming a solid connection with our excellent vendors. We have many different wedding vendors you can hire, each offering variety of jewellery, venues, restaurants, and dresses options. 

 Our wedding vendors are arranged according to their provided services, allowing couples to find the resources they need quickly. All you need is to enter a particular category you are looking at to discover the range of wedding vendors in that particular category. Many of those featured on our portal has been in this industry for a long time, and have earned themselves a solid reputation. Any couple who chooses either one can rest assured that they are in good hands. Couples can also better plan their wedding with the vendors’ professional assistance. Apart from the guide to different vendors available in Singapore, our website also features wedding deals that help couples keep to their set budget when planning their wedding. 

 For couples in Singapore that need more resources when planning their wedding, Blissful Brides has a magazine that will surely help any couple plan their perfect wedding. It is filled with gorgeous pictures and informative articles; couples can get lots of inspiration from browsing through. Besides our magazine, couples can also find the resources they need by looking through our website. We have many entertaining and informative articles ranging that helps couples find solutions to different problems, from financial management, relationships, and beauty and wellness. 

 Apart from our wedding planning guides, Blissful Brides is also known for being the Blissful Outdoor Wedding Shows (BOWS) organiser. Held three times a year, the highly anticipated wedding show is lined up with many exciting programmes. There are numerous deals and discounts that couples can find from the variety of exceptional wedding planners. Being one of Singapore’s most prominent events, couples can enjoy unbeatable convenience when visiting the wedding show. Besides superb deals, couples will also receive awesome door gifts and are able to win attractive prizes during the event. 

 Blissful Brides is without a doubt a one-stop guide to all the resources you need in Singapore to plan your wedding. You may send any enquiries you might have via the “Contact Us” page for any questions. Our friendly and professional team will be happy to assist you as much as they can. 

 We look forward to helping you with your wedding planning through our resources.

With an eclectic range of available resources on our portal, we hope that couples can enjoy an enjoyable and stress-free experience when arranging their wedding. In the wedding planning industry, Blissful Brides has gained more than 20 years of experience, thus forming a solid connection with our excellent vendors. We have many different wedding vendors you can hire, each offering variety of jewellery, venues, restaurants, and dresses options. 

 Our wedding vendors are arranged according to their provided services, allowing couples to find the resources they need quickly. All you need is to enter a particular category you are looking at to discover the range of wedding vendors in that particular category. Many of those featured on our portal has been in this industry for a long time, and have earned themselves a solid reputation. Any couple who chooses either one can rest assured that they are in good hands. Couples can also better plan their wedding with the vendors’ professional assistance. Apart from the guide to different vendors available in Singapore, our website also features wedding deals that help couples keep to their set budget when planning their wedding. 

 For couples in Singapore that need more resources when planning their wedding, Blissful Brides has a magazine that will surely help any couple plan their perfect wedding. It is filled with gorgeous pictures and informative articles; couples can get lots of inspiration from browsing through. Besides our magazine, couples can also find the resources they need by looking through our website. We have many entertaining and informative articles ranging that helps couples find solutions to different problems, from financial management, relationships, and beauty and wellness. 

 Apart from our wedding planning guides, Blissful Brides is also known for being the Blissful Outdoor Wedding Shows (BOWS) organiser. Being one of Singapore’s most prominent events, couples can enjoy unbeatable convenience when visiting the wedding show. Besides superb deals, couples will also receive awesome door gifts and are able to win attractive prizes during the event. 

 Blissful Brides is without a doubt a one-stop guide to all the resources you need in Singapore to plan your wedding. You may send any enquiries you might have via the “Contact Us” page for any questions. Our friendly and professional team will be happy to assist you as much as they can.

### Our Services

Elevate your wedding experience to new heights at PARKROYAL on Beach Road, now featuring our stunning new LED display wall. Imagine exchanging vows against a backdrop of mesmerizing visuals that add an enchanting touch to your special day. Our state-of-the-art LED display wall offers endless possibilities to personalise your wedding, from captivating images and videos to immersive ambiances that reflect your unique love story.

Whether you envision a romantic garden-themed affair or a glamorous evening celebration, our dedicated celebration curators will help you bring your vision to life, ensuring every detail is flawlessly executed. With the combination of our exquisite venue, exceptional service, and the transformative power of our LED display wall, your wedding at PARKROYAL on Beach Road will be an unforgettable experience for you and your guests.

No matter your preference, our versatile venue options cater to your desires. Choose from our grand ballrooms featuring high ceilings and crystal chandeliers or opt for an intimate space with cosy seating and warm lighting – all designed to suit your individual style.

Conveniently located near the city centre in Bugis, PARKROYAL on Beach Road is within walking distance of both Bugis and Nicoll Highway MRT stations and offers easy access to major expressways, making it an ideal venue for you and your guests.

Contact our celebration curators at +65 6505 5697 or email [celebrate.prsin@parkroyalhotels.com](mailto:celebrate.prsin@parkroyalhotels.com) to enquire and secure your exclusive limited-time savings.Alternatively, book a site visit appointment with our wedding curators directly [here](https://www.tablecheck.com/en/shops/parkroyal-beach-road-wedding/reserve).

# A Wedding Venue dripped with luxury and sophistication at PARKROYAL on Beach Road

### Elegant Event Spaces

The spaces at PARKROYAL on Beach Road feature two stunning pillarless ballrooms, each designed to elevate any celebration to new heights. With ceilings that seem to touch the sky and LED walls that cast a mesmerizing glow, these event spaces create an ambience that is nothing short of magical. Perfect for weddings, corporate functions, and any special occasion, guests are transported to a world of refined luxury from the moment they step inside.

Imagine exchanging vows bathed in the soft, golden hues of the setting sun, with the city skyline as your romantic backdrop.

Whether you choose to have a daytime celebration with the glistening pool waters or an evening affair under the city lights, the Poolside adapts to your vision, offering versatility and charm in equal measure.

# Peach Garden 桃苑 – the stellar choice for your special day

 2024-05-21

Vendor:[Peach Garden Restaurant](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/15/restaurants/detail/109/peach-garden-chinese-restaurant)

Peach Garden 桃苑 is a renowned restaurant chain in Singapore known for its Cantonese cuisine. It has six outlets across the island, including in shopping malls and standalone locations. Here are some key points about Peach Garden and why couples should consider them for their big day:

### Venues for any theme your heart desires

Peach Garden 桃苑 has 4 out of 6 Peach Garden outlets available for weddings: The Heeren, OCBC Centre, Thomson Plaza & The Metropolis. All outlets have different themes and capacities.

Firstly, amidst the hustle and bustle of Orchard lies Peach Garden @ The Heeren. The Heeren is a haven of refined elegance and has a maximum capacity of 200 people. The spacious venue coupled with the cream-coloured theme, conveys a touch of gracefulness that is guaranteed to make any couples’ special day remain eternally stylish. The background with an overview of Orchard road or its Main Hall that features an ocean-like theme, providing a beautiful backdrop for wedding photos. Overall, The Heeren embodies a harmonious blend of modernity and elegance, where timeless principles meet contemporary innovation to create a refined and sophisticated aesthetic and experience.

![Image 5: Peach Garden 桃苑 – the stellar choice for your special day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240521/20240521134410_73990.jpg)

_Peach Garden @ The Heeren_

Secondly, Peach Garden @ OCBC Centre has a capacity of 360 people, the most among Peach Garden’s venues – which can accommodate all of the guests comfortably. Situated on the heights of Level 33, it is guaranteed to provide a stunning view and breath-taking atmosphere to elevate your wedding. This prime location provides spectacular sights through the glass walls, and overlooks the Singapore River, Esplanade and Singapore Flyers. To add, the natural light filtering in makes the ballroom the best choice for picturesque shots. All in all, the location at OCBC Centre is certainly unique as it provides many beautiful scenes of the Singapore skyline from its heights.

![Image 6: Peach Garden 桃苑 – the stellar choice for your special day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240521/20240521134501_31333.jpg)

_Peach Garden @ OCBC Centre_

The third venue is located in Peach Garden @ Thomson Plaza, and it can accommodate up to 300 guests. Embodying a theme of Timeless Tradition, this venue is perfect for couples looking to host weddings in favour of their family, who might prefer a more traditional venue and vibe. At Thomson Plaza, the traditional decorations and customs are not tacky, but instead convey a deep sense of Chinese culture and heritage. The little dashes of red across the venue in the forms of flower bouquets, cutlery to napkins adheres closely to Chinese tradition and provides for a meaningful wedding day that pays homage to one's culture and heritage.

![Image 7: Peach Garden 桃苑 – the stellar choice for your special day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240521/20240521134534_36255.jpg)

_Peach Garden @ Thomson Plaza_

Last but not least, Peach Garden @ The Metropolis has a theme of Sunlit Simplicity and can host up to 120 guests. Although the smallest venue among all, it provides a cosy ambience for the wedding. With its floor-to-ceiling glass panels and abundant natural sunlight, this venue is perfect for capturing beautiful wedding luncheon photos, leaving couples with beautiful pictures that transcends their special day.

![Image 8: Peach Garden 桃苑 – the stellar choice for your special day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240521/20240521134619_43353.jpg)

_Peach Garden @ The Metropolis_

### Mouth-watering cuisine, bespoke creations

Peach Garden offers the most exquisite Cantonese dishes, bound to please the young and old. Pique your taste buds with signature dishes like Suckling Pig Combination Platter, Roasted Golden Suckling Pig, Stewed Ee-fu Noodle with Baby Lobster, Spring Onion and Ginger. Beyond being skilled in whipping up Cantonese delights, Peach Garden can even tailor a personalised wedding menu exclusively for your special day!

![Image 9: Peach Garden 桃苑 – the stellar choice for your special day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240521/20240521134824_45817.jpg)

_Featuring the Suckling Pig Platter and Tiger King Prawn with Superior Soya Sauce_

### Tailor-made packages, worthwhile pricings

Peach Garden’s attention to detail doesn’t just stop at venues and food – they have a dedicated team ready to assist couples throughout the planning process, ensuring a seamless and personalised experience. Of course, there is also flexibility in accommodating various budget levels so all couples can have a wedding day within their financial means. Although early bookings are recommended, Peach Garden is flexible enough to accommodate events with as little as 1-2 month’s notice if possible! This certainly eases the burden on stressed out couples rushing to plan their wedding.

Despite Peach Garden’s notable brand, they still offer pricing that remains value for money without compromising the quality of their food and services. Couples can enjoy a top-tier wedding experience without breaking the bank; from $1038++ per table onwards (for Packages), Peach Garden is also able to customise bespoke packages for smaller scale events such as solemnization or smaller wedding groups. The new offering for Solemnization: the Traditional Push Cart Dim Sum is starting from $88++ per person (minimum 3 tables). This menu features a selection of our meticulously crafted signature dim sum, including Steamed Fresh Prawn Dumpling, Steamed Siew Mai with Fish Roe, Deep-fried Bean Skin Roll with Seaweed, and more. Each meal is complemented with a main course and dessert for a memorable dining experience.

### Look no further than Peach Garden for your dream wedding

Peach Garden ensures that every wedding and its details is meticulously attended to, offering the couples a fuss-free and seamless experience. They also offer elegant settings with a variety of exquisite decor options to choose from, making sure that the couple’s special day is genuinely memorable. With them, they are able to cherish their special moment without any concerns about the wedding flow.

For more information on weddings at Peach Garden, simply contact their team at [banquet@peachgarden.com.sg](mailto:banquet@peachgarden.com.sg) or at 6252 9833 and be on your way to a memorable wedding!

# Celebrating Love in Elegance: M Hotel Singapore's Unforgettable Wedding Experience

 2024-04-20

Vendor:[M Hotel Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/9/hotels/detail/212/m-hotel-singapore)

![Image 6: Celebrating Love in Elegance: M Hotel Singapore's Unforgettable Wedding Experience](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240419/20240419154915_40013.jpg)

In the heart of Singapore's vibrant cityscape lies a concealed treasure—M Hotel Singapore—an idyllic haven where love stories flourish amidst an atmosphere of charm, romance, and sophistication. For those envisioning a wedding that seamlessly marries modern luxury with timeless elegance, M Hotel stands as the epitome of refined celebration. Here, your once-in-a-lifetime event transcends the ordinary, as M Hotel helps curate an immersive experience etched indelibly into your sweetest memories.

![Image 7: Celebrating Love in Elegance: M Hotel Singapore's Unforgettable Wedding Experience](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240419/20240419154931_74506.jpg)

Step into the enchanting realm of M Hotel's Banquet Suite, an opulent space designed to host up to 320 guests. Impeccably crafted and lavishly furnished, the Banquet Suite boasts cutting-edge technology, ensuring every nuance of your celebration is meticulously captured. The inclusion of a private kitchen and a dedicated culinary team elevates the wedding banquet experience to unparalleled heights.

![Image 8: Celebrating Love in Elegance: M Hotel Singapore's Unforgettable Wedding Experience](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240419/20240419154945_75942.jpg)

The prelude to your significant day commences with meticulous preparation, and M Hotel ensures each moment is as special as the occasion itself. The VIP lounge, adjacent to the Banquet Suite, serves as your private retreat for touch-ups and gown changes, allowing you to emerge resplendent in your finest attire for the magnificent evening ahead. The Bridal Suite, adorned with elegance and featuring an in-room Jacuzzi, provides an enchanting setting for a romantic wedding night—an added layer of luxury to your celebration.

![Image 9: Celebrating Love in Elegance: M Hotel Singapore's Unforgettable Wedding Experience](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240419/20240419155000_21873.jpg)

For those seeking a more intimate affair, the Anson Room beckons with its unique design featuring a lengthy aisle, setting the stage for a romantic march-in. Whether you gravitate towards the grandeur of the Banquet Suite or the intimacy of the Anson Room, M Hotel Singapore caters to individual preferences with versatile spaces that exude sophistication.

![Image 10: Celebrating Love in Elegance: M Hotel Singapore's Unforgettable Wedding Experience](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240419/20240419155018_51797.jpg)

Strategically positioned, just a 5-minute stroll from Tanjong Pagar MRT station, M Hotel Singapore offers unparalleled convenience for you and your guests. The central location ensures accessibility, allowing everyone to be part of your special day effortlessly.

![Image 11: Celebrating Love in Elegance: M Hotel Singapore's Unforgettable Wedding Experience](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240419/20240419155031_67657.jpg)

To heighten the allure of your dream wedding, M Hotel Singapore extends exclusive sign-up benefits. Embrace savings of up to $3800, including a $50 cash rebate per table, an additional bottle of signature M Wine per table, and a plethora of delightful surprises. Indulge in regal pampering and let M Hotel Singapore transform your wedding into an extraordinary and unforgettable affair.

![Image 12: Celebrating Love in Elegance: M Hotel Singapore's Unforgettable Wedding Experience](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240419/20240419155045_60333.jpg)

Your wedding day serves as a mirror reflecting your unique love story, and M Hotel Singapore comprehends the significance of making it truly extraordinary. With enchanting venues, impeccable services, and exclusive offers, M Hotel guarantees that your wedding celebration transcends the ordinary and becomes nothing short of magical.

Join us on Sunday, 12 May as we unveil our newly refurbished pillarless Grand Ballroom, offering unobstructed views and seamless experience for up to 400 guests. Discover the most befitting wedding plans, and unique opportunity to create an elegant and grand affair with us. Picture a grand entrance as you walk down the 38-meter-long aisle, setting the stage for unforgettable lifetime moments. Elevate your experience with our contemporary and sleek LED Wall, a dynamic canvas to showcase cherished memories that will last a lifetime.

Enjoy exclusive privileges when you confirm your wedding with us during this premier showcase, with attractive perks and savings, including up to S$188++* per table, unlimited beer, an additional night's stay, dining credits and more! Be the first 30 couples to RSVP and enjoy complimentary tasting of our wedding menu (valued at $48++) during this showcase, between 12.00pm to 2.30pm.

For more information or enquiries,[RSVP with form below](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/event-detail/911/Love-Always-Wedding-Showcase#tabal).

*Terms and conditions apply.

# 4 Frequently Asked Questions People Have About Guo Da Li

 2022-08-25

![Image 6: 4 Frequently Asked Questions People Have About Guo Da Li](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20220825/20220825110640_47308.jpg)

With all the resources currently available today, including the assistance of a [wedding guide in Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/ "Wedding Guide Singapore"), modern brides no longer have to find it daunting when planning a wedding. However, things can still get tricky, especially when discussing the more conventional aspects of a wedding. Chinese weddings are particularly prone to this, as they are typically brimming with traditions intended to bless the couple’s upcoming marriage.

Among the most prominent Chinese wedding traditions that many families still observe to this day is the [Guo Da Li ceremony](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/chinese-wedding-traditions/the-4-auspicious-must-dos-in-your-guo-da-li-ceremony "The 4 Auspicious Must-Dos In Your Guo Da Li Ceremony"). Guo Da Li is a traditional Chinese wedding custom that has been passed down from generation to generation. If you are curious about what this tradition means and its purpose, read on as this article lays down the answers to some of the most frequently asked questions about the Guo Da Li custom.

### 1.What is Guo Da Li?

Guo Da Li means “the betrothal gifts.” It is a traditional ritual ordinarily performed as part of Chinese weddings and is equivalent to the concept of “dowry” practised in numerous parts of the world. Guo Da Li is a formal ceremony in which the groom’s family presents an elaborate series of gifts and _lai see_ to the bride’s family.

The purpose of this tradition is essentially for the groom to show his sincerity to the bride and her family. Through this ceremony, the groom manifests his intention and promises to look after the bride for the rest of their lives. After the Guo Da Li ceremony, the bride’s family would usually send a gift of gratitude consisting of roughly half the gifts they receive, along with other auspicious items. This gift of appreciation traditionally represents their acceptance of the marriage proposal.

### 2.When should Guo Da Li take place?

Traditionally, the Guo Da Li ceremony should take place between 14 to 60 days prior to the wedding. Many families typically consult the Tung Shin, or the Chinese divination guide, for the most auspicious dates and hours. Additionally, during the ceremony, the groom and a matchmaker, typically an elderly female relative with good fortune, will give the bride’s family various gifts that symbolise fertility and prosperity.

### 3.What is usually needed for Guo Da Li?

The things you must prepare for a Guo Da Li ceremony will depend on the dialect group you belong to. For instance, a Cantonese bride’s ceremony will have a couple of items distinct from those in a Hokkien ceremony. Regardless of your group, the things you will provide for the ceremony must always come in pairs to symbolise good fortune. Here are some typical items you will notice in a Guo Da Li ceremony:

•A betrothal basket

•A red packet carrying the bride’s price

•Two pairs of dragon and phoenix candles

•A red banner to hang over the door

•A platter of roast pork

•Oranges (traditionally 8, which is considered a lucky number)

•Wine or hard liquor

•A traditional wedding cake

•Double happiness stickers

•Jewellery for the bride

### 4. What things should be avoided during a Guo Da Li ceremony?

Before the wedding date and during the Guo Da Li ceremony, the groom and the bride should avoid certain traditional taboos. The grooms are prohibited from showing up during the Guo Da Li but are allowed to accompany their relatives to the bride’s house for the ceremony. However, it is essential that they do not see the bride at any point. On the other hand, the brides should avoid eating Chinese wedding cakes, as it is believed to diminish the bride’s luck.

### Conclusion

Guo Da Li is ultimately a fascinating Chinese wedding tradition that comes with a purpose and has already survived the test of time. Even to this day, many families still observe the Guo Da Li custom, as it is an integral part of Chinese culture and is believed to help couples navigate their way through married life.

# An Insider’s Wedding Scoop: Joanna Soh’s Personal Tips to Nail Your Wedding Day

 2022-11-24

![Image 5: An Insider’s Wedding Scoop: Joanna Soh’s Personal Tips to Nail Your Wedding Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20221124/20221124102243_76662.jpg)

For all the true romantics at heart, your wedding ceremony is one of the most precious once-in-a-lifetime events to be treasured. Surrounded by your closest friends and loved ones, everyone wishes for their wedding to be perfect and memorable for years to come.

However, at the same time, it can be deeply stressful and anxiety-inducing planning for such a grand event — especially when you helmed the majority of the preparations alone like what influencer Joanna Soh did.

Between balancing her full-time job, a burgeoning social media presence, and hectic wedding planning all on her plate, how exactly did Joanna manage this feat? What did she love and regret the most about her wedding? And more importantly, what guidance can she glean regarding all things proposal, wedding prep, and relationship advice?

In this exclusive interview, Joanna candidly shared with us her best ‘big sister' tips to avoid the mistakes she did and slay your wedding day instead.

![Image 6: An Insider’s Wedding Scoop: Joanna Soh’s Personal Tips to Nail Your Wedding Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20221124/20221124102316_56275.jpg)

### A little background on Joanna

Compared to the average working adult, Joanna’s day-to-day life is everything but ordinary. While dedicated to her job as a full-time account manager at 99.Co, you can also find her busily capturing Insta-worthy moments to share with her 70,000 followers.

Take one glance at her social media profile and you’d think she’s the typical lifestyle or beauty influencer. However, there’s more than meets the eye.

Admittedly, she got her start from posting beauty- and fashion-related content when younger, but her content has since matured alongside her. Besides sharing good deals and the occasional foodie recommendation, we can now expect more snippets of her domestic and household life.

![Image 7: An Insider’s Wedding Scoop: Joanna Soh’s Personal Tips to Nail Your Wedding Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20221124/20221124102405_14717.jpg)

### Pre-wedding and day-of wedding obstacles faced

### #1 Self-planning a wedding

For starters, planning any major event from scratch is a huge undertaking — let alone a grand-scaled affair like wedding banquets. There are so many logistical concerns that’ll leave any untrained person feeling overwhelmed.

Initially, Joanna felt confident that she’d manage to cover all the bases for her wedding. It was only after she enlisted the help of an event planner (her friend’s sister) that she realised how many minute details had been missed out.

Although she settled the basics like the wedding gown and suit fittings, the small details like wedding favours/door gifts were accidentally forgotten. They got pushed down by the floods of daily emails received in her inbox.

While these mistakes were never intentional, they do slip our minds quite easily. Even when she was assisted by her friends here and there, nothing compared to the capabilities of a professional.

Things like compiling the guestlist, curating to perfect banquet menu, and selecting an appropriate theme and decor — there are just simply too many things on the wedding checklist. Not to mention, all these need to fall under your budget too.

Apart from the wedding prep itself, there are other pre-wedding businesses to attend to, like your pre-wedding photoshoot.

Moreover, [every wedding planner has their niche](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/trending/top-5-reasons-to-hire-a-wedding-planner-for-your-big-day); some specialise in [destination weddings](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/trending/how-do-you-know-if-destination-weddings-are-for-you), whereas others specialise in month-of or day-of coordinating. It really depends on what sort of help you need.

**Read more:**

[What Should You Prioritise at the Start of Your Wedding?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/trending/what-should-you-prioritise-at-the-start-of-your-wedding-planning)

[Too Busy to Plan Your Wedding? Blissful Brides’ Concierge Offers Complimentary Help For Couples](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/trending/too-busy-to-plan-your-wedding-blissful-brides-concierge-offers-complimentary-help-for-couples)

### #2 Menstrual hormonal acne

Ladies, whenever we hear the words “menstruation” and “hormonal acne”, we know they never bode well. If anything, that time of the month usually spells painful cramps, hormonal imbalances, skin breakouts, and emotions on edge all balled up into one.

And it’s one of the last things any blushing bride would want on her wedding day. Unfortunately, our menstrual cycle can’t exactly be predicted so far (like, one year) in advance throughout the wedding planning process.

In Joanna’s case, she was one of the unlucky few whose cycle coincided with the big day. As a result, she had an unwelcome visitor — a huge, painfully swollen pimple — right before her wedding day. It was so sore that she could barely lift a smile!

Needless to say, this sent her into an immediate frenzy and full-on panic mode. She frantically contacted her wedding makeup artist for advice, but regardless, it was a tough predicament.

Joanna tried all sorts of remedies as recommended by Google: from cold and warm compresses to pimple cream and stickers, but it was all for nought.

Ultimately, because she was pressed for time, she made her way down to her long-time aesthetic clinic, Clifford Clinic, as a last resort. At the clinic, they assessed her pimple condition and administered a S$150 acne jab [Cortisone Shot for Acne] as treatment.

At first, there wasn’t any noticeable change in the swelling. But after a couple of hours sleep, the miracle that Joanna prayed for came true and her pimple completely disappeared almost like magic. Even her makeup artist was astounded!

To Joanna, this S$150 spent was completely justifiable in exchange for rescuing her face in time. Whereas for others, it might not be worth it. Regardless of which you agree with, you have to agree that desperate times do call for desperate measures.

![Image 8: An Insider’s Wedding Scoop: Joanna Soh’s Personal Tips to Nail Your Wedding Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20221124/20221124102617_69899.jpg)

### #3 Slimming down before the wedding

It’s only normal for every bride-to-be to want to look her best for the wedding day, with weight loss or looking slim at the forefront of their mind. Although there are multiple approaches to losing fat in a healthy and consistent manner, here’s Joanna’s golden tip.

Two words, portion control.

As we’re sure most health experts would agree, weight loss is 20% exercise and 80% diet. What we put into our bodies is more impactful than the energy exerted.

Thus, although exercise wasn’t Joanna’s cup of tea, her discipline and consistency in her diet portions allowed her to stay on track with her weight goals. She didn’t need to restrict herself from her favourite foods (e.g. KFC), but limiting the quantity intake made all the difference.

In total, she managed to lose a total of 4.5kg before her actual wedding day.

**Fun fact:**Joanna and her fiance contracted COVID-19 two weeks before the wedding. This inadvertently caused their appetite to shrink a little, and ironically helped them work towards their weight goals despite being sick. Talk about a silver lining behind every cloud!

### #4 Not getting enough sleep

As with any pre-event jitters, falling asleep the night before might be a struggle. Despite taking sleep support pills* as well, Joanna and her husband were only able to sleep for 30 minutes.

Similarly to one’s menstrual cycle, this was not something that could be controlled. You can do your best to follow all the general sleep recommendations, but if your mind is active and full of nerves, sleep just won’t come naturally.

The best tips are just to “sleep earlier” and “avoid using electronics right before bedtime”, remarked Joanna.

*Not to be confused with sleeping pills. This sleep support pill helps to generate melatonin to induce deeper sleep more quickly.

![Image 9: An Insider’s Wedding Scoop: Joanna Soh’s Personal Tips to Nail Your Wedding Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20221124/20221124102734_69512.jpg)
### #5 Slight miscommunication over alcohol package

Of course, no merrymaking is complete without the accompaniment of alcohol. Once the booze is out, the good times roll naturally — or at least that’s what Joanna had in mind.

Prior to the wedding, Joanna actually asked the event manager twice regarding the hotel wedding package’s alcohol policy. Ostensibly, they were given a choice between free-flow beer or wine, of which, they chose the latter. Furthermore, they were told that no pre-event alcohol was allowed and that only regular beverages could be served.

Because of that, she was under the pretence that the wine would only start serving after the wedding solemnisation at around 7.30pm or 8.30pm. But then, that didn’t exactly go according to plan.

As it turns out, Joanna’s wedding guests were actually served the 28 complimentary bottles of wine (one per table) during the solemnisation itself; so much so that during the first course of the banquet, she was notified that all the wine had finished even though the feasting just began.

Flustered, they hurriedly forked out over S$400 more to purchase six more bottles of wine. If she had continued ordering more rounds, this extra alcohol cost would accumulate quickly and burst their wedding budget tremendously.

In hindsight, Joanna reflected that better clarity could’ve been communicated between hotel and newlyweds. And if the package permits a BYO (bring-your-own) alcohol policy, she highly recommends young couples take advantage of it!

![Image 10: An Insider’s Wedding Scoop: Joanna Soh’s Personal Tips to Nail Your Wedding Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20221124/20221124102956_14343.jpg)

### Bonus: Tips for proposals

It’s common knowledge by now but Singapore is not the cheapest city to live in — and wedding proposals are no exception! But between splurging on meaningful milestones and saving for your future together, where do we draw the line?

Luckily, Joanna has a few takeaways to share with us after her (very romantic) yacht proposal.

### #1 Use your best friends as a distraction

When you’re with your spouse 24/7, it’s very hard to keep secrets from them. They see and know your every move, making it nearly impossible to liaise with any vendors for a proposal. So what’s the solution here?

Rope your best friends into the act!

Not only is this the least suspicious method, but your friends can double up as a decoy to make it seem like you’re the one planning their proposal.

In Joanna’s case, her best friend had just purchased a resale flat back then. This meant that her best friend would need to legalise her marriage as soon as possible to secure the unit. One thing led to another and this acted as the perfect ruse for planning Joanna’s proposal in plain sight!

**Fun fact:** Get your friends to bring a nice, pre-planned outfit so at least the bride-to-be gets to look good during the surprise proposal.

### #2 Consider an overseas proposal

You’ve heard about destination weddings, but why not destination proposals? Since booking venues in Singapore can cost a pretty penny, planning your proposal overseas could potentially be both cheaper and offer a nicer scenery.

Because let’s face it, in terms of landscapes, Singapore is fairly limited for choice; unless you opt for a yacht proposal like Joanna’s fiance did, then that’s a different story.

![Image 11: An Insider’s Wedding Scoop: Joanna Soh’s Personal Tips to Nail Your Wedding Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20221124/20221124103200_56988.jpg)

### #3 Always double-check the rules/restrictions of the proposal venue

Singapore is notorious for rules, regulations, and imposing fines. The last thing you’d want is to be penalised for a gorgeous 800-balloon display because it breaches venue restrictions like safety distancing (back at the height of COVID-19).

For your wallet’s sake, Joanna advises it’s better to be safer than sorry.

### #4 Reuse the proposal decor for your wedding decor

Another ingenious tip that Joanna recommends is to not be afraid to re-use your proposal decor for your wedding if the theme fits! Every dollar counts, so why not make your money’s worth by re-purposing your proposal props and decor to elevate your wedding location?

This decision could be the crucial difference between abiding by your budget or breaking the bank.

![Image 12: An Insider’s Wedding Scoop: Joanna Soh’s Personal Tips to Nail Your Wedding Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20221124/20221124103410_53921.jpg)

### Final thoughts

Last but not least, a wedding is the closing of one chapter, and the opening of another. It marks the first milestone to the rest of your forever together with your spouse.

Although weddings involve external parties and families, just remember that at the end of the day, your wedding is a sacred union between the two of you. Prioritise instead, on building a strong foundation of trust and mutual understanding in order to foster healthy communication and compromises within nuptial constraints.

# Unfold Your Love Story at Concorde Hotel Singapore

 2024-04-04

Vendor:[Concorde Hotel Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/9/hotels/detail/500/concorde-hotel-singapore)

![Image 6: Unfold Your Love Story at Concorde Hotel Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240403/20240403150925_11009.jpg)

Nestled in the heart of the city, Concorde Hotel Singapore stands as a beam of elegance and luxury, promising couples a dream wedding venue that exceeds expectations in every aspect. From exquisite event spaces to meticulous wedding planning, Concorde Hotel Singapore sets the stage for your special day.

### Unparalleled Venue Spaces

![Image 7: Unfold Your Love Story at Concorde Hotel Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240403/20240403150956_42130.jpg)

At Concorde Hotel Singapore, no guest list is too extensive. No matter the size of your guest list, Concorde Hotel Singapore offers ample space for your guests, ensuring that everyone is able to busk in joy of the celebrations. The Concorde Ballroom spans an impressive 552 square metres which sets the stage for grand affairs and is capable of accommodating up to 450. For those looking for a more intimate affair, fret not, they also offer a smaller ballroom of 155 square metres, capable of accommodating up to 10 tables. These exceptional venue spaces are more than just settings for your wedding day but they are the heart of your celebrations, ready to infuse your special day with warmth, love and endless laughter.

### Elegance in Every Detail

![Image 8: Unfold Your Love Story at Concorde Hotel Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240403/20240403151025_26427.jpg)

Concorde Hotel Singapore’s ambience and style emanates sophistication and charm in every turn.

Step into the spacious and elegant ballroom, where the pillarless architecture ensures unobstructed views and offers ample space for your event to unfold magnificently. With its open layout concept, the ballroom also allows for seamless flow and optimal arrangements for any occasion. From exquisite chandeliers and high-rise ceilings, Concorde Hotel Singapore boasts picturesque spots for capturing stunning wedding photos that adds a glimmer of splendour to your wedding album. With a keen eye for details, each corner of the hotel is meticulously designed to provide stunning backdrops for you to capture memories that will last for a lifetime.

Furthermore, Concorde Hotel Singapore goes above and beyond in orchestrating your wedding to perfection. From heartfelt speeches to lively music, Concorde Hotel Singapore leaves no detail overlooked. With their high-end JBL speakers, your celebration is ensured to be accompanied by impeccable audio quality throughout your event.

### Tailored to Perfection

![Image 9: Unfold Your Love Story at Concorde Hotel Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240403/20240403151058_68742.jpg)

What truly sets Concorde Hotel Singapore apart is their unwavering commitment to personalised service. At Concorde Hotel Singapore, your wedding vision comes to life with an array of themes tailored to match your desired preferences. Whether you prefer an intimate lunch affair or an elegant wedding dinner, they offer a variety of dining options to suit your preferences and schedule. With a dedicated wedding planner and professional catering team in hand, couples can be rest assured that every aspect of their special day will be meticulously planned and executed to perfection.

If that isn’t enough to convince you, Concorde Hotel Singapore offers free upgrades to dessert buffets and complimentary flow of wines and beers. From exquisite gastronomic delights to attentive service, every element is designed to perfection, creating memories that lasts a lifetime.

### Secure Your Dates Now!

Book your dream wedding now with Concorde Hotel Singapore! At Concorde Hotel Singapore, we understand the rigorous planning needed to bring your visions alive on your special day. That is why we offer ample time for you to work together with our meticulous wedding planners to bring your vision to life. Secure your desired wedding date at least one year in advance with a minimum deposit. Wedding packages at the Concorde Hotel Singapore starts from $1,258+ to $1,498+ per table of 10 persons, offering exceptional value for your special day.

What are you waiting for? Book now and experience the pinnacle of luxury and elegance at Concorde Hotel Singapore, where your special day is crafted to perfection, ensuring that is nothing short of magical!

# Elevate Your Wedding Story to New Heights at Pan Pacific Orchard

 2024-03-30

![Image 5: Elevate Your Wedding Story to New Heights at Pan Pacific Orchard](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240328/20240328170727_73105.jpg)

_Source: @Pan Pacific Orchard_

Nestled along Orchard Road, Pan Pacific Orchard provides a touch of refined luxury for your special day through its unique event spaces. Immersed in the allure of nature, it establishes the perfect setting for a romantic "City in Nature" celebration, adorned with open-air structures and lush greenery. This enchanting haven promises to weave a love story amidst Singapore's vibrant heart, where luxury, beauty, and extraordinary moments come together in a setting crafted for love.

### Say “I Do” with a View

Pan Pacific Orchard invites you to savour the celestial enchantment of your union against the expansive sky at their Cloud Terrace Lawn.

![Image 6: Elevate Your Wedding Story to New Heights at Pan Pacific Orchard](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240328/20240328170749_62527.jpg)

_Source: Pan Pacific Orchard_

Elevated above the city, the Cloud Terrace graces the 18th floor as a rooftop garden meticulously designed to serve as an urban destination and event space in the sky. Nestled amidst silver-hued planting, reflective pools, and a perforated mirror ceiling, it offers a unique and sophisticated atmosphere.

![Image 7: Elevate Your Wedding Story to New Heights at Pan Pacific Orchard](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240328/20240328170807_66286.jpg)

_Source: Pan Pacific Orchard_

Located on the 11th floor of the hotel, the Garden Terrace reveals a carefully crafted botanical sanctuary, showcasing a central lawn surrounded by planter beds, seating squares, and water gardens. Spanning 311 square meters of lush greenery beneath towering ceilings, the Garden Terrace Lawn provides an impressive backdrop suitable for you to take those pivotal steps down the aisle, promising an enchanting beginning amidst the tranquillity of lush greenery.

### A Celebration Amidst the Sky

![Image 8: Elevate Your Wedding Story to New Heights at Pan Pacific Orchard](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240328/20240328170830_18399.jpg)

_Source: Pan Pacific Orchard_

The Claymore Ballroom, perched as one of Orchard Road's loftiest event spaces, sets the stage for an opulent wedding dinner. Hosting up to 430 guests, this expansive, pillarless venue features floor-to-ceiling windows that frame breathtaking city views. As the highest space in the vicinity, it bathes in natural daylight, transitioning into a mesmerising cityscape backdrop by night, promising an unmatched wedding experience. With its ceiling evoking silver cloud pillows and a full-height glass terrace enclosure, the Claymore Ballroom offers an elevated sensation of hosting an event in the sky.

### An Intimate Haven for Cherished Wedding Celebrations

![Image 9: Elevate Your Wedding Story to New Heights at Pan Pacific Orchard](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240328/20240328170853_51585.jpg)

_Source: Pan Pacific Orchard_

In the intimate setting of Scott’s Room, designed for wedding celebrations with your dearest loved ones, natural light bathes the versatile venue, accommodating up to 90 guests for theatre style seating.What distinguishes this space is the presence of two strategically positioned LED displays set against lush garden backdrops. These displays provide a canvas for personalised touches, enabling couples to craft distinctive and customisable experiences that enhance the atmosphere and infuse a personal charm into every celebration.

### Crafting Enchanting Wedding Themes

Pan Pacific Orchard spares no effort when it comes to crafting diverse and captivating wedding themes.

![Image 10: Elevate Your Wedding Story to New Heights at Pan Pacific Orchard](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240328/20240328170922_66860.jpg)

_Source: Pan Pacific Orchard_

Themes at Pan Pacific Orchard vary from a sleek and stylish idyllic setting with modern floral arrangements to the enchanting Euphoria theme, transforming the venue into a dreamlike experience. Picture fluffy clouds mimicked against clear skies, coupled with whimsical romantic setups. Pan Pacific Orchard stands out in the wedding experiences arena due to its dedicated attention to detail in crafting these themes.

### The Ideal Venue to Celebrate Your Love

Pan Pacific Orchard stands as the essential haven where love takes flight. From the captivating panoramas of the Cloud Terrace to the serene embrace of nature in the Garden Terrace, each element creates a unique backdrop for your love story.

Within these walls, your love story unfolds against breathtaking vistas and the tranquillity of nature. With Pan Pacific Orchard, you can be assured of a tranquil and captivating ambience where each moment contributes to a harmonious experience, perfect for creating cherished memories.
