# Wedding Rehearsal Dinner Etiquette: The Dos and Don’ts

 2024-01-29

![Image 5: Wedding Rehearsal Dinner Etiquette: The Dos and Don’ts](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240129/20240129143440_44589.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/clear-wine-glasses-on-table-ADNerVP2LjI)_

In the time leading up to the big day, wedding planning can become both thrilling and frantic. Amidst the flurry of decisions, there is one important event that is often overlooked: the rehearsal dinner.

It is this pre-wedding gathering that sets the tone for the upcoming nuptials and provides an opportunity for the couple, their families, and close friends to come together in a more relaxed setting. To ensure a smooth and enjoyable experience, here’s a quick guide to the dos and don’ts of a wedding rehearsal dinner.

![Image 6: Wedding Rehearsal Dinner Etiquette: The Dos and Don’ts](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240129/20240129143621_92897.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/clear-wine-glass-lot-on-table-O38Id\_cyV4M)_

### The Do’s

#### 1. Send Invitations in a Timely Manner

Kick off the rehearsal dinner festivities on a high note by sending out invitations well in advance. This thoughtful gesture gives family members, the wedding party, and close friends plenty of time to organise their attendance. Consider using digital invites to make things even more convenient and efficient.

#### 2. Choose a Comfortable Venue

Take a moment to carefully choose a setting that complements the overall wedding ambience while creating a relaxed and comfortable atmosphere. Whether you fancy a beloved local restaurant, a cosy garden get-together, or the elegance of a charming banquet hall, it’s key to factor in the size of your guest list. This ensures that your chosen venue sets the perfect stage for an intimate celebration.

#### 3. Personalise the Event

Elevate the experience by infusing personalised touches that mirror the couple’s unique personality. Weave in elements like lively photo slideshows highlighting cherished moments, heartwarming decorations, or a menu filled with the couple’s favourite dishes. This not only adds an extra dose of special charm but also ensures the event lingers in the hearts and minds of your guests.

#### 4. Express Gratitude

Take a heartfelt moment during the dinner to express sincere gratitude to those who’ve played crucial roles in bringing our dream wedding to life. Extend warm thanks to the wedding party, supportive family members, and any vendors whose contributions have made this celebration possible. This gesture fosters a sense of appreciation and strengthens the camaraderie among everyone involved.

#### 5. Plan a Brief Rehearsal

Keep the rehearsal itself focused and concise. Provide clear and organised instructions for the wedding ceremony, ensuring everyone knows their respective roles. Save the nitty-gritty discussions and details for the big day to maintain a relaxed atmosphere during the rehearsal dinner.

#### 6. Encourage Mingling

Foster a warm and inviting atmosphere by actively encouraging guests to mingle and get to know one another. This not only helps create a more comfortable environment for the wedding day but also strengthens the sense of community among attendees. Spice things up by incorporating ice-breaker activities to facilitate interactions.

#### 7. Prepare Toasts

If you have vendors present at the rehearsal dinner, ensure that gratuity is prepared in advance. Don’t leave this important detail for the last minute.

![Image 7: Wedding Rehearsal Dinner Etiquette: The Dos and Don’ts](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240129/20240129143931_49217.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/white-receipt-on-table-612790/)_

### The Don’ts

#### 1. Overwhelm with Details

While it’s important to go over the key wedding ceremony logistics, avoid bombarding your attendees with an excess of intricate details during the rehearsal dinner. Save the in-depth discussions for the big day, ensuring the rehearsal remains laser-focused on essential information without getting too overwhelming for everyone involved.

#### 2. Exclude Significant Others

Prioritise inclusivity by extending invitations to the significant others of the wedding party whenever you can. Creating a welcoming atmosphere not only fosters a stronger sense of community but adds an extra layer of fun for everyone at the event.

#### 3. Overschedule

Design a schedule that allows for flexibility and breathing room. Steer clear of cramming the evening with too many activities or never-ending speeches, as this can lead to attendee fatigue and diminish the overall enjoyment of the event. Find that sweet spot between structure and spontaneity to create a laid-back and lively atmosphere.

#### 4. Leave Thank You Notes for the Wedding Day

Seize the opportunity during the rehearsal dinner to express genuine gratitude to those who have been part of the wedding preparations. Avoid deferring this meaningful gesture solely to the wedding day, as the rehearsal dinner provides an intimate setting for heartfelt appreciation, setting a positive tone for the entire celebration.

#### 5. Neglect Special Dietary Requirements

Demonstrate thoughtfulness by ensuring that the chosen venue accommodates any dietary restrictions or preferences your guests may have. Take the lead in making sure everyone can fully enjoy the meal, creating an atmosphere of inclusivity and showcasing attentiveness to individual needs.

#### 6. Stress Over Perfection

While attention to detail is important, keep in mind that the rehearsal dinner is intended to be a more relaxed affair. Don’t let the little details overwhelm you—rather, channel your energy into creating a cosy and inviting environment.

#### 7. Delay Gratuity for Vendors

Prioritise professionalism by ensuring that gratuity for vendors present at the rehearsal dinner is prepared in advance. Avoid leaving this crucial detail for the last minute, as timely acknowledgement and compensation contribute to a positive working relationship with vendors and uphold the overall smooth execution of the event.

![Image 8: Wedding Rehearsal Dinner Etiquette: The Dos and Don’ts](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240129/20240129143949_79298.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/assorted-flowers-on-table-2253831/)_

### A Prelude to the Big Day

As the prelude to the grand wedding day, the rehearsal dinner is a time for joy, celebration, and connection. By following these dos and don’ts, couples can create a memorable and blissfully stress-free experience for themselves and their loved ones, setting the stage for a beautiful wedding celebration.

# Ready, Set, Say 'I Do!' Essential Steps Before Your Wedding Day

 2024-01-31

![Image 6: Ready, Set, Say 'I Do!' Essential Steps Before Your Wedding Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240131/20240131124007_49776.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/photo-of-couple-standing-on-wooden-planks-2403568/)_

The wedding day is often etched in our hearts as one of the most memorable and cherished occasions. It's a day filled with love, joy and the beginning of a new chapter in your life. However, this significant day can also take an unexpected turn into a realm of stress and chaos if you're not adequately prepared. The last thing anyone wants is for the bride, who should be radiating happiness, to transform into a bridezilla due to unforeseen issues.

This is where careful planning and preparation come into play. To ensure that your wedding day remains a blissful and unforgettable experience, we have compiled some essential steps for brides to take in advance. These steps are not just about avoiding potential pitfalls; they're about setting the stage for a smooth and enjoyable celebration of love.

### Prepping Your Face Canvas

![Image 7: Ready, Set, Say 'I Do!' Essential Steps Before Your Wedding Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240131/20240131124036_95768.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/search/facial/)_

Skincare is an aspect that often escapes couples' attention, with some beginning to focus on it only a week, or even a mere day, before their wedding. Yet, the path to achieving a radiant and glowing look commences as early as three months before the big day. Recognizing that looking your absolute best when you say "I do" necessitates early preparation, it's advised to embark on a skin care regimen sooner rather than later.

Cleansing, exfoliating, and moisturising should become your daily mantra. Incorporate serums and masks to address specific concerns like fine lines, acne, or uneven tone. It is recommended to schedule regular facials every month to cleanse your skin thoroughly. If you're a bride planning to wear a backless dress, keep in mind the visibility of your blemishes, and find a professional aesthetician to not only focus on your face but also your back acne/scars that would be visible.

### Locks of Love

![Image 8: Ready, Set, Say 'I Do!' Essential Steps Before Your Wedding Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240131/20240131124058_73025.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/search/HAIR%20dresser/)_

In the grand tapestry of wedding preparations, the significance of proper hair care often tends to be overlooked. However, your hair is more than just a physical feature – it's an integral part of your identity and plays a pivotal role in framing your appearance, especially on your wedding day. Start early by identifying your hair's needs – whether it's nourishment, volume, or shine.

Collaborate with a skilled hairstylist to determine the perfect wedding day hairstyle that compliments your dress and theme. Regular trims, deep conditioning treatments, and minimal heat styling will ensure your locks are picture-perfect and full of vitality. Collaborate with a skilled hairstylist to determine the perfect wedding day hairstyle that complements your dress and theme. Regular trims, deep conditioning treatments, and minimal heat styling will ensure your locks are picture-perfect and full of vitality.

### Fit and Fabulous

![Image 9: Ready, Set, Say 'I Do!' Essential Steps Before Your Wedding Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240131/20240131124121_58696.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/women-s-wearing-purple-floral-brassiere-holding-gray-concrete-pathway-during-day-time-42400/)_

Sailing smoothly into that dress wouldn't pose a challenge if we initiate our workout routine ahead of time. Dedication to regular exercise and a well-balanced diet would yield favourable results, but the crucial factor is maintaining consistency. Participate in habitual physical activities that bring you joy, whether it's practising yoga, going for a jog, or dancing. Fuse cardiovascular exercises with strength training for a comprehensive regimen. In addition, concentrate on a nutrition plan abundant in fruits, vegetables, lean proteins, and whole grains. Staying hydrated is essential; therefore, ensure you consume ample water to uphold skin elasticity and overall health.

### A Spa Serenity

![Image 10: Ready, Set, Say 'I Do!' Essential Steps Before Your Wedding Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240131/20240131124139_68893.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/search/spa/)_

Planning for your wedding can induce some wedding stresses, and it's not uncommon for some brides to transform into bridezillas in the lead-up to the big day. It's essential to pause and give yourself the gift of relaxation – this isn't merely a luxury; it's a necessary escape from the whirlwind of responsibilities. Delve into the world of self-pampering by considering a selection of rejuvenating beauty treatments available at a spa. Treatments such as facials, body scrubs, and massages possess the ability to work magic on your skin's radiance and overall relaxation. To further alleviate those pre-wedding jitters and envelop yourself in tranquillity, contemplate experiencing the soothing effects of aromatherapy.

### The Final Bridal Look

![Image 11: Ready, Set, Say 'I Do!' Essential Steps Before Your Wedding Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240131/20240131124236_18748.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/two-woman-3089849/)_

Prior to your wedding day, it's important to finalize your chosen bridal makeup appearance. This makeup should elevate your inherent beauty and mirror your individual style. It's advisable to arrange a bridal makeup trial well ahead of time, allowing you to test out various looks and pinpoint the one that truly aligns with your preferences. Take into account factors such as the lighting at your venue, the hues in your outfit, and the level of glamour you aim for. Work closely alongside a professional makeup artist to ensure that your makeup not only exudes breathtaking allure in photographs but also remains resilient in the face of the day's emotional moments.

### Prepare Yourself To Say “I Do

As you approach the monumental moment of saying 'I do,' remember that radiance and confidence are not only about the external appearance but also the inner glow that comes from taking care of yourself. Embrace these essential beauty and wellness steps to embark on your wedding day journey with vitality, poise, and a heart brimming with joy. Your wedding day is a celebration of love, and feeling your best ensures that you'll treasure the memories and photographs for years to come.

# Creating Memories One Wedding at A Time: JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La

 2024-01-19

Vendor:[JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/9/hotels/detail/513/jen-singapore-tanglin-by-shangri-la-)

![Image 6: Creating Memories One Wedding at A Time: JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240118/20240118112806_28716.jpg)

_Source: JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La_

Set in the bustling heart of Tanglin, a refined gem beckons couples to embark on their journey of matrimonial bliss within its stylish and intimate confines. JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La is only a short stroll from Orchard Boulevard MRT (TE13), making it a prime location for accessibility and convenience! Just imagine, a wedding venue close to premier shopping and entertainment!

Contemporary in style, the Hotel sets the stage for a range of wedding banquets, ranging from grander banquets (280 guests) to more intimate ceremonies. At JEN Singapore Tanglin, the hotel offers a selection of themes, ranging from rustic to an air of sophistication. Take your pick! The ballrooms within the Hotel offer versatility and space for customisation of wedding decor, for themes exclusive to the Hotel!

### Malacca & Penang

![Image 7: Creating Memories One Wedding at A Time: JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240118/20240118112828_63578.jpg)

_Source: JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La_

JEN Singapore Tanglin prides themselves on the versatility of space, and Malacca & Penang is a superb example. The enchanting pillarless ballroom witnesses a marriage of innovation and seamless elegance with moveable partitions that allows the room to be transformed at will, effortlessly transitioning from an expansive hall for grander celebrations to an intimate haven for more personal affairs. The floor-to-ceiling windows allow maximum and soft natural light to enter the room, granting it an ethereal charm.

Malacca & Penang comes with a nifty and charming foyer, acting as a prelude to the grandeur that awaits the wedding guests. The foyer offers a private sanctuary for guests to gather and indulge in catch-ups and revel in the excitement altogether.

### Temasek

![Image 8: Creating Memories One Wedding at A Time: JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240118/20240118112852_83277.jpg)

_Source: JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La_

Similar to the ballroom above, Temasek can be configured to accommodate a sizable guest list! This venue can hold up to 190 guests for a banquet style. Temasek features an aisle that stretches gracefully, allowing for a longer march-in. The pillarless expanse ensures an unobstructed view of the grand event. Temasek also has a private foyer with ample seating, suitable for pre-event activities.

### The Gallery

![Image 9: Creating Memories One Wedding at A Time: JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240118/20240118112923_37597.jpg)

_Source: JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La_

The Gallery is the largest event space of them all. Designed to host up to 280 guests in an atmosphere of unparallelled sophistication, this expansive room boasts a mid-high ceiling of 3.3 metres, creating a sense of vastness and regality. Elegant chandeliers suspend overhead, casting a soft glow on the grand affair happening below. Furthermore, the room is equipped with three strategically placed projectors to ensure that every guest has a front-row seat to the enchanting event.

The Gallery opens its doors to a foyer at Rumpoles Bar, for hushed whispers of excitement and the clinking of glasses before the main event.

### Special Services & Dining

![Image 10: Creating Memories One Wedding at A Time: JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240118/20240118113005_39636.jpg)

_Source: JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La_

Aside from the wonderful ballrooms to choose from, the Hotel extends its commitment to excellence by offering extra services that embody indulgence and convenience. Delight in the wedding cake service, along with the fragrant touch from the floral arrangement service!

Furthermore, why not indulge in the spa services to pamper and rejuvenate yourself a little? With these in-house services, your wedding day is effortlessly simplified, with the promise of satisfaction.

Lastly, guests would be delighted to know that the Jen Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La offers a suite of delectable food prepared in their halal-certified kitchen!

### Conclusion

At JEN Singapore Tanglin, your wedding will be nothing short of memorable. From its enchanting ballrooms to the Hotel’s commitment to indulgent services, bask in the symphony of warmth, love and joy on your big day, at the quintessential destination that is JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La. Scroll down to enquire!

Event Date: 13 Jan 2024, Sat. 12:00 PM and 2:00 PM
Whether you envision an elaborate indoor celebration in our glass-clad floor-to-ceiling dining hall or a romantic stroll down the aisle at sunset in our enchanting open-air garden, your love story will unfold just the way you've always imagined – stylish, charming, and undeniably enchanting.

"Promise to Forever" Wedding Workshop
Event Details:
Organizer: Carlton Hotel Singapore
Admission: Admission is complimentary (Registration is required)
Event Date: Sunday, 28 January 2024. 11.00am to 5.00 pm.
Carlton Hotel Singapore invites you to our "Promise to Forever" wedding workshop. Immerse yourself in an exceptional experience as our team of devoted wedding experts and carefully chosen vendors stand ready to turn your dream wedding into a reality.
With packages starting from $1,238++ per table of 10, our curated wedding offerings promise to elevate your celebration to celestial heights. Enjoy exclusive privileges, including additional wines, a barrel of beers, extended stays, and more delightful surprises when you confirm your wedding celebration with us during the workshop.

Event Details:
Organizer: PARKROYAL COLLECTION Pickering
Admission: Complimentary, strictly by appointment
Event Date: 7 Dec, Thu. 3:00 PM – 9:00 PM
Forever begins at PARKROYAL COLLECTION Pickering, Singapore. From exquisite cuisines, picture-perfect venues to personalised service, there’s nothing quite like a PARKROYAL COLLECTION wedding. Our dedicated Celebrations Curators are committed to attending to every detail, big or small; tying up the loose ends for you while you tie the knot.
Be it an intimate solemnisation or grand banquet wedding, our hotel-in-a-garden offers a wide range of options for your celebration.
Speak to our Celebrations Curators at our wedding workshop to celebrate your dream 2024 wedding in extraordinary style and create memories that last a lifetime. Confirm your special occasion during the show to enjoy exclusive perks.

Admission: Complimentary, RSVP required

Be enchanted by our intuitive service and flawless decor, where each detail is a testament to our commitment to your dreams.

Orchard Romance Wedding Show
Event Details:
Organizer: Orchard Hotel Singapore
Admission: Complimentary
Event Date: Sunday, 19 November 2023, 2.00pm – 6.00pm
Host your wedding at The Orchard Hotel’s largest pillarless ballroom in the heart of Singapore. With a capacity of up to hundred tables, we offer wedding venues to suit every request, from grand banquets to intimate solemnization.
Make a date with us on Sunday, 19 November 2023, 2.00pm – 6.00pm and enjoy a cash rebate up to $8,800++  and other exclusive perks when you confirm your wedding with us!
Admission is complimentary and light refreshments will be provided, so hurry and sign up today!
For more information or to RSVP
Here
!

Love in the Groove at Aloft Singapore Novena
Event Details:
Organizer: Aloft Singapore Novena
Admission: Complimentary
Event Date: 26 Nov, Sun. 11:00 AM – 5:00 PM
Join us and celebrate Love in the Groove at Aloft Singapore Novena on Sunday, 26 November 2023 for an exquisite wedding show.
Exchange your vows in our exquisitely landscaped outdoor event lawn and walk down the aisle in a modern, pillarless ballroom, complete with cutting-edge audio-visual technology and a LED videowall.
Enjoy exclusive wedding rebates and perks of up to $2000 when you confirm your wedding with us during the event. Stand a chance to win Aloft Hotels stays and dining vouchers in our lucky draw.
Limited slots available and appointment is strictly via first-come-first-served basis.
For more information or to RSVP
Here
!

We're thrilled to introduce this limited-time offer, which includes a spectacular pre-wedding photoshoot package, complete with a complimentary selection from our exquisite new collection of Actual Day gowns. Say I do at W Singapore – Sentosa Cove premier wedding halls, where it’s all about celebrating the two of you in a stylish location. Our innovative planners will transform the hotel’s breathtaking venues into an out-of-the-world wedding setup that’s unique to you, whether that means glamour, fun, simple, chic or all of the above.
Enjoy 5% off per guest and many more perks such as an additional bottle of hand-picked wine for every 10 persons confirmed when you book your packages by 30 November 2023.
To ensure an exceptional experience, we kindly request couples to make an appointment or RSVP with our wedding planners before visiting W Singapore - Sentosa Cove.

Event Details
Organizer: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel
Admission: Free
Event Date: 13 Oct, Fri. 6:00 PM – 10:00 PM
Enter into a world of enchantment and let us bring your special wedding day to life at Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel!
Get first-hand preview of our new wedding theme, Elegant Scarlet – blooming with peonies and red roses which symbolises love. Be impressed with our meticulously curated wedding menus, along with a diverse range of vendors such as bridal boutique, fine jewelry, photo booth services, live music, and more.

# Choosing the Perfect Bridal Hairstyle: Tips and Inspiration

 2023-07-13

![Image 5: Choosing the Perfect Bridal Hairstyle: Tips and Inspiration](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20230713/20230713142416_74750.jpg)

Your wedding day is a beautiful and treasured moment, full of meaning and lasting memories. Every aspect, no matter how minor, is extremely important. Among these exquisite details, your bridal hairstyle shines like a luminous gem, deserving of careful consideration. As such, allow us the pleasure of assisting you in discovering the perfect bridal hairstyle with these valuable tips.

### 1. Consider Your Dress and Venue

Take a moment to think about your wedding dress and venue before indulging in visions of your ideal hairstyle. The style and neckline of your dress have an influence over the choice of a suitable hairstyle. For instance, picture an elaborate updo that beautifully complements a strapless gown, or loose waves that harmonise flawlessly with a bohemian-inspired ensemble.

Likewise, allow the ambience of your chosen venue to gently steer your hairstyle selection. Should your vows be exchanged amidst a [flourishing outdoor garden](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/trending/5-things-you-need-to-ready-to-pull-off-an-outdoor-wedding "5 Things You Need To Ready To Pull Off An Outdoor Wedding"), envision a romantic half-up, half-down creation adorned with dainty blooms. Conversely, an elegant chignon or a sleek ponytail might elegantly befit a sophisticated indoor gathering. Allow the overarching ambience of your wedding to serve as your guiding beacon to the perfect hairstyle for your special day!

### 2.Seek Professional Advice

Enlist the guidance of a professional hairstylist once you have envisioned the desired style for your tresses. By scheduling a trial session well in advance of your momentous day, you can openly discuss your ideas and experiment with various hairstyles. A seasoned stylist will be able to provide invaluable insights based on your hair type, length, and texture and assess your facial features, ensuring that the selected style accentuates your innate beauty.

During the trial, don’t hesitate to voice your preferences and address any concerns you may have. After all, transparent communication holds the key to success. Should you plan on adorning your hair with accessories like a veil, tiara, or hairpin, be sure to present them to your stylist. This enables them to seamlessly incorporate these elements into your chosen hairstyle.

### 3. Embrace Your Natural Beauty

When deciding on a bridal hairstyle, remember to celebrate and embrace your inherent beauty. Avoid drastic changes that might make you uncomfortable or veer too far from your personal style. Your wedding day should be an extension of your true essence, exuding confidence and joy.

If you have naturally curly hair, consider embracing its charm with a soft and romantic updo or an artfully loose side braid. For those with straight hair, explore sleek, polished options like a classic bun or an elegant, braided crown. Allow your distinctive features to be accentuated, and grant your chosen hairstyle the privilege of reflecting your vibrant personality, illuminating your essence.

### 4. Draw Inspiration from Various Sources

The world is an abundant source of inspiration. Take advantage of diverse sources to gather ideas relevant to your style. Immerse yourself in the enthralling pages of wedding magazines, the realms of bridal websites, and social media platforms like Pinterest and Instagram. Consider creating a dedicated folder or board to curate and save your favourite looks, ready to be shared with your trusted stylist.

Additionally, draw inspiration from the allure of celebrity weddings and the glamour of red-carpet events. Celebrities often blaze trails with their elegant and sophisticated hairstyles, setting trends that captivate the imagination. Seek out those stars with similar hair types or facial features to your own, unveiling styles that could be a seamless match for your beauty. Adapt these ideas, infusing them with your personal preferences, and fashion a customised look that expresses your individuality.

### 5. Don’t Forget About Hair Care

When preparing for your big day, it’s essential to go beyond mere hairstyle selection and prioritise the care of your precious locks. During the months preceding your wedding, establish a dedicated hair care routine encompassing regular trims, deep conditioning treatments, and minimal heat styling. Nourish your hair from within by maintaining a well-balanced diet and staying well-hydrated. These practices will significantly improve your hair’s overall health and radiant appearance.

### Conclusion

When searching for the perfect bridal hairdo, personal preference, expert advice, and artistic inspiration all intertwine. With these tips and a touch of imagination, you are bound to discover a hairstyle that will highlight your inner brilliance while expressing the essence of a radiant bride.

# What to Do When Your Gown Doesn’t Fit Before the Wedding Day

 2023-05-23

![Image 6: What to Do When Your Gown Doesn’t Fit Before the Wedding Day](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20230523/20230523091930_16340.jpg)

A wedding is one of the most important events in a woman’s life. Many women dream of having a blissful and picturesque wedding that they can proudly recall with their children. For this reason, they want everything about their wedding to be perfect, especially their wedding dress. However, sometimes, the unexpected can happen. You might suddenly realise that your wedding gown doesn’t fit just a few days before your wedding day.

When that happens, the temptation to panic can be quite strong. However, you shouldn’t let the situation stress you out and ruin your excitement, as there are several things you can do to fix the situation. Here are some essential things you can do when your wedding gown doesn’t fit.

### 1. Analyse the situation

If you know that the wedding dress is truly yours and is too tight or too big, you need to analyse the situation. The first thing you must do is to calculate the amount of time you have until your wedding day. Evaluate how tight or big your wedding gown is to help you decide on your options. If you only have a couple of days left, your options are limited compared to when your wedding day is still further in the future. Analysing the situation helps you identify which options will work for you.

### 2.Try holding your breath or standing up straight

Sometimes, your wedding gown might only be slightly tight. In that case, it’s relatively easier to fix the situation. Try getting your dress zipped by holding your breath in. You can also stand up straight so that your weight will have a greater distribution area. However, keep in mind that these options are only good solutions if your wedding gown is mildly snug. Otherwise, you must choose more drastic options, as you wouldn’t want to look and feel uncomfortable on your wedding day.

### 3.Have the dress altered

If your wedding dress is more than mildly snug, you have no choice but to alter it. You may need to do this, especially if your dress was altered the first time or if you’ve gained weight from the time you bought it. While you may be able to get slimmer before your wedding day, only you can decide if this is possible. If you’re pressed for time, as your wedding day approaches fast, having your dress altered is probably the best option you must go with.

### 4. Rent another gown

Aside from altering your wedding gown, another great option when you don’t have much time until your wedding day is to rent another gown. Evening gown rentals are popular for being cheap and convenient. Although it might be hard to search for a dress that looks similar to the one you originally planned to wear, you may be able to find another gown design that you’ll love. Usually, rental companies offer a variety of beautiful wedding gowns.

### Conclusion

Finding out that your wedding dress doesn’t fit just a few days before your wedding can be stressful and worrisome. There’s probably nothing you want more than to walk down the aisle wearing a stunning wedding gown that fits perfectly. While the situation may be a cause for concern, there’s not much reason for you to panic. Hopefully, the essential tips in this article will help you fix the problem just in time for your special day.

# 4 Key Questions to Ask About Lights for an Outdoor Wedding

 2023-06-15

![Image 6: 4 Key Questions to Ask About Lights for an Outdoor Wedding](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20230615/20230615130149_34334.jpg)

[Outdoor wedding venues](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/merchant/18/wedding-venues "Outdoor Wedding Venues, Outdoor Wedding Venues Singapore")are all the rage these days. However, [pulling off a magical open-air celebration](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/trending/5-things-you-need-to-ready-to-pull-off-an-outdoor-wedding "5 Things You Need To Ready To Pull Off An Outdoor Wedding")requires meticulous planning, especially when it comes to the venue’s lighting. There’s so much to consider when selecting the perfect lights for your outdoor wedding, ensuring the right amount of visibility without compromising the romantic atmosphere of a wedding _en plein air_.

Planning the lighting scheme for your wedding affair involves striking a delightful balance between your guests’ safety and comfort and the overall theme and ambience of your special day. To ensure the success of your al fresco wedding, here are some essential inquiries that will help you out along the way!

### Question #1: When to consider the lights for an outdoor wedding?

Planning a wedding is a journey filled with countless details, and as with any other aspect, the sooner you line up your light suppliers and installers, the better. Close collaboration with the venue owner and your trusted wedding planner is the key to a luminous celebration under the open sky. Before the wedding season comes in full swing, consider everything that’s missing in your exterior lighting options, and watch as your wedding preparations unfold with ease when the magical day draws near.

### Question #2: Who’s responsible for providing lights for an outdoor wedding?

The answer to this question may vary depending on the circumstances at hand. However, in most cases, it’s the venue owner or the ever-resourceful wedding planner who takes charge of providing those shimmering lights.

If you wish to sweep exterior lighting off your worry-filled wedding planning checklist, seek out a venue owner who offers reliable lighting options. You’ll be thrilled to discover that many venue owners now present an array of lighting options to enhance their event packages.

### Question #3: How to light an outdoor wedding?

There are different kinds of exterior lighting options you can use for your wedding. You would want to start by exploring the outdoor lights available at your chosen wedding venue:

● Are the pathways clearly lit?

● Does the parking area have spotlights?

● Is there landscape lighting to display the unique features and create visual interest?

● Are entryways properly lit and easy to find?

● Are perimeters marked clearly with lights?

● Can any of the lights be adjusted?

● How can the lighting be controlled?

These are the questions you should ask when contemplating the lighting for your outdoor wedding. To get a fuller picture of the place, it’s a good idea to visit the venue a few days or weeks before the wedding.

Take note of where the main events will unfold and envision the type of lighting that will beautifully complement each moment. During the ceremony, all eyes will be transfixed upon the wedding party, and you can cleverly employ strategically-placed spotlights to ensure clear visibility without overwhelming your beloved guests.

### Question #4: How much lighting is needed for an outdoor wedding?

The quantity of lights needed for an al fresco wedding depends on the layout of the venue and the size number the wedding. Generally, it’s worth noting that people tend to underestimate the number of lighting fixtures needed for such occasions. Therefore, it’s always wiser to utilise more fixtures that are closer together but on a lower brightness setting. This provides a more uniform look for the venue, eliminating dark spots and shadows.

### Conclusion

Lighting is a crucial element that deserves your utmost attention, especially for your open-air extravaganza. Remember, you have a trifecta of lighting possibilities: the enchanting options offered by your chosen venue, the expertise of a professional outdoor lighting company, and your creative brilliance. The sooner you plan, the easier it’ll be to pull off the wedding of your dreams!

4 Things You Must Know Before Confirming Your Wedding Date
Planning a wedding requires extensive preparation, including careful consideration of the wedding date. Once you announce your engagement, choosing the ideal wedding date becomes a priority and is often the first question asked by family and friends. Before proceeding with other aspects of your wedding planning checklist, it is crucial to select a suitable date.
To ensure a smooth process, there are several factors to consider when determining your wedding date. Here are some essential details to be aware of before finalizing your chosen date.

# 4 Things You Must Know Before Confirming Your Wedding Date

 2023-05-08

![Image 6: 4 Things You Must Know Before Confirming Your Wedding Date](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20230508/20230508130126_86162.jpg)

Pulling off a wedding requires a lot of planning. There are essentially plenty of things you need to plan and prepare to ensure your wedding will be a success. One of the most important things you should carefully decide on and plan is your wedding date. After announcing your engagement, your wedding date will surely be the first question that your family and friends will ask.

For this reason, you must pick an ideal wedding date before continuing with your wedding planning checklist. When setting a date for your wedding, there are several factors you need to consider to ensure that you’ll have no trouble with your chosen date. To help you choose the best time of the year for your wedding, here are some important pieces of information you should know before confirming your wedding date.

### 1. Weather Patterns

Unlike other countries with four seasons, Singapore only has two periods that you must keep in mind: the monsoon season (which happens from June to September, and from the middle of November to early March) and the rest of the year. Knowing the weather patterns is necessary, especially if you’re planning to have your wedding in an [outdoor wedding venue](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/merchant/18/wedding-venues "Outdoor Wedding Venues, Outdoor Wedding Venues Singapore")where [sudden downpours](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/trending/what-you-must-do-when-it-suddenly-rains-on-your-wedding-day "What You Must Do When It Suddenly Rains on Your Wedding Day")are a possibility. Understanding these climatic conditions is crucial to ensuring your special day runs smoothly.

### 2. Peak Seasons

In Singapore, the more popular months for weddings include December, June, July, March, May, September, and November because they’re commonly between huge festivals, such as Chinese New Year, the Hungry Ghost Festival, Qing Ming, Deepavali, and Hari Raya Puasa. If your wedding date falls within a peak season, you should be prepared that your chosen venue might not be available. You’ll also be less likely to avail of additional perks and discounts.

### 3. Public Holidays

If your wedding happens just a few days before the Christmas holidays or the Chinese New Year, you’ll likely end up with fewer guests than expected. Carrying out your wedding on a long weekend or a public holiday is often a bad idea as your family and friends may have other responsibilities or prior events to attend. So, if you want to see all your family members and friends on your wedding day, avoid choosing a public holiday as your date.

### 4. Auspicious Dates

Chinese wedding customs, such as [Si Dian Jin](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/jewellery/7-jewellery-brands-that-offers-a-modern-twist-to-si-dian-jin "Si Dian Jin, Si Dian Jin Singapore")and Guo Da Li, are steeped in centuries-old cultural traditions and superstitions. In selecting a wedding date, Chinese culture adherents lay significant emphasis on choosing an auspicious day, as it is believed to bestow good fortune and blessings on the union.

When planning your wedding, it’s essential to keep these customs in mind because they can add a meaningful dimension to your celebration while also honouring the ancient heritage.

### Conclusion

The selection of your wedding date is a critical aspect of wedding planning, as it can significantly impact the outcome of your nuptial celebration. From navigating through monsoon seasons to ascertaining auspicious dates, selecting a date demands meticulous attention. Nevertheless, your careful consideration and planning will ensure the attendance of your loved ones and a truly exceptional wedding celebration.

**![Image 8](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/images/package_picx.png) Events & Contest details**

Carlton Hotel Singapore presents “ Meet Our Wedding Planners Workshop”, where you will have a one-on one consultation with our team of wedding professionals along with a selection of handpicked wedding vendors who will help bring your wedding vision to life. Experience a preview of our new wedding themes onsite and celebrate your joyous union of love in our ballrooms with menus from our award winning Wah Lok Cantonese Restaurant for your kind selection.

Whether you are planning an intimate wedding luncheon at our contemporary Esplanade room or a grand banquet at the highly configurable Empress Ballroom, our wedding venues at Carlton Hotel Singapore are designed to add a sprinkle of stardust as you take your first steps to nuptial bliss.

Confirm your wedding with us during this workshop and enjoy exclusive privileges such as additional wines, beer barrel, additional night stay and more. Enjoy additional perks for UOB cardholders when you confirm your wedding dinner in Empress Ballrooms.

Our wedding packages start from $1,188++ per table of 10 persons.

For more information or registration, please kindly contact our wedding sales team via email at [banquet@carltonhotel.sg](mailto:banquet@carltonhotel.sg).

Summer Of Love Wedding Showcase
Event Details
Organizer: PARKROYAL on Kitchener Road
Admission: Free
Event Date: 4 Jun, Sun. 11:00 AM – 6:00 PM
An oasis of romance awaits you and your beloved at PARKROYAL on Kitchener Road, Singapore, a hidden gem that sparkles amidst the vibrant city vibes of Farrer Park. Be it an intimate wedding with your nearest and dearest or a grand affair with all your loved ones, we are here to help you plan a celebration that is simply yours, filled with your stories, traditions and meaningful touches that will make it a day to remember.
For more information or to RSVP

An oasis of romance awaits you and your beloved at PARKROYAL on Kitchener Road, Singapore, a hidden gem that sparkles amidst the vibrant city vibes of Farrer Park. Be it an intimate wedding with your nearest and dearest or a grand affair with all your loved ones, we are here to help you plan a celebration that is simply yours, filled with your stories, traditions and meaningful touches that will make it a day to remember.

A newly-renovated events floor features our spacious **Emerald**, **Jade**and **Sapphire**ballrooms along with a dedicated reception foyer. These beautiful event venues cater to weddings from 80 to 400 guests, offering a variety of menus that will suit every palate and wedding style. Complemented by state-of-the-art lighting and sound equipment, our well-appointed spaces offer those in love an ideal canvas for curating a wedding celebration that is truly unique and personalised. Journeying with our experienced wedding planners who devote meticulous care and attention to every detail, couples are assured of an elevated hospitality experience for themselves and their guests.

Come discover our passion for creating real connections and joyous experiences that celebrate you and your memorable experiences.

What's more, confirm your wedding with us to enjoy exclusive wishes such as a complimentary wine package or an additional one-night-stay with breakfast for your wedding day! _*Terms and conditions apply._

All About Si Dian Jin: Is It Still Necessary These Days?
The gifting of Si Dian Jin is a long-standing wedding custom of the Chinese culture that is continuously observed to this day. The term “Si Dian Jin” essentially translates to “Four Touches of Gold,” as it was customarily a four-piece set of betrothal jewellery consisting of a bangle, necklace, ring, and a pair of earrings. This jewellery set is given to the bride as a way of welcoming her into the family and bestowing blessings on the newlyweds.
The origins of the Si Dian Jin custom date back several centuries ago in Guangdong, China. Despite being a centuries-old tradition, the gifting of Si Dian Jin remains an essential practice for many soon-to-be brides and grooms in China, Singapore, and other Asian countries. To understand why, here are some of the reasons why Si Dian Jin remains relevant in modern times.

4 Questions You Must Ask Before Renting A Wedding Dress
Selecting a dress for your wedding day is a crucial decision that requires plenty of consideration. With an endless range of options, finding the right dress for your special day may certainly take time. One essential part of this process is deciding how you’ll procure your wedding dress. The renting versus purchasing debate is a dilemma that many brides face, as both of these options come with their respective pros and cons.
That being said, if you’re specifically after the cost, then wedding dress rental is your best choice since it’s significantly cheaper than buying an entirely new dress. However, the cost is not the only thing you must consider before making a decision. To help you decide whether rental is the right option for you, here are the most important questions you should ask before you rent a wedding dress.

Welcome! Luna Bianca, a reputable bridal gown rental and photographic service provider in Singapore, is hosting an event called Luna's Friendors Day (LFD) that we are thrilled to offer to you. We want to give couples the chance to look into all bridal-related services in one convenient place.

 Various bridal-related services will be gathered under one roof at LFD so that you may learn more about them. By exhibiting several services that can make your special day flawless, this event is intended to make the process of organizing your wedding easier

 There is no cost to attend the event, which will take place on April 15, 2023 (1 Day Event) from 12 to 6:30 pm.

 During the event, you will have the chance to learn more about our services and special offers from our vendors as well. We want you to take pleasure in the occasion and have fun considering various possibilities for your wedding day.

 If you join up with any of our Friendors on the day of the event, Luna will give you up to 20% off our services such as gown rental, pre-wedding photoshoot, and wedding photoshoot as a bonus. To spice up the day, we will also do lucky draws that are sponsored by Luna.

### Lucky Draws are

What To Discuss With Your Wedding Photographer Beforehand
Weddings are incomplete without photos. Your wedding photos are essentially there to serve as an incredible memorial to one of the most important days of your life. To make sure that these photos accurately reflect your wedding day and the love you and your partner have for each other, you need to find a photographer whose work matches your style and preferences.
Wedding photography packages are very much popular because they can be trusted to deliver high-quality photos. However, to ensure that your desired photos are achieved, it’s essential to communicate with your photographer about certain matters beforehand.

# What to Discuss With Your Wedding Photographer Beforehand

 2023-03-13

![Image 5: What to Discuss With Your Wedding Photographer Beforehand](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20230306/20230306095008_22424.jpg)

Weddings are incomplete without photos. Your wedding photos are essentially there to serve as an incredible memorial to one of the most important days of your life. To make sure that these photos accurately reflect your wedding day and the love you and your partner have for each other, you need to find a photographer whose work matches your style and preferences.

Wedding photography packages are very much popular because they can be trusted to deliver high-quality photos. However, to ensure that your desired photos are achieved, it’s essential to communicate with your photographer about certain matters beforehand.

Along with these [questions you should ask your photographer](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/wedding/5-vital-questions-to-ask-your-potential-wedding-photographer "5 Vital Questions To Ask Your Potential Wedding Photographer"), below are some key things you should discuss with them days or weeks before your wedding.

### 1. Shots You Like and Dislike

Weddings are supposed to be a once-in-a-lifetime event. If there’s a specific photo or photos that you desperately want, you should tell your photographer about it before your wedding day. These pictures can be anything — a moment between you and your beloved mother or a shot of you and your partner next to a fountain where the marriage proposal happened.

If the photographer has no idea that these moments are important to you, they won’t be able to capture them. Similarly, you should also tell your photographer about certain shots that you think are cringe or wouldn’t want to be included in your wedding album. For your photographer to get things right, you need to let them know what you like and dislike.

### 2. Timetable for the Wedding Day

Having a clear and well-organised timetable for your wedding day is crucial to ensuring that everything you wish to happen, happens. This includes adding time into your schedule for the formal shots and some peaceful bride-and-groom photos.

When the photographer knows the timetable for your wedding day, they can capture all the moments that you want to be captured. You wouldn’t want to feel stressed, rushed, or miss out on anything meaningful when it comes to your wedding photos.

### 3. Planned Surprises and Quirks

Sometimes, people want their wedding day to be full of surprises to make the occasion more memorable. However, on the part of the wedding photographer, surprises can be missed opportunities.

Hence, if you’re planning to insert some quirks and surprises into your wedding schedule, you should inform your photographer in advance so they wouldn’t miss them. No matter what surprise it is and whoever organises it, it’s essential to let the photographer know.

### 4. Any Unexpected Lighting Elements

While a good photographer should be able to handle unusual lighting situations, it’s still necessary to inform them if you have anything planned. For instance, if you’re planning to hire a DJ and have a dark dance floor, you should let your photographer know.

Learning about these things before the wedding day will enable the photographer to prepare the appropriate equipment necessary for achieving high-quality photos, notwithstanding any lighting oddities.

### Conclusion

There are several different things to discuss with your photographer before your wedding day. Help your photographer make your wedding day smooth and seamless by always being transparent with them. Furthermore, informing your photographer about certain situations is an absolute must if you wish to achieve the most beautiful photos of your wedding.

Guo Da Li And Jing Cha: How Are These Customs Different?
At present, most couples adopt a modern approach when it comes to the flow of their wedding by merely incorporating some traditions. Some couples do so for the experience, while others are committed to adopting traditional practices unique to their nationality or dialect group. In Singapore, particularly, many couples still choose to practice some Chinese wedding customs, such as Guo Da Li and Jing Cha.
Indeed, Chinese weddings are known for fusing unique customs and traditions. These customs are imbued with meanings and are usually anchored on traditional Chinese values, such as loyalty, filial piety, kindness, love, and more.
If you’re planning to incorporate some Chinese customs into your upcoming wedding, this article might interest you! Read on to learn more about Guo Da Li and Jing Cha, two of the most important Chinese wedding customs.

# Guo Da Li and Jing Cha: How Are These Customs Different?

 2023-03-06

![Image 6: Guo Da Li and Jing Cha: How Are These Customs Different?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20230306/20230306093905_87087.jpg)

At present, most couples adopt a modern approach when it comes to the flow of their wedding by merely incorporating some traditions. Some couples do so for the experience, while others are committed to adopting traditional practices unique to their nationality or dialect group. In Singapore, particularly, many couples still choose to practice some Chinese wedding customs, such as _Guo Da Li_ and _Jing Cha_.

Indeed, Chinese weddings are known for fusing unique customs and traditions. These customs are imbued with meanings and are usually anchored on traditional Chinese values, such as loyalty, filial piety, kindness, love, and more.

If you’re planning to incorporate some Chinese customs into your upcoming wedding, this article might interest you! Read on to learn more about _Guo Da Li_ and _Jing Cha_, two of the most important Chinese wedding customs.

### What is Guo Da Li?

In Chinese culture, _Guo Da Li_ is considered the official wedding proposal and is the first component of Chinese wedding customs. It is also known as the “betrothal ceremony” because it involves the giving and receiving of betrothal gifts between the families of the bride and the groom.

According to Chinese superstitions, the betrothal ceremony should be conducted on an auspicious day. In modern times, it usually takes place 1 to 2 weeks before the actual wedding day.

## What Happens During the Guo Da Li Ceremony?

In a _In a [\_Guo Da Li\_ ceremony](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/the-4-auspicious-must-dos-in-your-guo-da-li-ceremony "The 4 Auspicious Must-Dos In Your Guo Da Li Ceremony"),_ it is required for the groom and his family to deliver to the bride and her family a red packet containing the betrothal gift money called the “_Pin Jin.”_ Aside from the _Pin Jin_, there is also a set of other betrothal gifts that must be given to the bride’s family, including a pair of dragon and phoenix candles, a can of pig trotters, wine or hard liquor, traditional wedding cakes or _Xi Bing_, jewellery for the bride or _[Si Dian Jin](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/understanding-the-history-and-significance-of-si-dian-jin "Si Dian Jin, Si Dian Jin Singapore")_, and more.

Upon receiving the _Pin Jin_ and other items, the bride and her family shall return a portion (usually half) of the gifts to symbolise that they’re willing to acknowledge the generosity of the groom’s family and to “share the joy” with them. Most of the time, _Guo Da Li_ in Singapore is financed by the couple themselves. However, in some cases, the parents of both the bride and the groom may also share the cost of the wedding banquet.

### What is Jing Cha?

_Jing Cha,_ or “tea ceremony”, is the Chinese counterpart to Western solemnisation. It is the formality of introducing the bride and the groom to the relatives of the couple, not just their immediate family. It is traditionally done by having the couple “_jing cha_” or offer tea to the elder relatives as a way of paying their respects. Because it is the formal introduction of the bride and the groom, _Jing Cha_ is considered one of the most significant events at a Chinese wedding.

### What Happens During the Jing Cha Ceremony?

During a usual _Jing Cha_ ceremony, the couple must first serve tea to the groom’s family. They should be dressed in _Gua_ for this occasion. The sweet tea serves as the symbol of the harmonious relationship between the couple and their respective families. It is usually brewed from red dates, lotus seeds, or longans with the tea set from _Guo Da Li_. Red dates and lotus seeds signify the couple bearing a child early in their marriage, while the longans symbolise a “dragon” wanting to have a male child.

Although the tradition is that the couple arrives at the groom’s house first, some couples may choose to conduct the tea ceremony for the bride before leaving for the groom’s house. In some instances, the couple may even do the ceremony together at the wedding banquet area before the banquet begins. Traditionally, the newlyweds are required to kneel when serving the tea. However, most modern families now only require the newlyweds to bow while standing.

### Conclusion

Even though modern adaptations of Chinese wedding customs are becoming increasingly common in Singapore, it’s always a good idea to backtrack and understand better why some customs and traditions are done, and which of them continue to be a significant part of modern Chinese weddings. If you wish to incorporate a bit of tradition into your upcoming wedding, _Guo Da Li_ and _Jing Cha_ are two of the essential Chinese customs you should consider incorporating.

Event Details
Organizer: Carlton Hotel Singapore
Admission: Free
Event Date: 26 Mar, 11:00 AM – 05:00 PM
Carlton Hotel Singapore presents “ Meet Our Wedding Planners Workshop”, where you will have a one-on one consultation with our team of wedding planners. Experience a preview of our new wedding themes onsite and celebrate your joyous union of love in our ballrooms with menus from our award winning Wah Lok Cantonese Restaurant for your kind selection.

Centennial Bliss Wedding Showcase at Conrad Centennial Singapore
Event Details
Organizer: Conrad Centennial Singapore
Admission: Free
Event Date: 10 Mar, 6:00 PM – 10:00 PM
Say yes to eternal wedding bliss and let your love story unfold in style at Conrad Centennial Singapore. Whether it is an intimate solemnisation ceremony or an enchanting soireé in our grand ballroom, allow our team of experienced planners help you discover your bespoke wedding vision.

# 5 Wedding Ceremony Moments That Must Be Captured in Photos

 2022-12-15

![Image 5: 5 Wedding Ceremony Moments That Must Be Captured in Photos](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20221215/20221215180819_60475.jpg)

Photos are something that shouldn’t be overlooked at a wedding. As such, professional wedding photographers are essential to wedding ceremonies as they are responsible for capturing every memorable moment of the day. Hence, it’s no surprise that [wedding photography packages in Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/merchant/14/wedding-photography "Wedding Photography Packages Singapore")are in high demand.

By hiring a professional wedding photographer, you can immortalise the sweetest, loveliest, funniest, and most authentic moments of one of the most notable events of your life. Although all your wedding photos create a fantastic collection, some moments need more emphasis. If you’re curious about what they are, here are 5 moments during your wedding ceremony that should be photographed.

### 1.When the groom waits for the bride

Moments before the couple faces the altar to say their “I do’s,” the groom usually has to wait for his bride to arrive. It’s always tender to see the groom eagerly anticipate his bride. This moment becomes even sweeter when the groom sees his bride as she makes her way down the aisle, and his face lights up with enthusiasm. As a result, no wedding photographer should pass up the opportunity to capture the groom’s endearing reaction.

### 2.When the bride walks down the aisle

The bride walking down the aisle is one of the most thrilling and exciting highlights of every wedding ceremony. As the stunning bride slowly approaches her future husband, her face usually displays beauty, love, and contentment. During this moment, the bride becomes the centre of attraction. The gorgeous couple, as well as their future children and grandkids, should be able to reminisce and experience this precious moment in photographs for the rest of their lives.

### 3.When they exchange their vows

The exchanging of vows is an integral part of every wedding ceremony. Vows are words the bride and groom exchange with each other, expressing both their intent and promise. Because it’s a significant part of the ceremony, wedding photographers should capture the exchanging of vows through captivating photos. This will also help the pair to remember the expressions on their faces as they make their lifetime pledges to one other in the future.

### 4.When they exchange rings

Traditionally, the bride and the groom exchange rings as a symbol of their everlasting commitment to each other, which begins on their wedding day. Couples can either exchange rings as part of their wedding vows or separately after the ceremony. No matter when the ring exchange takes place, it’s essential to have this special moment captured, as it will serve as a reminder to the couple of the commitment they made to each other on their wedding day.

### 5.When they share their first kiss

Wedding ceremonies ordinarily end with the couple’s first kiss. During this moment, the newlyweds get to share an intimate and endearing kiss after being pronounced “husband and wife.” The couple’s first kiss is something that must be photographed as it marks the beginning of their marriage. Many consider it to be the most priceless moment of the celebration, filling the air with romance and exhilarating the couple and their guests.

### Conclusion

Although every moment of a wedding ceremony is delightful and spectacular, a few stand out above the others and deserve to be immortalised in photographs. If you want perfect shots of these beautiful and romantic moments, you should absolutely hire professional wedding photography services.

What You Must Do When It Suddenly Rains On Your Wedding Day
Outdoor weddings have grown in popularity over the years. There are many different reasons for an outdoor wedding, which is why more and more people seek it. For one, it gives couples greater freedom to roam and be creative, as well as natural light that is ideal for photography. As a matter of fact, many couples tend to request outdoor venues when selecting and hiring wedding photography packages in Singapore.
However, while having an outdoor wedding may have multiple benefits, it also has some disadvantages. One of them is dealing with bad weather. # Leave Your Worries at the Door with Andie Ng, Wedding Emcee 

 2023-01-10

![Image 5: Leave Your Worries at the Door with Andie Ng, Wedding Emcee ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20230110/20230110141428_39771.jpg)

What does the perfect wedding emcee do?

A wedding emcee is the host of the festivities—their job is to keep everything running smoothly, keep your guests and loved ones entertained and ensure you and your partner are the stars of the show!

With that being said, one need not look further for the perfect emcee than Andie Ng: wedding emcee and host maestro!

### About Andie

![Image 6: Leave Your Worries at the Door with Andie Ng, Wedding Emcee ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20230110/20230110141512_10877.jpg)

Energetic, passionate and friendly, Andie puts a personal and meaningful touch to the events she hosts for her clients. She’s a total people person—her bubbly personality makes it a breeze to interact with your guests and keep everyone comfortable and well-entertained.

She also majored in Chinese in University, and may even mix in Hokkein dialect to keep your guests laughing if you so wish.

Andie has more than a hundred weddings under her belt, along with hosting road shows, d&d events and even her own internet radio show where she honed her impeccable skills. Her style involves truly celebrating her clients and their stories, as well as incorporating the various elements and ideas they have for their dream day into a coherent and seamless program.

### Leave Your Worries Behind

![Image 7: Leave Your Worries at the Door with Andie Ng, Wedding Emcee ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20230110/20230110141732_34098.jpg)

Every couple can agree that planning a wedding can be stressful. There are many little, but powerful decisions to make: What order to plan our events? What songs would we choose for the wedding march?

Thankfully, Andie offers her clients complimentary consultation sessions. With her wealth of experience, planning your programme flow is made easier and more enjoyable. Although everything will be planned to a T, Andie is well-prepared to expertly manage any unexpected curveballs on your big day.

She is willing and able to reconcile multiple various elements you wish for your dream day into a singular, perfect programme for you and your partner. Would you like two songs during your wedding march? How about a video diary compiling messages from your loved ones?

The possibilities are endless! Always willing to go the extra mile, Andie even offers her help beyond hosting your reception and may offer her complimentary services during your solemnisation or tea ceremony events should you wish.

### Hosting from the Heart

![Image 8: Leave Your Worries at the Door with Andie Ng, Wedding Emcee ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20230110/20230110141743_47772.jpg)

Andie’s sincere passion for her craft translates into the work she puts in to make her clients’ wedding day all the more special.

She offers affordable price points along with her plethora of support.Memories of your special day are yours to keep forever, so leave it to Andie to manage the little moments so you can cherish and enjoy your wedding to the fullest.

To learn more about Andie and her services, you may contact her at [yesiamdee@hotmail.com](mailto:yesiamdee@hotmail.com)for more information.

#FEELOVED
brand campaign.
Love & Co. appointed Joshua Tan (Fly entertainment), and his fiancée, Tay Zoen as new brand ambassadors while celebrating their love story through a film campaign. The brand continues to spread love through its extensive range of jewellery - engagement rings, wedding bands and diamond jewellery.
Read more
here.

Escape to Luxury with Hotel Fort Canning
Hidden away within the lush 18 hectares of Fort Canning Park is the luxurious conservation hotel, Hotel Fort Canning. Once a British military administration building, it has now been transformed into a gem—the perfect location for any couple.
Whether you and your partner are looking for a private function or something a little more festive, there’s an abundance of options for you!
Hotel Fort Canning offers its guests six exquisite wedding banquet venues, including The Grand Marquee, Singapore’s largest air-conditioned indoor marquee. The hotel also features unique outdoor settings for solemnisations and receptions on their stunning terraces, sun deck and poolside.
See more
here.

Whether you’re planning for an intimate gathering or a grand affair, voco
™
Orchard Singapore provides all the options you’d need to curate your dream day.

here.

# 4 Simple Strategies to Feel at Ease for Your Wedding Photos

 2022-10-27

![Image 6: 4 Simple Strategies to Feel at Ease for Your Wedding Photos](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20221028/20221028170214_48754.jpg)

Being camera shy is a regular occurrence for many people. Even photographers who spend their days photographing others can become self-conscious in front of the camera. If you are not a model, you are probably not accustomed to spending plenty of time posing in front of the camera with all eyes on you. This is especially concerning if you need to pose for your wedding photos.

However, wedding photos do not have to feel like you are being chased by the paparazzi. If you are feeling a bit nervous thinking about your wedding photos, this article might help you! Here are 4 effective ways to make yourself feel comfortable in front of the camera on your wedding day.

### 1. Practice your poses

Practice makes perfect. Just like learning a new skill, you can become a pro at posing for photos by practising your poses and expressions. Look for some inspirational photos on Instagram or Pinterest and imitate the poses with your partner in front of the mirror. Practising how you move and look together will make it much simpler to take directions and pose as a couple on your wedding day.

### 2. Talk to your photographer

Everyone has bits they love and bits they would rather ignore. For instance, you may not like your nose, arms, or other features. In this instance, you should have a conversation with your wedding photographer ahead of time to get their advice on how to approach your wedding photos. Your photographer wants you to like your photos. The better they understand you,the more likely they are to provide you with shots you will love.

### 3. Do not forego the prenup photos

Frequently, [wedding photography packages in Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/merchant/14/wedding-photography "Wedding Photography Packages, Wedding Photography Packages Singapore")already include prenuptial photos. Think of this prenuptial session as a trial run – it allows you to experience how your photographer works and enables you to receive real-time feedback without the time crunch of a wedding day. If you do not like the photos or are not comfortable with the photographer’s style, the prenup session gives you the chance to figure things out before you hire the photographer for your wedding day.

### 4. Do not hesitate to say no

When it comes to your wedding photos, what you like is the priority. Hence, if you ever feel uncomfortable or do not want to do a pose, you should let your photographer know. You hired your photographer to take beautiful photos of your wedding and foster a positive experience, so you are allowed to say _no_ whenever you like. Professional photographers usually do not feel offended when you speak and are glad to comply with your wishes.

### Conclusion

Shyness in front of the camera is a universal experience. On your wedding day, however, it is critical that you feel comfortable and secure posing in front of the camera so that you have mesmerising photos of one of the most pertinent moments of your life. By following the tips shared in this article, you can beat the pre-wedding nerves and become confident enough to pose for incredible wedding photos.

# Understanding the History and Significance of Si Dian Jin

 2022-10-26

![Image 6: Understanding the History and Significance of Si Dian Jin](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20221028/20221028170745_40513.jpg)

There are many forms of weddings all throughout the world. Each of these types comes with unique customs and traditions that are still observed to this day. Chinese weddings are probably one of the most prominent forms of wedding that are rich in traditions and superstitions to follow. A traditional Chinese wedding includes a variety of customs and ceremonies, many of which have been observed for centuries.

Among the most popular Chinese wedding tradition is the gifting of the _Si Dian Jin_ set. The term “_Si Dian Jin_” basically translates to “Four Touches of Gold.” If you are unfamiliar with this term or this Chinese tradition, you are on the right page! Continue reading to learn more about the history and significance of _[Si Dian Jin](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/7-jewellery-brands-that-offers-a-modern-twist-to-si-dian-jin "Si Dian Jin, Si Dian Jin Singapore")_.

### What is the history behind _Si Dian Jin_?

_Si Dian Jin_ is a centuries-old Chinese wedding custom that originated in the Chao Shan region of Guangdong, China. It is practised and observed by the Chinese Teochews, and it refers to four gold pieces of jewellery presented to the bride as a betrothal present: a ring, a necklace, a set of earrings, and a bangle.

During the [_Guo Da Li_ ceremony](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/chinese-wedding-traditions/4-frequently-asked-questions-people-have-about-guo-da-li "4 Frequently Asked Questions People Have About Guo Da Li")_,_ the mother of the groom will present her daughter-in-law with a set of gold jewellery. The Chinese term for “gold” has a resemblance to the curved rooftops of Teochew houses, thereby symbolising that the daughter-in-law will be properly taken care of and will be welcomed warmly in her new home.

Today, the tradition is adopted by many Hokkien, Cantonese, and other Chinese families, but the practice still varies among dialects. For instance, Hokkien and Cantonese households may focus on getting only one or two jewellery items, whereas Teochew families typically offer a four-piece set of jewellery. The most typical jewellery gift is a set of bangles.

### What is the importance of each _Si Dian Jin_ jewellery piece?

A fundamental custom of Chinese weddings is the giving of Si Dian Jin, which has deep meaning and symbolism. To have a deeper understanding of the significance of this custom, here are what each piece of jewellery in a _Si Dian Jin_ set traditionally represents:

*   **Ring –**The ring symbolises the couple’s commitment to each other. It is frequently seen as a sign of love, good fortune, and prosperity.
*   **Necklace –**The translation of the Chinese word for “necklace” is “continuity.” Therefore, the necklace in a _Si Dian Jin_ set refers to the connection of two families and the development of a harmonious relationship.
*   **Earrings –**A pair of earrings represent the perfect pairing and union between the bride and the groom.
*   **Bangle –** Bangles are typically designed with symbol animal elements, such as the phoenix and dragon. The phoenix is commonly associated with rebirth, beauty, and grace, whereas the dragon is often portrayed as a benevolent and powerful protector. These two symbols, worn together on a bangle, represent the ideal balance of yin and yang.

### Conclusion

Chinese weddings are undoubtedly one of the most culturally rich weddings in the world. Their traditions and practices are not only distinct and fascinating, but also rich in significance and symbolism. By knowing the history of the _Si Dian Jin_ custom and the meaning behind every jewellery piece in a _Si Dian Jin_, you can better understand why traditions like this remain important and widely practised today.
