# Wedding Hacks: Choosing the Ideal Wedding Décor

 2019-06-14

![Image 6: Wedding Hacks: Choosing the Ideal Wedding Décor](http://bit.ly/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20190609/20190609013949_20049.jpg)

When preparing for the big day, one of the most immediate and dare we say essential aspects to consider would be the wedding theme. In addition to shorlisting your desired location from the wide variety of [wedding venues in Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/merchant/18/wedding-venues "Wedding Venues, Wedding Venues Singapore"), the ideal décor is also required in order to bring your theme to life. From venue selection to nailing the basics, here’re some tips for choosing the perfect wedding decorations.

**Know Your Venue**

![Image 7: Wedding Hacks: Choosing the Ideal Wedding Décor](http://bit.ly/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20190609/20190609014134_75372.jpg)

_Hotel ballrooms are a popular choice for wedding venues_

_Source: Twogather Pictures_

Before shopping for your wedding decorations, it’s important to first understand what your wedding venue offers. For instance, does the venue offer mood lighting? Does it feature pillars that require dressing up? As such, it’s important to have a chat with the wedding coordinator/planner before actually purchasing the decorations.

**Tying the Theme Together**

![Image 8: Wedding Hacks: Choosing the Ideal Wedding Décor](http://bit.ly/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20190609/20190609014025_67510.jpg)

_A Disney themed wedding with purple as the main colour scheme_

_Source: Jovanni Photography_

From old-school glamour to minimalistic to funky modern, there is a [wide array of themes](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/trending/you-want-it-you-got-it-a-guide-to-the-ultimate-got-themed-wedding "You Want It, You GoT It: A Guide to the Ultimate GoT-Themed Wedding")for you to choose from. You could even opt for a Disney-inspired wedding (as long as both parties are agreeable).

It may be surprising, but the theme does not actually determine the colour palette of your wedding. Instead, a little tweaking to the family of colours goes a long way for the overall look and feel of your wedding. For example, a Beauty and the Beast-inspired wedding could be presented in pastel colours, to provide a softer feel to the wedding.

From table centrepieces and serviettes to wedding favours, it’s essential for the table settings to complement the theme. Simplicity is beauty – so don’t be afraid to expand the colour palette with just two different colours of varying shades.

**Delving Into Details**

![Image 9: Wedding Hacks: Choosing the Ideal Wedding Décor](http://bit.ly/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20190609/20190609014033_36019.jpg)

_A rustic-themed wedding_

Whether you choose to go with the venue’s existing decorations or rent decor or props from external vendors, ensure that your decorations are complementary to basic features such as tableware, linens and lighting, that your overall aesthetic isn’t compromised.

Together with the venue, your wedding decorations play a major role in creating the ambience. Whilst selecting the ideal decorations may take require considerable time and effort, seeing your wedding theme come to life will make the task worth every while.

# Basque Beauty: Wed in Style at the All-New Alkaff Mansion

 2019-06-10

![Image 6: Basque Beauty: Wed in Style at the All-New Alkaff Mansion](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20190609/20190609005931_72673.jpg)

_The Alkaff Mansion_

_Source: 1-Host_

Heads up newlyweds-to-be, The Alkaff Mansion has officially reopened its doors!

Known as the Alkaff Mansion Ristorante, the restaurant was previously helmed by Executive Chef Gabriele Piegaia of Tuscan origins and had received high acclaim.

![Image 7: Basque Beauty: Wed in Style at the All-New Alkaff Mansion](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20190609/20190609005939_80357.jpg)

_A couple celebrating their marriage at The Alkaff Mansion’s outdoors_

_Source: @smittenpixels.co_

For over four years, the Alkaff Mansion Ristorante provided both indoor and [outdoor wedding venues](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/merchant/18/wedding-venues "Outdoor Wedding Venues, Outdoor Wedding Venues Singapore"), and was the picture-perfect destination for many couples – including Instagram celebrity Inez Siantar and her now-husband Kok Yong.

Retaining its gorgeous Tudor-styled architecture, the dreamy venue today houses Basque restaurant UNA, bar TXA and café Wildseed.

![Image 8: Basque Beauty: Wed in Style at the All-New Alkaff Mansion](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20190609/20190609005947_16183.jpg)

_The UNA on the second level of The Alkaff Mansion_

_Source: 1 UNA_

Featuring signature items such as the suckling pig, selection of Paellas and Spanish grills, UNA has relocated from its previous space at One Rochester. From a partnership with the Basque Culinary Institute to its modern [romantic decor](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/trending/how-to-making-wed-d-i-y-ng-decorations "How-To: Making Wed(D-I-Y)ng Decorations")on the second level of the mansion, UNA provides an intimate venue that’s perfect for a cosy yet glamorous ceremony.

Visit TXA – Singapore’s first and only pintxos-dedicated bar – to amp up the mood. Host your after-party at TXA and enjoy bite-sized snacks, drinks and indulge in the electric atmosphere.

![Image 9: Basque Beauty: Wed in Style at the All-New Alkaff Mansion](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20190609/20190609005955_44167.jpg)

_Brunch at Wildseed_

_Source: @wildseedsg_

Looking to include your furmily at the wedding? Wildseed is a pet-friendly café that offers its signature dishes such as the Atas Kaya Toast, Pink Pear Elderflower Tart and Cherry Pecan Tart. Desserts aside, the café also offers a variety of savoury dishes.

![Image 10: Basque Beauty: Wed in Style at the All-New Alkaff Mansion](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20190609/20190609010002_32928.jpg)

_A simulated solemnisation ceremony at the Alkaff Mansion Wedding Fair_

_Source: @theperfectstatement_

The Alkaff Mansion remains a popular wedding venue, and rightfully so. Wedding facilities include a full-service bar, bridal room, AV equipment, projector and screen and an outdoor gazebo for solemnisation.

Outdoors, the romantic gazebo and grandeur of European-style fountains make for an ideal solemnisation venue.

For indoor wedding banquets, the two-storey mansion can seat up to 250 guests, who will be treated to your customised Basque catering menu or other options ranging from a set menu to a buffet.

![Image 11: Basque Beauty: Wed in Style at the All-New Alkaff Mansion](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20190609/20190609010009_79290.jpg)

_The second level of The Alkaff Mansion redecorated for a wedding_

_Source: The Alkaff Mansion_

With an expansive front verandah, balustrade staircases and pendant lighting, go for romantic elegance for the wedding night of your dreams. What’s more, The Alkaff Mansion was built in 1918, its history of over 100 years only adding to its elegant ambience.

**The Alkaff Mansion**

10 Telok Blangah Green, S(109178)
